strings.130_town_wishes_almost_11: I've never seen so many zombies! And they look angry!
strings.130_town_wishes_almost_12: Heh... maybe I shouldn't have rung that bell...
strings.130_town_wishes_almost_13: Sard... there's a lot of things we shouldn't have done.
strings.130_town_wishes_almost_14: But now, with the portal, we can fix all of them!
strings.130_town_wishes_almost_15: Two Keepers... two talking skulls... and somehow I'm not even surprised.
strings.130_town_wishes_almost_2: Time to rebuild the portal. Then everyone gets their wish.
strings.130_town_wishes_almost_3: Just... try not to break reality again.
strings.130_town_wishes_almost_4: So this is it? The wishing part?
strings.130_town_wishes_almost_5: Wait... why are there two Keepers?
strings.130_town_wishes_almost_6: Keeper One and Keeper Two... it's a long story, my friend.
strings.130_town_wishes_almost_7: Hey, I know you. You're the poet Vagner!
strings.130_town_wishes_almost_8: That's all in the past now, just like you being a Keeper.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_1: You fixed it! You did it! The world is saved!
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_10: Relax. Look, it's not even working yet.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_11: By the way... why isn't it working?
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_12: Last time, six sinners and a Keeper were enough.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_14_10: You cannot make wishes for yourselves... only for someone important to you.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_14_3: Look! It's working! I guess you were the seventh.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_14_4: Well that's quite a surprise. Perhaps my forced solitude changed me after all.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_14_7: All of you have done well.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_14_9: Now you may make your wishes. But...
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_15_1: I'm here... Ah, I'm so tired of walking. How do you all manage it?
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_15_10: We can make our wishes now.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_15_11: You cannot make wishes for yourselves... only for someone important to you.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_15_2: Everything's ready, but the portal isn't working.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_15_3: That's strange... are we still expecting someone?
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_15_5: Do you hear that noise outside?
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_15_6: Sounds like the whole town is gathering.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_15_8: I guess it's probably because I wrote about it in the latest issue of the magazine.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_16: Alright then... I wish for my friend Gunter to believe in himself, and not care about others people's opinions.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_17: Good wish. And I wish for you to learn some modesty and manners!
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_18: Ha! Also a very good wish, my friend.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_19: Alright, time for some serious wishes.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_2: And don't even think about breaking it again. I'm talking to all of you!
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_20: I wish Albert's sister back to being a normal woman!
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_21: Oh Linda... I wish you could finally relax and trust me. I'll never let you down.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_23: Hmm... I wish Agatha to find her happiness again. You don't need to fear losing things anymore.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_24: I think that's doable. But for that, I wish Herbert to regain his passion for life.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_25: Be brave again, soldier Herbert... just like in your old stories!
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_26: Now it's our turn. This should be easy!
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_27: Just a moment... Keeper, those two earned their curses.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_28: Maybe they deserve forgiveness... but I'd still like you to keep them on probation for another decade or so.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_29: That's probably fair. Ten more years won't change much.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_3: Or I'll find you and bite you!
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_30: Alright then... besides, I'm starting to like being a talking skull.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_31: Now it's my turn, I think...
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_32: I wish for Keeper One and his wife to return to the real world.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_33: Nothing's happening... why isn't anything happening?
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_34: Wishes take time... but in your case, you must use the portal itself.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_35: Then I'll skip my wish. I've already made too many.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_36: What should I wish for you, my friend?
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_37: Do you want to return with us?
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_38: In the real world you'll become one person again.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_39: Just don't forget to give me back the eye before you leave.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_40: You can go... we'll manage the rest on our own.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_43: What a story this has been. My thanks to all of you.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_44: And thank you, Old God, for the strange adventure we've lived through.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_45: Now wish me home, Keeper One. Keeper Two is ready to go!
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_47: You know... you guys go without me. Save your wish.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_48: I'm going to stay in this strange world with all my new friends.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_49: I want to see what happens here next.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_5: Alright then... farewell. Enjoy your wishes!
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_50: With the red eye or without it, I'll make my own story.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_51: Are you sure you don't want to use my wish?
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_52: No thanks... I can make all my wishes come true, all by myself.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_53: I am a Keeper, after all!
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_54: Well, back to work, my friend!
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_55: Let's not waste any more time. I have a big plans!
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_56: Seems I'll need to get used to living without my eye.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_57: You have a plan... Ha! The Ancient God has a better one.
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_6: Two Keepers... two talking skulls... and a fairy... are we expecting anyone else?
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_7: Agatha, you're about to be very surprised...
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_8: I told you we were going to miss everything!
strings.130_town_wishes_finish_9: Did you already make your wishes?
strings.131_history_start_before_2: I can't... it’s part of being a skull.
strings.131_history_start_before_3: Yeah... at first it was so unbelievable, but now...
strings.131_history_start_before_4: Hey, I haven’t had a chance to ask... how did you end up in the Inquisitor’s dungeon?
strings.131_history_start_before_5: Well... it all started in a place far, far away...
strings.131_history_start_cinematic_1: It was my usual Friday, in my usual world...
strings.131_history_start_cinematic_10: They accused me of witchcraft... And locked me in a dungeon...
strings.131_history_start_cinematic_2: Someone special was waiting for me at home after work.
strings.131_history_start_cinematic_3: Sometimes, your routine and your chores slowly wear you down...
strings.131_history_start_cinematic_4: But even in the everyday world, there's a place for loving and feeling loved.
strings.131_history_start_cinematic_5: Even when you know someone is already a little nervous...
strings.131_history_start_cinematic_7: The man with the red eye was waiting for me... Talking about a new chapter in my life...
strings.131_history_start_cinematic_8: He made a clone of me... or split me in two...
strings.131_history_start_cinematic_9: And then I found myself at the Inquisitor’s headquarters.
strings.131_history_start_ends_2: The sad part is, I couldn’t die there... But it was still very painful...
strings.131_history_start_ends_3: So maybe I lost some part of my mind...
strings.131_history_start_ends_4: Don’t be scared. You’re with Larry now.
strings.132_history_apocalypsis_before_1: So, how is everything around here?
strings.132_history_apocalypsis_before_2: Fresh air, hard work... I kind of enjoy it.
strings.132_history_apocalypsis_before_3: Good... I took a risk and snooped around the base.
strings.132_history_apocalypsis_before_4: Surprisingly, there's notes scattered all over the place.
strings.132_history_apocalypsis_before_5: A lot of them... no idea who wrote them, or why.
strings.132_history_apocalypsis_before_6: What kind of notes? Anything useful?
strings.132_history_apocalypsis_before_7: Mostly words. Emotions. Stuff like that... I read them.
strings.132_history_apocalypsis_before_9: That’s what I learned about the last days before the apocalypse.
strings.132_history_apocalypsis_cinematic_1: It all started about eight years ago.
strings.132_history_apocalypsis_cinematic_10: Then one day, even the living started turning undead. In masses.
strings.132_history_apocalypsis_cinematic_11: It began near the Royal Palace, and soon swallowed up most of the town.
strings.132_history_apocalypsis_cinematic_2: They'd been having trouble with their dead long before that...
strings.132_history_apocalypsis_cinematic_3: Something about betraying their gods. Twice.
strings.132_history_apocalypsis_cinematic_5: Everything really went downhill after a strange man who couldn’t die appeared...
strings.132_history_apocalypsis_cinematic_6: A man who was meant to be you.
strings.132_history_apocalypsis_cinematic_7: After that, the dead began to rise...
strings.132_history_apocalypsis_cinematic_8: Before anyone could bury them in the northern graveyard...
strings.132_history_apocalypsis_cinematic_9: Or send them off on ships.
strings.132_history_apocalypsis_end_1: Then the zombie transformations just stopped...
strings.132_history_apocalypsis_end_2: But there were already too many undead...
strings.132_history_apocalypsis_end_3: Now people fear every dead body...
strings.132_history_apocalypsis_end_4: Yet somehow they’ve learned to live in this mess.
strings.133_history_god_cinematic_before_1: I’ve got an update about your situation.
strings.133_history_god_cinematic_before_10: Remember when you told me about the guy with red eyes who split you in half...
strings.133_history_god_cinematic_before_2: You found some more notes somewhere...
strings.133_history_god_cinematic_before_3: Yeah... mostly about the final day of a guy named Rufus.
strings.133_history_god_cinematic_before_4: Personal stuff. You know how it is...
strings.133_history_god_cinematic_before_5: Plus I have another trusted source...
strings.133_history_god_cinematic_before_6: Someone big in the grave business.
strings.133_history_god_cinematic_before_8: Yep... a certain donkey, very talkative. Full of strange theories.
strings.133_history_god_cinematic_start_1: The man with red eyes was once a local god.
strings.133_history_god_cinematic_start_10: Long story short... the Old God showed the people mercy, and signed a contract with them.
strings.133_history_god_cinematic_start_11: He gave them a Graveyard Keeper to guide their souls and grant them peace after death.
strings.133_history_god_cinematic_start_12: There were many graveyard keepers, each serving their time...
strings.133_history_god_cinematic_start_13: Each brought here from distant lands.
strings.133_history_god_cinematic_start_14: And just when you appeared, another one arrived in the North Graveyard.
strings.133_history_god_cinematic_start_2: He provided people everything, in exchange for worshiping him.
strings.133_history_god_cinematic_start_3: Then they betrayed him... for a newer god.
strings.133_history_god_cinematic_start_4: After that, they were on their own with all their problems and their needs.
strings.133_history_god_cinematic_start_5: They abandoned all the old rituals, and the cycle of reincarnation collapsed.
strings.133_history_god_cinematic_start_6: The lost souls became a real problem...
strings.133_history_god_cinematic_start_7: What about the second god, and the second betrayal you mentioned?
strings.133_history_god_cinematic_start_8: Not important. The second god was a failure.
strings.133_history_god_end_1: But something bad happened to him...
strings.133_history_god_end_2: And I believe you’re the new Graveyard Keeper now.
strings.133_history_god_end_3: Hm... no one ever told me any of that. I’m not sure...
strings.133_history_god_end_4: Then tell me... doesn’t it seem odd to you, that a certificate appears when you bury a body?
strings.133_history_god_end_5: Now that you mention it... yeah, that is a little strange.
strings.133_history_god_end_6: Exactly. It’s part of an ancient contract...
strings.133_history_god_end_7: And you’re part of it too now.
strings.134_history_keeper_beer_1: I think I can find out more about the other keeper... the one who might be you.
strings.134_history_keeper_beer_2: That’s good news. I can’t believe any part of me could be that bad.
strings.134_history_keeper_beer_3: There’s just one problem... I'll need beer.
strings.134_history_keeper_beer_5: Not for me. For our comrade... the donkey.
strings.134_history_keeper_beer_6: Someone taught the poor beast how to drink.
strings.134_history_keeper_beer_7: Alright. I’ll bring some if it helps loosen his tongue.
strings.134_history_keeper_cinematic_end_1: Donkey has never seen him since...
strings.134_history_keeper_cinematic_end_2: Maybe his wish came true, and he went home.
strings.134_history_keeper_cinematic_end_4: Hey, don't you want to go back too?
strings.134_history_keeper_cinematic_end_5: No... not really. Sure there's things I miss...
strings.134_history_keeper_cinematic_end_6: But I think I belong here now.
strings.134_history_keeper_cinematic_end_7: Were you "where you belonged" chained up in the dungeon? Ha.
strings.134_history_keeper_cinematic_star_1: Now I’m almost certain the other keeper was you...
strings.134_history_keeper_cinematic_star_2: He was a decent enough fellow. A little greedy.
strings.134_history_keeper_cinematic_star_4: But overall, not a bad guy.
strings.134_history_keeper_cinematic_star_5: Always dreaming of going back to his world...
strings.134_history_keeper_cinematic_star_6: He discovered a legend about a wish-granting portal...
strings.134_history_keeper_cinematic_star_7: And put all his energy into restoring it...
strings.134_history_keeper_cinematic_star_8: He thought he'd fixed everything, with some help from his new friends.
strings.134_history_keeper_cinematic_star_9: But then, a short time after, the undead plague began...
strings.134_history_keeper_donkey_3: He’s way too excited about drinking with a skull.
strings.134_history_keeper_ride_1: You know, we kind of had a good time...
strings.134_history_keeper_ride_2: He even gave me a ride on his back...
strings.134_history_keeper_ride_3: So, did you learn anything useful?
strings.135_town_fisher_good_decent_3: Hah... trying to impress me, are you?
strings.135_town_fisher_good_decent_4: Anyone can catch a fish in a calm lake.
strings.135_town_fisher_good_decent_5: Try doing that in the sea.
strings.135_town_fisher_good_decent_7: No. This is my spot. Try your luck near the pier.
strings.135_town_fisher_good_decent_8: Bring me a sea fish and I’ll share an old fisherman’s recipe.
strings.135_town_fisher_good_meet_2: Not as good as it used to be.
strings.135_town_fisher_good_meet_3: You know, there's some good fishing spots outside town.
strings.135_town_fisher_good_meet_4: So you’re saying you’re a better fisherman?
strings.135_town_fisher_good_meet_7: Bring me a decent fish from one of your spots...
strings.135_town_fisher_good_meet_8: And I’ll admit you’re worth something.
strings.135_town_fisher_good_myst_2: It wasn’t easy, but I did it.
strings.135_town_fisher_good_myst_3: Let me see... you actually did it...
strings.135_town_fisher_good_myst_4: You win... the golden fisherman’s rod is yours.
strings.135_town_fisher_good_sea_3: Well... I’ll be damned. I guess the recipe is yours... best meal a fisherman can get.
strings.135_town_fisher_good_sea_4: Still, I’m a bit better than you.
strings.135_town_fisher_good_sea_5: If you really want to beat me, catch a mysterious fish.
strings.136_guards_discount_ask_10: We’ll see... I’ll raise my own soldiers... fearless and armed with shiny spears!
strings.136_guards_discount_ask_11: Alright... alright. Maybe we can discuss a small discount.
strings.136_guards_discount_ask_2: Why is your service so expensive?
strings.136_guards_discount_ask_3: Because we’re the only mercenaries around, and there hasn’t been much work lately.
strings.136_guards_discount_ask_4: So when someone finally does hire us, we set the price high.
strings.136_guards_discount_ask_5: But you just said no one hires you... maybe it’s because of that price.
strings.136_guards_discount_ask_6: Maybe nobody needs mercenaries... except you.
strings.136_guards_discount_ask_7: And now that I think about it, maybe every new contract should cost you even more!
strings.136_guards_discount_ask_9: Maybe... but what choice do you have?
strings.136_guards_discount_discount_2: So what kind of discount are we talking about?
strings.136_guards_discount_discount_3: Simple. Bring us some good quality wine. It’s nearly impossible to get these days.
strings.136_guards_discount_discount_4: And where exactly am I supposed to find it?
strings.136_guards_discount_discount_5: No idea... maybe you can make some. Ha ha.
strings.136_guards_discount_wine_3: Mmm... that is good. Where did you get it?
strings.136_guards_discount_wine_5: Hmm... in that case you can definitely make us some more.
strings.136_guards_discount_wine_6: Tell you what... we’ll gladly take your wine as payment instead of money.
strings.136_guards_discount_wine_7: To be honest, we’d only spend the money on wine anyway... just worse wine.
strings.137_base_resurection_necro_1: I see you're smiling... did you finally get that zombie book?
strings.137_base_resurection_necro_2: Yes... it should have all the answers.
strings.137_base_resurection_necro_3: Good. Now you just need a decent place to raise the dead.
strings.137_base_resurection_necro_4: I expect it’s just like cooking — better ingredients, better results.
strings.137_base_resurection_necro_5: What does cooking have to do with it?
strings.137_base_resurection_necro_6: Oh, I mean... better corpses make better zombies.
strings.137_base_resurection_room_1: I told you this is the place!
strings.137_base_resurection_room_10: And the wires start making all kinds of funny sparks. he he
strings.137_base_resurection_room_11: Wait... there’s a lightning storm every <sprite name="day_envy">?
strings.137_base_resurection_room_12: Yeah... just like clockwork. This world has become even weirder than I remember.
strings.137_base_resurection_room_13: I’m pretty sure that before the apocalypse, zombie resurrection worked perfectly fine without all that elec... whatever.
strings.137_base_resurection_room_14: Back then the air was full of magic.
strings.137_base_resurection_room_15: Shouldn’t we check their notes first?
strings.137_base_resurection_room_16: Hmm... looks like blueprints for the equipment they used here.
strings.137_base_resurection_room_17: But not a single word about the serum recipe.
strings.137_base_resurection_room_18: They keep referring to some book with the formula... the Necronomicon.
strings.137_base_resurection_room_19: Heh... I read that once! Although I only skimmed the cooking section.
strings.137_base_resurection_room_2: Looks like they took most of the equipment with them...
strings.137_base_resurection_room_20: I guess I'll need to find someone who knows more about zombie resurrection... and that book.
strings.137_base_resurection_room_3: But look — they left some resurrection serum, and a few notes.
strings.137_base_resurection_room_4: According to this, they were using electricity to resurrect corpses.
strings.137_base_resurection_room_6: See those long thin rope things on the wall? Those are wires... They carry electricity.
strings.137_base_resurection_room_7: But where would they get electricity here?
strings.137_base_resurection_room_8: Those wire things go all the way up to the top of the tower...
strings.137_base_resurection_room_9: Every <sprite name="day_envy"> when it storms, lightning strikes the tower.
strings.137_base_resurection_think_1: Think you might try resurrecting your own zombies at some point?
strings.137_base_resurection_think_10: I bet they were doing it somewhere near the morgue... We need to get into that room.
strings.137_base_resurection_think_11: That’s probably where they kept all their resurrection secrets.
strings.137_base_resurection_think_2: Yeah... that would be nice. Those green guys are pretty useful.
strings.137_base_resurection_think_3: I found some notes here about the experiments that the inquisitors were up to.
strings.137_base_resurection_think_4: They were hoping to resurrect their own zombies, and make them fight the bad ones.
strings.137_base_resurection_think_6: Looks like they got pretty close, too... They managed to resurrect them. Just couldn’t control them.
strings.137_base_resurection_think_7: To control them, I think you need to put a collar with a blue stone on them.
strings.137_base_resurection_think_8: Yeah, sounds like a good solution...
strings.137_base_resurection_think_9: You should ask the guy in the wooden mask about those stones.
strings.138_base_garden_clay_1: Nice... it actually works if you keep it spinning.
strings.138_base_garden_clay_2: Now I just need some clay.
strings.138_base_garden_clay_3: I spotted a clay deposit near those ruins.
strings.138_base_garden_clay_4: Thanks, Larry... I’d be lost without you.
strings.138_base_garden_dungeon_1: Why the long face? Something on your mind?
strings.138_base_garden_dungeon_10: Hmm... fair point. What would I do without you?
strings.138_base_garden_dungeon_11: You'd probably still be hanging from a chain in a dungeon. Ha ha.
strings.138_base_garden_dungeon_2: Yeah... I need to find a way into the basement.
strings.138_base_garden_dungeon_3: Back in my day, they usually kept basements below ground.
strings.138_base_garden_dungeon_4: So I’d check what’s under that hatch.
strings.138_base_garden_dungeon_5: What hatch are you talking about?
strings.138_base_garden_dungeon_7: I swear that wasn’t there before... it just... appeared...
strings.138_base_garden_dungeon_8: Sorry to disappoint you, but it was always there.
strings.138_base_garden_dungeon_9: It’s probably just psychological... fear of dungeons, massive trauma...
strings.138_base_garden_garden_1: While you were off wandering around, I did a bit of scouting.
strings.138_base_garden_garden_10: Looks like they grew grapes there. Probably for wine.
strings.138_base_garden_garden_11: A glass of wine really helps during an execution, you know. Ha ha...
strings.138_base_garden_garden_2: I was busy saving the world... which includes you, by the way.
strings.138_base_garden_garden_3: Very noble of you... Alright, I’ll tell you what I found.
strings.138_base_garden_garden_4: Maybe it’ll even help you save the world. Ha ha...
strings.138_base_garden_garden_5: This looks like a perfect spot for your crafting.
strings.138_base_garden_garden_6: Nice... I always wanted to work somewhere outdoors with a view.
strings.138_base_garden_garden_7: There used to be a garden here...
strings.138_base_garden_garden_8: Don’t ask why inquisitors needed one.
strings.138_base_garden_garden_9: And what’s over there, across the broken bridge to the left?
strings.138_base_garden_sand_1: Don’t tell me you need sand too.
strings.138_base_garden_sand_3: Good thing there’s plenty near the river.
strings.138_base_garden_sand_4: Who knows... maybe we’ll even find gold in it one day. Ha ha.
strings.139_town_homobonus_1: Hey, I should thank you for driving those zombies away!
strings.139_town_homobonus_10: I hate to break it to you, but no one is going to buy bottled water.
strings.139_town_homobonus_11: You’re absolutely right... mostly because all my bottles are broken.
strings.139_town_homobonus_12: I need new bottles to continue. If you could bring me some bottles.
strings.139_town_homobonus_13: I really need some new bottles. Bring me some, and I’ll give you my uncle’s old books.
strings.139_town_homobonus_15: I don’t know... I can barely read.
strings.139_town_homobonus_17: Ha ha... by the next time we meet, I’ll have made a fortune!
strings.139_town_homobonus_2: Now I can finally get back to business.
strings.139_town_homobonus_4: Oh, I’m Homobonus... a water seller.
strings.139_town_homobonus_5: Nice to meet you, my good man.
strings.139_town_homobonus_6: But what do you mean, selling water? It’s free everywhere... in the river, in any well.
strings.139_town_homobonus_7: That’s exactly why it’s the perfect business! I see opportunity!
strings.139_town_homobonus_8: Nobody sells water in bottles! Only wine and beer!
strings.139_town_homobonus_9: Soon, the entire market will be mine!
strings.13_village_fairy_jully_1: So... what can you tell me about fairies?
strings.13_village_fairy_jully_11: You'll need a couple of teeth.
strings.13_village_fairy_jully_12: Will a dead man's teeth work?
strings.13_village_fairy_jully_13: Yeah... hmm... in that case, you'd also need Dream Dust.
strings.13_village_fairy_jully_14: Where am I supposed to find that?
strings.13_village_fairy_jully_15: Where indeed... You won't like this...
strings.13_village_fairy_jully_16: The Plague Doctor... that excuse of a man.
strings.13_village_fairy_jully_17: He's your one option... But I have to warn you... He's cursed.
strings.13_village_fairy_jully_19: His cursed home is somewhere... underground.
strings.13_village_fairy_jully_20: Yeah... I've seen him in the dungeon under my house...
strings.13_village_fairy_jully_3: Hmm... You have helped us, I'll give you that.
strings.13_village_fairy_jully_4: Maybe you really are starting to think beyond more than just yourself...
strings.13_village_fairy_jully_6: Ancient spirits of nature... from a time before the god with the red eye.
strings.13_village_fairy_jully_7: Hey, I saw that guy! He even talked to me!
strings.13_village_fairy_jully_8: Yeah, yeah... don't talk rubbish. He's long gone! Abandoned us all...
strings.13_village_fairy_jully_9: There's a village on the other side of town. They still worship him — can you believe it?
strings.140_town_homobonusus_1: Hey! Its nice to see you again!
strings.140_town_homobonusus_11: The problem is, in this business I’m always running low on faith.
strings.140_town_homobonusus_12: And you... you have a nice, stable income.
strings.140_town_homobonusus_13: So if you’re interested, we can trade your faith for my money... at a very reasonable rate.
strings.140_town_homobonusus_2: So... how’s the water business going?
strings.140_town_homobonusus_6: Hmm... but you do look happy and prosperous. What changed?
strings.140_town_homobonusus_7: Instead of selling water, I decided to write a book about how to start your own water-selling business.
strings.140_town_homobonusus_8: Wait... you gave me a book because you said you couldn’t read.
strings.140_town_homobonusus_9: I said I can barely read! But plenty enough to write a self-help book.
strings.141_town_porters_1: Don’t you ever get tired dragging crates to the Town all by yourself?
strings.141_town_porters_2: Got a better idea? Because sending zombies down main street sounds like a quick way to start a riot.
strings.141_town_porters_3: Who said anything about the street?
strings.141_town_porters_4: Bet the Inquisitors had a way to get to the Town unnoticed.
strings.141_town_porters_5: And judging by this tunnel? I’d bet it leads straight into Town. Quietly.
strings.141_town_porters_6: ...You might actually be right. I’ll check it out.
strings.141_town_porters_7: Of course I am. You should really start getting used to that.
strings.142_foundry_zombie_10: We didn't have them all at the palace... and the portal still worked.
strings.142_foundry_zombie_11: Thank you... I know someone who definitely knows how to use the portal.
strings.142_foundry_zombie_13: That whole portal affair completely transformed me and my friends. I used to be full of pride!
strings.142_foundry_zombie_14: Now I'm just a modest monk... and I'm perfectly content.
strings.142_foundry_zombie_15: I hope you find your own peace as well.
strings.142_foundry_zombie_2: This is zombie power. You can use it as a labor force. Compact. No feeding required.
strings.142_foundry_zombie_3: The brothers will appreciate this. Thank you.
strings.142_foundry_zombie_4: I hope you finish the portal... and use it wisely.
strings.142_foundry_zombie_5: If that's even possible... only the Ancient God knows...
strings.142_foundry_zombie_7: By the way, do you know how to activate a portal?
strings.142_foundry_zombie_9: You're supposed to collect six items... at least, that was the plan.
strings.143_workshop_piece_10: I'm a good friend too... and I need that fragment.
strings.143_workshop_piece_11: Hmm... do you know what's better than luck?
strings.143_workshop_piece_13: Help me straighten things out with my project, and the rock is yours.
strings.143_workshop_piece_2: Jack, I need the portal fragment Gunter gave you.
strings.143_workshop_piece_3: The one he charged with luck especially for me?
strings.143_workshop_piece_5: Not happening. I normally don't buy into Gunter's mystic nonsense...
strings.143_workshop_piece_6: Although lately... I could use a bit of luck. Ha ha.
strings.143_workshop_piece_7: You don't need some silly rock. You've got Gunter backing you.
strings.143_workshop_piece_8: Ha! Gunter needs someone backing him.
strings.143_workshop_piece_9: He's a good kid, and a good friend... He's just a little spineless.
strings.143_workshop_piece_get_11_a: Yes. He just needs to wrap up some PR stuff first.
strings.143_workshop_piece_get_11_b: Yep. He's waiting for you at his place to discuss the details.
strings.143_workshop_piece_get_12: That sounds good... You know, it's not easy always being on top.
strings.143_workshop_piece_get_13: Sometimes I'd like to be an ordinary man who can just rely on a friend.
strings.143_workshop_piece_get_14: And working together on a project is what turns men into friends!
strings.143_workshop_piece_get_17: Can I have that stone now?
strings.143_workshop_piece_get_18: Of course. May it bring you luck as well.
strings.143_workshop_piece_get_2: I think I got you the answers you were looking for.
strings.143_workshop_piece_get_3: Maybe... but now I'm questioning something else.
strings.143_workshop_piece_get_4: Do I really need to push myself this hard? While you, the monks...
strings.143_workshop_piece_get_5: You all seem more capable than me.
strings.143_workshop_piece_get_6: Hey Jack... cheer up. You're the toast of the town, after all.
strings.143_workshop_piece_get_8: He chose you. That means something.
strings.143_workshop_piece_get_9: He told me he wants to launch a new major project... with you.
strings.143_workshop_piece_outside_1: I'll go place these fragments at the portal, and politely request the next one.
strings.144_crossroad_home_10: So it looks more like a house and less like a tent.
strings.144_crossroad_home_12: You're probably wondering what a modest sister wants with a fourth wall.
strings.144_crossroad_home_13: So you can smash it dramatically?
strings.144_crossroad_home_14: No... I let other people do the wall breaking.
strings.144_crossroad_home_15: I want Herbert to leave his job and move in...
strings.144_crossroad_home_16: He's so tired of everything... and I'd be able to read to him more...
strings.144_crossroad_home_17: Ha, I thought your whole thing was anger, not lust.
strings.144_crossroad_home_19: I'm an old nun, and he's an old soldier. We don't deal in love.
strings.144_crossroad_home_2: Maybe you should quit beating around the bush and just ask for a favor.
strings.144_crossroad_home_20: It's about giving Herbert some peace, after all he's endured for those ungrateful fools.
strings.144_crossroad_home_21: Sorry if I offended you... I'll build your fourth wall.
strings.144_crossroad_home_3: You've hinted at it twice already.
strings.144_crossroad_home_4: Don't you dare talk to me like that.
strings.144_crossroad_home_5: But yes... I do need your help. Hopefully for the last time.
strings.144_crossroad_home_7: In your dreams. I've never been better.
strings.144_crossroad_home_9: I need you to improve my living quarters one more time.
strings.144_crossroad_home_complete_3: The next time Herbert comes to hear me read, I'll invite him to your ceremony.
strings.144_crossroad_home_complete_4: He'll hear the organ... and afterward, I'll ask him to leave his post...
strings.144_crossroad_home_complete_5: He's been overwhelmed lately... he hasn't asked me to read to him in ages.
strings.145_base_organ_1: Thank you, Keeper, for the ceremony... the organ truly moved me.
strings.145_base_organ_10: I felt it too. The music reminded me of a time before all the bitterness.
strings.145_base_organ_11: When I think of my sisters now, there's no anger... only gentle sorrow.
strings.145_base_organ_12: It's nice to hear that warmth in your voice.
strings.145_base_organ_13: You're a great example. Steadiness and kindness can change the world.
strings.145_base_organ_15: That's good to hear. Now don't keep him waiting... invite that old soldier home.
strings.145_base_organ_16: Before he changes his mind and decides the barracks are more peaceful!
strings.145_base_organ_2: I told you, Herbert — that instrument carries something special in its pipes.
strings.145_base_organ_3: Indeed. I thought your voice was the most beautiful sound I knew...
strings.145_base_organ_4: But now you have a competitor...
strings.145_base_organ_5: The music eased my heart. A short walk to top it off would be just right.
strings.145_base_organ_6: I'll join you in a moment. I need a word with the Keeper.
strings.145_base_organ_8: I'm glad he found peace. I hope you found some too.
strings.145_base_organ_9: I don't know how you did it... Herbert told me he felt no wrath, only peace.
strings.145_base_organ_ceremony: A Good Example is the Best Sermon
strings.146_stilt_master_ask_11: Fine, then yes... I carve "special" wood.
strings.146_stilt_master_ask_12: I need some for a church project.
strings.146_stilt_master_ask_13: Church project? That sounds impressive. Good for you.
strings.146_stilt_master_ask_14: Do you need me to do something for it?
strings.146_stilt_master_ask_15: Do something? No... no, man. I'll just sell it to you.
strings.146_stilt_master_ask_17: Once I fix my wood-catching mechanism.
strings.146_stilt_master_ask_18: So there's something I can help you with after all?
strings.146_stilt_master_ask_19: No, no... I'll handle it myself...
strings.146_stilt_master_ask_2: I'm looking for a master woodcarver.
strings.146_stilt_master_ask_21: What's stopping you from fixing it now?
strings.146_stilt_master_ask_22: I need some materials. But I don't like going to the market...
strings.146_stilt_master_ask_24: Fine. I'll get the materials for you.
strings.146_stilt_master_ask_3: Hmm... there should be one around here... let me think...
strings.146_stilt_master_ask_4: Oh wait... I think I'm a master woodcarver.
strings.146_stilt_master_ask_7: Special? What's so special about it?
strings.146_stilt_master_ask_8: It's just wood from the trees that grow in the northern mountains.
strings.146_stilt_master_ask_9: Sometimes it drifts down the river... and I gather and season it.
strings.146_stilt_master_materials_2: Here's the materials you asked for.
strings.146_stilt_master_materials_3: Sweet... you know, I didn't actually need them.
strings.146_stilt_master_materials_4: After our talk, I checked the mechanism... It was just stuck...
strings.146_stilt_master_materials_5: So I can get that special wood now?
strings.146_stilt_master_materials_6: Sure. I'll give it to you in exchange for some coins.
strings.147_sewers_looters_1: This is it. Mauritzio's cheese cellar lies just behind this wall.
strings.147_sewers_looters_10: Wonderful idea. Except you'll bury yourself... and the entire neighborhood... under rubble.
strings.147_sewers_looters_11: Then I'll wait. Doors don't vanish without a reason. Sooner or later, I'll figure out the trick.
strings.147_sewers_looters_12: Meanwhile I should focus on restoring the portal.
strings.147_sewers_looters_2: And the door should be right here.
strings.147_sewers_looters_3: Yes... It should be. But it isn't.
strings.147_sewers_looters_4: Maybe we were mistaken. Maybe the door moved.
strings.147_sewers_looters_5: Doors don't move. And we're in the right spot. Can't you smell the cheese?
strings.147_sewers_looters_6: We robbed this place once, before the apocalypse. The door was right here. I remember running through it.
strings.147_sewers_looters_7: Fine. I'll just dig through the wall.
strings.147_sewers_looters_8: No chance. The wall is too thick... solid stone.
strings.148_doctor_cough_10: Linda... I think she cares about me. And I want to be there for her.
strings.148_doctor_cough_11: She's fragile... innocent, like my sister once was. I need to protect her.
strings.148_doctor_cough_13_a: I'll do everything I can to find a cure.
strings.148_doctor_cough_13_b: I'm working on something that might help you.
strings.148_doctor_cough_2: You mentioned something about a way to cure yourself.
strings.148_doctor_cough_3: Yes, there could be a way to cure my cough. cough-cough
strings.148_doctor_cough_5: Perhaps. You might just happen across something that could save me.
strings.148_doctor_cough_6: I thought you already had a plan, and just needed my help getting ingredients or something.
strings.148_doctor_cough_7: No... I don't have a plan. But for the first time, I want to live. cough-cough
strings.148_doctor_cough_8: I used to envy the healthy and the strong... But now I'd settle for breathing without pain.
strings.149_sluice_tools_land_11: You must be from somewhere pretty advanced.
strings.149_sluice_tools_land_12: But I really want to help Albert. I'll get you the right equipment.
strings.149_sluice_tools_land_13: Excellent. We'll begin clearing the land in the meantime.
strings.149_sluice_tools_land_3: I'm glad you approve. I hope to see your first harvest soon.
strings.149_sluice_tools_land_4: There's just one issue... we didn't bring our tools.
strings.149_sluice_tools_land_5: That's easily solved. You can buy tools in town.
strings.149_sluice_tools_land_6: We've seen them. Such poor quality.
strings.149_sluice_tools_land_7: You can imagine what they'd do to the soil.
strings.149_sluice_tools_tools_11: It's a magical po-ta-to. Some adventurers brought it from faraway lands.
strings.149_sluice_tools_tools_12: It draws its strength from the soil. Boil it well.
strings.149_sluice_tools_tools_13: Have your friend inhale the steam from the boiled po-ta-to.
strings.149_sluice_tools_tools_14: Repeat that every day for a week, and his cough should fade away.
strings.149_sluice_tools_tools_2: Wow, I'm surprised how quickly you made this place look nice.
strings.149_sluice_tools_tools_3: Seems I brought you the tools just in time.
strings.149_sluice_tools_tools_4: We love to work... We're surprised how lazy everyone is here.
strings.149_sluice_tools_tools_5: As if someone else is meant to provide everything.
strings.149_sluice_tools_tools_6: Oh, if you only knew how true those words are.
strings.149_sluice_tools_tools_7: I'll expect my share of the harvest.
strings.149_sluice_tools_tools_8: We heard your friend is very ill, so we'll give you some in advance.
strings.149_sluice_tools_tools_9: And you may purchase more anytime.
strings.14_guard_faith_battle_2: Just take this red banner. The others will follow you.
strings.14_guard_faith_bell_2: Here's the bell I was talking about.
strings.14_guard_faith_bell_3: I'll set it up and explain to everyone just how important it is...
strings.14_guard_faith_head_11: We need to bring our Sword count to an appropriate number.
strings.14_guard_faith_head_12: And I can assure you... that isn't happening without that squad of Hired Swords on board.
strings.14_guard_faith_head_13: Ok... I think I can manage all this...
strings.14_guard_faith_head_15: Even with all that, we'll still need a miracle...
strings.14_guard_faith_head_16: to beat all those zombies. Or a cheap trick.
strings.14_guard_faith_head_18: Like an ace up your sleeve.
strings.14_guard_faith_head_19: It won't give us an advantage, but it might give us a second chance.
strings.14_guard_faith_head_2: Interesting... it's the first time in many years that someone actually cares.
strings.14_guard_faith_head_21: We need to make a bell...
strings.14_guard_faith_head_23: ... and that's how we can drive them to retreat, and save ourselves if the battle turns.
strings.14_guard_faith_head_25: Heh... I'm just glad you're the one testing it.
strings.14_guard_faith_head_26: Bring me the bell. I'll get everything else prepared.
strings.14_guard_faith_head_3: So... we going to fight the zombies back now?
strings.14_guard_faith_head_4: Oh no, not we... mostly you. I'm too old for this.
strings.14_guard_faith_head_5: Ok, I'm ready! Let's kick some zombie butt!
strings.14_guard_faith_head_7: We need to prepare. And since our dear Master Jack has abandoned ship,
strings.14_guard_faith_head_8: it's up to you to gather all the supplies and materials we'll need.
strings.14_guard_faith_head_9: Hmm... Sounds like a lot of work.
strings.14_guard_faith_sword_2: Good to hear. I hope you'll lead our forces into battle!
strings.150_base_90not_10: All you'll need to do then is fix the portal. With my red eye and a snap of a finger...
strings.150_base_90not_11: Whoosh! Wishes granted, world saved, and so on.
strings.150_base_90not_12: You really want your eye back?
strings.150_base_90not_13: I'm used to its power. It took a long time for me to learn how to live without it.
strings.150_base_90not_14: Honestly... I'm a little afraid for you.
strings.150_base_90not_15: Yes, I know... it gives me bad dreams.
strings.150_base_90not_2: I spoke with them. They're all willing to help me.
strings.150_base_90not_3: But something's still holding them back.
strings.150_base_90not_4: I told you... they have to be one hundred percent on your side.
strings.150_base_90not_5: But I don't know what else I can do for them. They all seem pretty settled now.
strings.150_base_90not_6: Yes, trust requires time. You'll just have to wait.
strings.150_base_90not_7: And perhaps, one day, your skills will be great enough to help them.
strings.150_base_90not_8: I see... then I'll keep improving my skills.
strings.150_base_90not_9: Or... you could just give me back my eye, and we skip this slow part.
strings.150_base_90not_give_eye_2: Oh, thank you. I was starting to think you were one of those cautious types.
strings.150_base_90not_give_eye_3: It feels wonderful to have my eye back.
strings.150_base_90not_give_eye_4: You said things would go faster with my friends once you had it back again.
strings.150_base_90not_give_eye_5: And I am a god of my word.
strings.150_base_90not_give_eye_6: Go speak with those six again. With my blessing, I'm sure things will go smoothly.
strings.150_base_90not_keep_eye_2: Alright then, I'll just keep doing my work.
strings.150_base_90not_keep_eye_3: Why not, if you like it so much.
strings.151_base_90yes_1: So the whole sinful crew is on board?
strings.151_base_90yes_10: Heh... It was entertaining at first, but it caused quite a mess.
strings.151_base_90yes_11: Still... good luck with what comes next.
strings.151_base_90yes_2: Oh! You startled me... Yes, they've all agreed.
strings.151_base_90yes_3: I just need to get the last portal fragment.
strings.151_base_90yes_4: And to get it, I'll have to face the other me.
strings.151_base_90yes_5: Well, I suppose I'll help you. To be honest, I'm not very fond of your other version.
strings.151_base_90yes_6: It seems you're the better choice. But who can really know, right?
strings.151_base_90yes_7: You never explained why you split us in the first place.
strings.151_base_90yes_8: That's... complicated. The kind of complicated that only gods enjoy. But in short, I wanted to try something different.
strings.151_base_90yes_9: Like when I decided humans were ready to handle things on their own.
strings.152_astrologer_dark_come_1: Hey guys... how's your project going?
strings.152_astrologer_dark_come_10: Something elegant, maybe carved from expensive wood. With a paper holder.
strings.152_astrologer_dark_come_11: We'd be very grateful. Right, Jack?
strings.152_astrologer_dark_come_12: Yes... the readers adore me. They write such wonderful letters.
strings.152_astrologer_dark_come_13: Alright then. If that's what you need, I'll make it.
strings.152_astrologer_dark_come_3: Great... just great. We're still in the pre-production phase.
strings.152_astrologer_dark_come_4: Yes, we're planning to make some money first, and then travel around studying how other colossi were built.
strings.152_astrologer_dark_come_5: Maybe you should start building your own first.
strings.152_astrologer_dark_come_6: You know... that might actually be a good idea.
strings.152_astrologer_dark_come_7: Did you lose your fan letters again?
strings.152_astrologer_dark_come_9: Keeper, you could really help us by crafting a new prosthetic hand for Jack.
strings.152_astrologer_dark_dream_1: I hope today we'll finally do something.
strings.152_astrologer_dark_dream_10: Not right now. I'm starting a new project instead.
strings.152_astrologer_dark_dream_11: A brand new magazine... OnlyFuns. Linda will write about all the funny stories from the Port Club.
strings.152_astrologer_dark_dream_12: It's going to be a huge success!
strings.152_astrologer_dark_dream_14: Wow... people really like me. These letters are full of compliments.
strings.152_astrologer_dark_dream_2: Hey, yesterday we released the twelfth issue of our magazine.
strings.152_astrologer_dark_dream_3: We shared all our grand plans with the readers!
strings.152_astrologer_dark_dream_4: Plans are nice... but maybe we should actually build something too.
strings.152_astrologer_dark_dream_5: Jack, everyone is thrilled about your vision for the colossus.
strings.152_astrologer_dark_dream_6: We sold twice as many copies as usual. Where's that adoring fan letter?
strings.152_astrologer_dark_dream_9: That's wonderful. You were also planning to publish your poetry, remember?
strings.152_astrologer_dark_hand_2: Here's an elegant hand for you. It won't hold a hammer, but it's perfect for holding papers.
strings.152_astrologer_dark_hand_3: Thanks, Keeper. It's exactly what I needed.
strings.152_astrologer_dark_wake_up_1: What's wrong? You were shouting in your sleep.
strings.152_astrologer_dark_wake_up_2: Just a strange dream. My friends were heading down the wrong path.
strings.152_astrologer_dark_wake_up_3: Maybe that's the sign you were waiting for. They might need your help!
strings.153_crossroad_dark_chair_2: Here it is — the most comfortable chair I could come up with.
strings.153_crossroad_dark_chair_4: Yes, yes... of course. Thank you, Keeper!
strings.153_crossroad_dark_come_10: He can build the most comfortable chair for you... right?
strings.153_crossroad_dark_come_11: Yes... of course. That won't be a problem.
strings.153_crossroad_dark_come_2: Very peaceful... though my legs seem to be getting weaker.
strings.153_crossroad_dark_come_3: Don't worry. We'll get you a new chair... something more comfortable.
strings.153_crossroad_dark_come_4: Maybe what you need is more walking.
strings.153_crossroad_dark_come_5: You might be right. I was even thinking of returning to my old post... just part-time.
strings.153_crossroad_dark_come_7: Do you want me to just leave you be... and deliver your body to the Keeper?
strings.153_crossroad_dark_come_8: No, no, Agatha... there's still so many books you can read to me.
strings.153_crossroad_dark_come_9: That's the right attitude, Herbert. And our friend the Keeper will be happy to help us.
strings.153_crossroad_dark_dream_1: Are you sure you don't need anything?
strings.153_crossroad_dark_dream_10: And then I'll have a part of you forever.
strings.153_crossroad_dark_dream_11: Alright, Agatha... I'd hate to upset you.
strings.153_crossroad_dark_dream_2: No, you just sit and relax. You're safe here... don't wear yourself out.
strings.153_crossroad_dark_dream_3: I'll be back soon, and read to you some more.
strings.153_crossroad_dark_dream_4: That sounds terrific. Meanwhile, maybe I'll take a short walk... visit my old guards.
strings.153_crossroad_dark_dream_5: Absolutely not. They're a terrible influence on you.
strings.153_crossroad_dark_dream_6: My life has become too calm. I'm starting to think you're protecting me a little too much...
strings.153_crossroad_dark_dream_7: I just don't want to lose you, Herbert. I've already lost so much.
strings.153_crossroad_dark_dream_8: Now relax and think of the next story you're going to tell me.
strings.153_crossroad_dark_dream_9: The Keeper's device will write it down.
strings.153_crossroad_dark_wake_up_2: Yes... not a pleasant one. A disturbing dream about my friends.
strings.153_crossroad_dark_wake_up_3: Maybe it's time for you to help them.
strings.154_linda_dark_come_1: Hey Albert how are you doing?
strings.154_linda_dark_come_10: You deserve it, my love. Do you need something, Keeper?
strings.154_linda_dark_come_11: Actually yes. I'm looking for a way to help you. Maybe you can think of something.
strings.154_linda_dark_come_12: Do you need any help, Linda?
strings.154_linda_dark_come_13: Oh, that's very sweet of you...
strings.154_linda_dark_come_14: We're fine. Everything is under control. But if you want to help, you could bring me some luxury drapes.
strings.154_linda_dark_come_15: Water-resistant drapes. I want to decorate my basement lab.
strings.154_linda_dark_come_16: Hmm, yes Albert... drapes would make it look much nicer.
strings.154_linda_dark_come_17: Alright, I'll try to make some for you.
strings.154_linda_dark_come_2: Good, good, Keeper. Quite busy, but very happy.
strings.154_linda_dark_come_3: Where's Linda? She's usually welcoming patrons around this time.
strings.154_linda_dark_come_4: She's resting. She has done so much for the town... she deserves some personal time now.
strings.154_linda_dark_come_7: Nice to see you, Keeper... yawn
strings.154_linda_dark_come_9: Albert is wrapping me with care... maybe a bit too tightly.
strings.154_linda_dark_drape_2: I brought the drapes. They're waterproof and fire-resistant.
strings.154_linda_dark_drape_3: Thank you, Keeper. That's exactly what we needed to make our little nest even nicer.
strings.154_linda_dark_dream_1: Linda — I was waiting for you downstairs in my lab!
strings.154_linda_dark_dream_10: The basement is quieter. Much better for delicate work.
strings.154_linda_dark_dream_11: You'll grow to appreciate it soon.
strings.154_linda_dark_dream_12: I'll appreciate anything you do for me, my love.
strings.154_linda_dark_dream_2: Oh sorry, darling. I was busy and lost track of time.
strings.154_linda_dark_dream_3: I gave you a weekly schedule for a reason. You need to stop working so much.
strings.154_linda_dark_dream_4: It's time for your health injection. I've prepared several serums for you.
strings.154_linda_dark_dream_5: Oh Albert... maybe you've already taken enough care of me.
strings.154_linda_dark_dream_6: Nonsense. Your beauty and health must be preserved. Afterward you'll rest... a long, deep sleep.
strings.154_linda_dark_dream_7: Of course, Albert... I'm just not used to someone caring about me so much.
strings.154_linda_dark_dream_8: You are everything to me... and your health and beauty deserve protection.
strings.154_linda_dark_dream_9: But why can't we do the procedure in your medical office upstairs?
strings.154_linda_dark_wake_up_2: Yes, something is always happening... you just need to have fun with it.
strings.154_linda_dark_wake_up_3: I think it's time for you to have fun helping others.
strings.155_guards_bridge_10: She's so kind... and fragile in her own way. She misses her sisters deeply.
strings.155_guards_bridge_11: Maybe "fragile" isn't quite the right word.
strings.155_guards_bridge_12: You should have seen her eyes, when she mentioned the organ from her old monastery.
strings.155_guards_bridge_13: I asked Jack... He said you'd be able to build one.
strings.155_guards_bridge_14: Let me guess... It needs special wood for proper resonance.
strings.155_guards_bridge_15: So you've already looked into it.
strings.155_guards_bridge_16: Then it's fortunate you're heading to the woodcarvers anyway.
strings.155_guards_bridge_18: Let me know when the organ is ready.
strings.155_guards_bridge_2: We need a plan to fight through to the woodcarvers on the lake.
strings.155_guards_bridge_3: You're never content with peace, are you...
strings.155_guards_bridge_4: I was even considering leaving the service... and yet here you are again.
strings.155_guards_bridge_5: Herbert, trust me... this time it benefits you too.
strings.155_guards_bridge_6: Fine. We'll push north from the square, cross the two main bridges...
strings.155_guards_bridge_7: Then head west. That should lead us to the lake bridge... if it's not overrun.
strings.155_guards_bridge_9: Wait... this might also be my chance to repay Agatha.
strings.155_guards_bridge_retirement_11: All I need is a proper suit of armor to mount on the wall... and then I'll retire.
strings.155_guards_bridge_retirement_13: And maybe a set for my men...
strings.155_guards_bridge_retirement_14: So I know they'll be protected once I step aside.
strings.155_guards_bridge_retirement_2: Are you really planning to step down?
strings.155_guards_bridge_retirement_3: Why not? Things are finally stable.
strings.155_guards_bridge_retirement_4: And I should spend more time with Agatha... it steadies her.
strings.155_guards_bridge_retirement_5: You're right. She shouts at people less.
strings.155_guards_bridge_retirement_6: Exactly. And your soldiers are stronger than ever.
strings.155_guards_bridge_retirement_7: There's a new quartermaster replacing Jack at the warehouse.
strings.155_guards_bridge_retirement_8: He's stubborn, and a creature of few words. He'll go far... and he'd be a great replacement for me, too.
strings.156_base_pieces_1: So... the legendary magic portal is nearly finished.
strings.156_base_pieces_10: Alright... it's in a well-secured, heavily protected inquisitor base.
strings.156_base_pieces_11: One of the inquisitors had quite a pretty wife, so during my last job I kept an eye on them.
strings.156_base_pieces_12: Hold on... the base on the hill west of Town?
strings.156_base_pieces_13: Maybe. I can see the place, but I don't have a map.
strings.156_base_pieces_14: And it's still guarded? When did you last check?
strings.156_base_pieces_15: Some time ago... but I'm quite sure... Wait... where did all the inquisitors go?
strings.156_base_pieces_16: Now I just see a funny donkey drinking with... a talking skull.
strings.156_base_pieces_17: Then that's definitely my base. Where's the fragment?
strings.156_base_pieces_18: Just lying around in the debris.
strings.156_base_pieces_2: Yes. Two more fragments, and the thing should finally work again.
strings.156_base_pieces_3: Just let me know when you're placing the final piece.
strings.156_base_pieces_4: I'd like to be standing very far away from any dramatic portal activation.
strings.156_base_pieces_6: Mirror, mirror... show me the sixth portal fragment.
strings.156_base_pieces_8: Oh dear... that one won't be easy. Especially for a couple shady fellows with a magic mirror.
strings.156_base_pieces_9: Just tell him! He'll get it no matter the cost.
strings.156_base_pieces_base_10: Hmm... except you're dressed differently. And the other skull looks better.
strings.156_base_pieces_base_11: Excuse me? The other talking skull?
strings.156_base_pieces_base_12: Ah yes, and there, I see her — the Keeper's wife. She told me to call her the Queen.
strings.156_base_pieces_base_14: In the throne room of the Royal Palace. The last fragment is there.
strings.156_base_pieces_base_15: That's bad news. The palace is in the center of the infected area.
strings.156_base_pieces_base_16: But I also have good news.
strings.156_base_pieces_base_18: I just won a bet against Comrade Donkey. I said we'd eventually need to meet your other self.
strings.156_base_pieces_base_19: I just need that fragment, not to meet myself.
strings.156_base_pieces_base_20: We won't tell donkey about that part.
strings.156_base_pieces_base_21: There is somebody who'd know the way to the Palace.
strings.156_base_pieces_base_23: Davy the Dagger. He knows all the hidden paths. Talk to him.
strings.156_base_pieces_base_3: No, I still need one more.
strings.156_base_pieces_base_4: That's good. You know — as your friend and companion, I'm expecting a wish for myself.
strings.156_base_pieces_base_5: Of course, Larry. We're almost there.
strings.156_base_pieces_base_6: I'll ask where the last fragment is right away.
strings.156_base_pieces_base_7: Mirror, mirror... reveal the final portal fragment.
strings.156_base_pieces_base_8: Hey... are you messing with me? You're standing right next to it with that talking skull.
strings.156_base_pieces_base_9: No... this can't be the last one. Or is there another one here?
strings.157_base_palace_10: I need a safe path to the throne room in the Royal Palace.
strings.157_base_palace_11: Wow, that is dangerous... Robbing the palace would be the crown jewel of my career!
strings.157_base_palace_12: See? I knew it was too much for you.
strings.157_base_palace_13: Hold on now! Anything is possible for the right price.
strings.157_base_palace_14: I swear I'll find that path. I'd gladly sacrifice every one of my looters to discover it.
strings.157_base_palace_15: And when they're gone, I'll recruit and train new ones!
strings.157_base_palace_16: That's the spirit. I admire your dedication, Davy.
strings.157_base_palace_2: There's nobody I can ask but you.
strings.157_base_palace_4: Although... maybe this one is too hard for you.
strings.157_base_palace_7: Nothing is too dangerous for Davy the Dagger.
strings.157_base_palace_9: Oh sard, just say what you want already.
strings.157_base_palace_more_1: Keeper! This has been a job worth bragging about.
strings.157_base_palace_more_10: There should be a hidden door somewhere in this wall.
strings.157_base_palace_more_11: But even with all your strength and resources... it might just be too much.
strings.157_base_palace_more_12: Thanks, Davy. I'll figure something out.
strings.157_base_palace_more_13: Did you hear that, Larry? What should I do?
strings.157_base_palace_more_14: Looks like we're preparing for the final battle.
strings.157_base_palace_more_15: It's about time for your friends indeed to become your friends in need.
strings.157_base_palace_more_18: I'm already asking them to help activate the portal.
strings.157_base_palace_more_19: Great. Then one more small favor shouldn't make any difference.
strings.157_base_palace_more_2: So you found a safe route?
strings.157_base_palace_more_3: Well... not exactly safe. You'll still need to fight your way through.
strings.157_base_palace_more_4: That's something I'm used to by now.
strings.157_base_palace_more_5: You don't understand. This fight will be massive.
strings.157_base_palace_more_6: You'll go in through the sewer, and come out at the square near the palace.
strings.157_base_palace_more_7: That's where you'll have to battle all the zombies in the area and keep them busy.
strings.157_base_palace_more_8: If you can hold them there, the road to the palace should stay open.
strings.157_base_palace_more_9: Look here... I brought a map to explain it.
strings.157_base_palace_pay_2: Give me a day or two. I'll come to your house when I have news.
strings.157_base_palace_pay_4: Nice, right? Only for our best customers.
strings.157_base_palace_pay_5: Gunter even suggested that we offer every fifth looting for free.
strings.157_base_palace_pay_6: Yeah, that sounds like something Gunther would come up with.
strings.158_astrologer_palace_help_10: But things could get much worse at any moment.
strings.158_astrologer_palace_help_11: We need to restore balance to the world.
strings.158_astrologer_palace_help_13: Well, a fairy and an ancient goddess of nature wouldn't lie!
strings.158_astrologer_palace_help_15: Who knows what the ancient gods would or wouldn't do.
strings.158_astrologer_palace_help_16: Maybe... but if you help me, we can all ask the magic portal for a wish.
strings.158_astrologer_palace_help_17: You should've started with that. What do we need to do?
strings.158_astrologer_palace_help_18: I just need you to stand beside me when I place the last fragment for the portal.
strings.158_astrologer_palace_help_19: That's not a problem, right Jack?
strings.158_astrologer_palace_help_2: My friends... I need to ask you something important.
strings.158_astrologer_palace_help_20: But the last fragment is in the Palace... and I'll have to fight my way there.
strings.158_astrologer_palace_help_21: Even with my factory and all my resources, I'll need every bit of help I can get.
strings.158_astrologer_palace_help_22: It's no problem, Gunter. The portal is right behind the wall. We'll be there when the time comes.
strings.158_astrologer_palace_help_23: And I might have something that will help you get that last fragment.
strings.158_astrologer_palace_help_25: It's a blueprint for an automatic bow system. I never had enough resources to build a prototype.
strings.158_astrologer_palace_help_26: But I bet you could make plenty of them.
strings.158_astrologer_palace_help_3: We've been through a lot together. We've built a lot...
strings.158_astrologer_palace_help_4: But it could all be for nothing, unless you help me save the world.
strings.158_astrologer_palace_help_5: What's happening to the world, mate?
strings.158_astrologer_palace_help_6: Well... zombies are flooding the Town, the days of the week are changing places...
strings.158_astrologer_palace_help_7: I thought we reached a comfortable balance with the zombies.
strings.158_astrologer_palace_help_8: And the strange calendar? It's just funny pictures. I'm already used to it.
strings.158_astrologer_palace_help_9: Yeah, yeah... I know. I got used to it too...
strings.158_astrologer_palace_press_2: I made this one simple to operate, Gunter.
strings.158_astrologer_palace_press_3: Don't worry. Jack will help me figure it out.
strings.158_astrologer_palace_press_4: The first thing I'm printing is the news that I finally have a printing press!
strings.158_astrologer_palace_prothesis_2: Now this is exactly the prosthetic I needed!
strings.158_astrologer_palace_prothesis_3: I'm glad I could help with your project.
strings.159_crossroad_palace_device_2: I tested it, and surprisingly — it works!
strings.159_crossroad_palace_device_3: That's because you're a good person... the gods' favorite Keeper.
strings.159_crossroad_palace_help_10: No, this is real. I need to complete the magic portal, stop the zombies, and help the Old God.
strings.159_crossroad_palace_help_11: Shame on you... that sounds like old beliefs and superstitions.
strings.159_crossroad_palace_help_12: You know, Agatha... the Keeper has earned my trust.
strings.159_crossroad_palace_help_13: You'll easily see it's all true... and if you help me, you can each ask the portal for a wish.
strings.159_crossroad_palace_help_14: We already have everything we need... but Herbert is right. You've earned our trust. We'll help you.
strings.159_crossroad_palace_help_15: What do we need to do?
strings.159_crossroad_palace_help_16: Stand beside me when I gather all the portal fragments.
strings.159_crossroad_palace_help_17: I'll assemble them at the Astrologer's house by the port.
strings.159_crossroad_palace_help_18: I don't much like that fellow... but we'll be there.
strings.159_crossroad_palace_help_19: Thank you. The trouble is, the final fragment is in the Palace... and I'll have to fight my way in.
strings.159_crossroad_palace_help_2: I know you've finally found some peace.
strings.159_crossroad_palace_help_20: With all the faith and blessings in the world... plus my army... I'll still need your help to succeed.
strings.159_crossroad_palace_help_21: But what can an old nun do?
strings.159_crossroad_palace_help_22: Hmm... I bet the old head of the guard can do something.
strings.159_crossroad_palace_help_23: I'll talk to the quartermaster.  I bet he can find some extra space for your defensive equipment.
strings.159_crossroad_palace_help_24: And the mercenaries owe me a favor... You can use them in this battle.
strings.159_crossroad_palace_help_25: The only thing I have to give you is my blessing, Keeper.
strings.159_crossroad_palace_help_26: Thank you... it means a lot.
strings.159_crossroad_palace_help_3: You've fought enough battles in your life.
strings.159_crossroad_palace_help_4: But all of it could be meaningless, unless you help me save the world.
strings.159_crossroad_palace_help_5: I know my prayers aren't enough... I'll have to teach Herbert how to pray properly!
strings.159_crossroad_palace_help_6: Prayers may help... but this is bigger than that. The very foundation of the world is in danger.
strings.159_crossroad_palace_help_7: And I'm the only one who can save it... with your help, of course.
strings.159_crossroad_palace_help_8: Oh, I see what this is. He's rehearsing the dramatic part from his trilogy.
strings.159_crossroad_palace_help_9: He's not bad, I have to admit. Very heroic tone.
strings.159_crossroad_palace_trilogy_2: Wow, they look amazing. I bet they're very exciting.
strings.159_crossroad_palace_trilogy_3: You're right, Herbert... great books always have great covers.
strings.15_guards_fightback_lose_1: Something went wrong. We couldn't take them. This time.
strings.15_guards_fightback_lose_2: Can't say I'm surprised... But you're free to keep trying.
strings.15_guards_fightback_lose_3: Usually, we only assemble our defense lines once a week. After the bell rings.
strings.15_guards_fightback_lose_4: But this area near the gate is always secure.
strings.15_guards_fightback_lose_5: You can try again when you're ready.
strings.15_guards_fightback_win_1: Well well... I wish I could say you did  good job...
strings.15_guards_fightback_win_10: I'll check the perimeter and assign more guards.
strings.15_guards_fightback_win_12: Alright... time to open the zone and push toward the port.
strings.15_guards_fightback_win_3: There was no hope for us before.
strings.15_guards_fightback_win_4: There was nothing left to defend... at least, that's how it felt.
strings.15_guards_fightback_win_5: But now... I have this strange feeling... Hope.
strings.15_guards_fightback_win_6: That actually sounds kind of... good?
strings.15_guards_fightback_win_7: Heh... I was supposed to retire the week all this started.
strings.15_guards_fightback_win_8: But now? There's no peace, no quiet, and definitely no time for reading a good book.
strings.15_guards_fightback_win_9: Anyway... it's your call now. Use what we took by sword, and secure this area.
strings.160_linda_palace_bottles_2: Keeper, you've become a true craftsman. These bottles are truly elegant.
strings.160_linda_palace_bottles_3: I'm glad they meet your standards, Albert.
strings.160_linda_palace_chocolate_2: Mmm... it smells wonderful. I can't wait to try it with Albert.
strings.160_linda_palace_chocolate_3: I'm sure you'll both enjoy it.
strings.160_linda_palace_help_10: I'm close to repairing that portal, but I still need to activate it.
strings.160_linda_palace_help_11: For it to work, the two of you must stand beside me.
strings.160_linda_palace_help_12: I don't get it... Are we going to travel somewhere through it?
strings.160_linda_palace_help_13: No, the magic portal grants wishes... we'll all ask for one.
strings.160_linda_palace_help_14: Pardon me, but I thought the main purpose of a portal was traveling.
strings.160_linda_palace_help_15: It's a rather strange for such an object to be granting wishes.
strings.160_linda_palace_help_16: Albert, don't be so skeptical. You could ask the portal for a cure for Aleksta.
strings.160_linda_palace_help_17: Ah... you're right. Portal or not, we'll help you.
strings.160_linda_palace_help_18: But the last fragment is in the Palace, and I'll have to fight my way there.
strings.160_linda_palace_help_19: Even with an army of my best zombies, I don't have enough strength to win that battle.
strings.160_linda_palace_help_2: Linda, Albert... I have something important to ask.
strings.160_linda_palace_help_20: Say no more. In my research, I happened across a potion formula.
strings.160_linda_palace_help_21: It makes zombie skin much stronger. It should help you.
strings.160_linda_palace_help_22: That's wonderful work, Albert. As for me, all I have is a recipe that greatly boosts endurance.
strings.160_linda_palace_help_23: I've taken it many times myself.
strings.160_linda_palace_help_24: Thank you. Now I feel much more prepared.
strings.160_linda_palace_help_3: Just when you've finally found happiness together, the whole world may be in danger.
strings.160_linda_palace_help_4: The world is teetering on the edge of non-existence...
strings.160_linda_palace_help_5: Oh no... I knew things were too good to be true.
strings.160_linda_palace_help_6: Did you hear that, Linda? Apparently, the end of the world has terrible timing.
strings.160_linda_palace_help_7: Let him talk, Albert. The Keeper probably has a plan.
strings.160_linda_palace_help_8: That's right. Everything that's happening... the zombie problem and all of it...
strings.160_linda_palace_help_9: It all started because of the previous Keeper and a magic portal.
strings.161_base_survey_10: Of course, you just get stuff like this handed to you... If only I had a table like that when I was young and curious.
strings.161_base_survey_1_a: So what was this laboratory used for?
strings.161_base_survey_1_b: So what was the laboratory upstairs used for?
strings.161_base_survey_2: Misguided inquisitor alchemy, I guess... cough-cough
strings.161_base_survey_3: Not much left now... except that table in the middle.
strings.161_base_survey_4: Oh... and of course they left behind the most valuable equipment.
strings.161_base_survey_5: It’s a Survey Table... you use it to learn things about items.
strings.161_base_survey_6: That knowledge is supposed to enrich your understanding of the world... cough-cough.
strings.161_base_survey_7: Wait... any item can give me knowledge?
strings.161_base_survey_8: Well, in your case I couldn't be sure... but in general, yes. It can even show some of an item's alchemy properties.
strings.161_base_survey_9: Seems like a very important table. I’ll get a lot of use out of it.
strings.162_village_pardon_ask: Go Wild in the Wild Lands
strings.162_village_pardon_get_2: To receive a Royal Pardon, you must first commit a minor crime.
strings.162_village_pardon_get_4: Minor crime detected... damage to Royal property.
strings.162_village_pardon_get_5: Pay the fine to receive a Royal Pardon.
strings.162_village_pardon_pay_2: Fine paid. Thank you for your cooperation.
strings.162_village_pardon_pay_3: Royal box is out of black ink.
strings.163_village_fish_3: Honestly, they look pretty unappetizing to me.
strings.163_village_fish_4: Nonsense... you just need to know how to cook them!
strings.163_village_fish_5: Here... try these recipes. Might change your mind.
strings.164_base_alchemy_chest_1: Ha ha... go on, take a look. I bet it's just what you need.
strings.164_base_alchemy_insanity_1: I couldn’t help noticing that little spark of madness in your eyes.
strings.164_base_alchemy_insanity_2: You think so? You are a talking skull, after all... Are you even real?
strings.164_base_alchemy_insanity_4: I'm just saying you need some ways to relax... try some good food, drink some wine.
strings.164_base_alchemy_insanity_5: Heh... maybe you’re right, Larry... I do like this new life...
strings.164_base_alchemy_insanity_6: It’s just... sometimes what I have to do feels a little too strange.
strings.164_base_alchemy_intro_1: Funny how the dust recipe turned out to be the easiest one.
strings.164_base_alchemy_intro_2: Yeah... except I have no idea where to get those ingredients.
strings.164_base_alchemy_intro_3: Hmm... you see that chest over there? Maybe it already has everything you need.
strings.164_base_alchemy_intro_4: Yeah, sure... because life is always so convenient.
strings.164_base_alchemy_intro_5: You’d be surprised... Sometimes it is — especially for desperate Keepers.
strings.165_base_donkey1_1: So, I see you’re doing pretty well helping the Town.
strings.165_base_donkey1_10: Yeah, yeah... I’m just a humble donkey trying to earn a carrot.
strings.165_base_donkey1_2: Yeah... those people need someone to look after them.
strings.165_base_donkey1_3: And naturally, that someone is you.
strings.165_base_donkey1_4: It's nice to feel like I'm needed... you know?
strings.165_base_donkey1_5: Yeah, yeah... but do they actually need your help?
strings.165_base_donkey1_7: I’m not so sure... those capitalist bastards got exactly what they deserved.
strings.165_base_donkey1_8: They did everything they could to drag the town into chaos.
strings.165_base_donkey1_9: Hey, I thought you moved past all that.
strings.166_base_donkey2_1: Three carrots a day, Comrade Donkey, one two okay!
strings.166_base_donkey2_11: They don't make anything. The town is full of traders and shops... nothing but buying and selling.
strings.166_base_donkey2_12: But I get it... the worse the people — the better the corpses!
strings.166_base_donkey2_13: Hmm... I guess that’s one way to look at it.
strings.166_base_donkey2_14: Don’t worry about it. We’re all doing just fine.
strings.166_base_donkey2_3: Good to see you in such a good mood.
strings.166_base_donkey2_4: You know, Larry isn't half bad... not as good as the last skull, but still.
strings.166_base_donkey2_5: I taught him how to drink. Ha ha...
strings.166_base_donkey2_6: And we scared the life out of the Nun...
strings.166_base_donkey2_7: Larry was riding me, and we were singing songs... ha ha.
strings.166_base_donkey2_8: I guess it’s good you're having a good time. If it doesn't affect your job, of course.
strings.166_base_donkey2_9: Hey... who makes all the beer we drink? Who's the one spoiling the town?
strings.167_base_donkey3_1: How goes the day, master of the Town?
strings.167_base_donkey3_11: Anyway, it’s a fine day for a donkey to work for your monopoly.
strings.167_base_donkey3_2: Me? I’m just a humble Graveyard Keeper.
strings.167_base_donkey3_3: Yeah... who happens to own the town.
strings.167_base_donkey3_4: Without you, this place would fall apart.
strings.167_base_donkey3_5: You’re being dramatic... They have a Town Head and... other important people.
strings.167_base_donkey3_6: Ha ha... still, a dark hat and a red eye would suit you nicely.
strings.167_base_donkey3_8: There was one guy a long time ago who did everything for these people.
strings.16_foreman_letter_foreman_11: Yeah... one more... for my friend.
strings.16_foreman_letter_foreman_15: Where was I... Ah yes, I met an absolutely brilliant man of science.
strings.16_foreman_letter_foreman_17: And oddly enough, he seemed to know quite a bit about someone...
strings.16_foreman_letter_foreman_18: Who resembles you quite closely... Very strange...
strings.16_foreman_letter_foreman_19: He also shared a recipe with me, for a bell.
strings.16_foreman_letter_foreman_20: Instructions enclosed on how to build and use the bell.
strings.16_foreman_letter_foreman_22: It should help you fight off the zombies and clear out the port district.
strings.16_foreman_letter_foreman_22_1: So how exactly is this thing supposed to work?
strings.16_foreman_letter_foreman_22_2: The sound of such a bell is like an order for zombies to withdraw and return to the center of the Town.
strings.16_foreman_letter_foreman_22_3: Oh! Like they withdraw on <sprite name="day_sloth"> morning, when the bell rings.
strings.16_foreman_letter_foreman_22_4: This bell is like that one, just smaller.
strings.16_foreman_letter_foreman_22_5: So it's not just any bell... It's supposed to be magic.
strings.16_foreman_letter_foreman_23: P.S. There's no materials here. The warehouse is in the zombie part of the port.
strings.16_foreman_letter_foreman_24: We'll get to it as soon as you retake the port.
strings.16_foreman_letter_foreman_25: P.S.S. Please avoid using the boat until we've recovered the warehouse....
strings.16_foreman_letter_foreman_3: To begin with, I have to tell you — the material you provided...
strings.16_foreman_letter_foreman_6: This is the sole reason for the poor seaworthiness of the boat I built.
strings.16_foreman_letter_foreman_7: Therefore, I'm not risking my way back by sea...
strings.16_foreman_letter_foreman_8: My place on the boat will be taken by the Nun.
strings.16_foreman_letter_foreman_9: She promised to help boost your morale.
strings.16_foreman_letter_plan_1: Did you get any of that?
strings.16_foreman_letter_plan_2: Yeah, easy. First meet the Nun at the village tavern.
strings.16_foreman_letter_plan_3: Second, get to the port district through the town full of zombies.
strings.16_foreman_letter_plan_6: That's not clear for now, but keep that recipe ready.
strings.16_foreman_letter_plan_7: When life gives you a recipe for a magic bell, you'll probably need one soon enough.
strings.16_foreman_letter_twins_4: We're back from port. And we got a Nun.
strings.16_foreman_letter_twins_8: The Nun at the tavern... she's waiting for you.
strings.17_village_nun_meeting_1: Hi, I'm the local Graveyard Keeper. I heard you were looking for me.
strings.17_village_nun_meeting_10: Here... take this book: "So You Decided to Decorate Your Church."
strings.17_village_nun_meeting_13: Now go! Decorate the church so I can perform a ceremony!
strings.17_village_nun_meeting_14: I'll come by every <sprite name="day_wrath"> to check your progress.
strings.17_village_nun_meeting_15: Once everything's ready, I'll perform the first ceremony myself.
strings.17_village_nun_meeting_16: Try to get out of it
strings.17_village_nun_meeting_17: And why exactly should I help you and sort out the church?
strings.17_village_nun_meeting_2: I heard you're also an Inquisitor. Is that true?
strings.17_village_nun_meeting_22: Holy signs shall visit upon you...
strings.17_village_nun_meeting_3: Yes... Yes I am. I have a medallion and everything.
strings.17_village_nun_meeting_4: Excellent! At last, someone who can burn all those heretics!
strings.17_village_nun_meeting_6: Have you finished repairing the old temple for me?
strings.17_village_nun_meeting_8: Uh... I'm still kind of in the middle of the process...
strings.17_village_nun_meeting_9: Don't lie to me! You know nothing of temples!
strings.17_village_nun_tavern_2: I'm here to talk to the Nun.
strings.17_village_nun_tavern_3: Could you please hurry up and do whatever she asks?
strings.17_village_nun_tavern_4: The sooner we get her out of the tavern, the better.
strings.17_village_nun_tavern_5: I mean... she's scaring away all my customers!
strings.17_village_nun_tavern_6: I'll see what I can do...
strings.18_doctor_after_all_3: I kinda like it down here!
strings.18_doctor_after_all_4: Guess I got used to dark, underground places...
strings.18_doctor_after_all_6: Also, my nose is itching... just like the first time they brought you to the dungeon!
strings.18_doctor_after_all_7: We definitely need to get rid of this blockage and explore deeper.
