strings.18_doctor_after_all_8: And by we, I mostly mean you!
strings.18_doctor_after_all_9: So I'll wait upstairs while you... deal with that mess.
strings.18_doctor_basement_first_1: Wow, our very own dungeon! How cool is that?!
strings.18_doctor_basement_first_2: You know... I have some bad memories about dungeons.
strings.18_doctor_basement_first_4: I think it's actually a pretty big one. Maybe even connects different places underground.
strings.18_doctor_basement_first_5: It might even be linked to the town sewers.
strings.18_doctor_basement_first_6: Can you imagine how many interesting things might be hidden in the dungeon of a mysterious Inquisitor's base?
strings.18_doctor_basement_first_7: Hmm... maybe you're right. This basement could be useful.
strings.18_doctor_encounter_first_10: I fear I shall never escape this heavy burden.
strings.18_doctor_encounter_first_2: I'll never find a way inside the tower...
strings.18_doctor_encounter_first_5: I thought you peasants were afraid of dungeons.
strings.18_doctor_encounter_first_6: Hey, I'm not a peasant. I'm the Graveyard Keeper...
strings.18_doctor_encounter_first_8: And actually this is my dungeon!
strings.18_doctor_guessing_correctly_3: But my guess — the Plague Doctor.
strings.18_doctor_guessing_correctly_4: And I've got business with him.
strings.19_base_ceremony_church_2: Feel free, like I'm not even here...
strings.19_base_ceremony_church_3: But know that I'm still watching you!
strings.19_base_ceremony_next_4: You need to get to the people in the port.
strings.19_base_ceremony_next_5: Reach out to them... make them happy... and your ceremonies will...
strings.19_base_ceremony_next_7: I'll be at the crossroads near the Town Wall, awaiting my new prophecy.
strings.19_base_ceremony_next_8: You'll have to support me with writing supplies and paper!
strings.19_base_ceremony_next_9: I shall have to write down all my holy experiences.
strings.19_base_ceremony_ready_10: I can't... You'll have to manage. You're an Inquisitor, right?
strings.19_base_ceremony_ready_12: That's practically a priest. Besides, the locals trust you more!
strings.19_base_ceremony_ready_13: That's very important. In places like this we practically convert trust into Faith... and money!
strings.19_base_ceremony_ready_14: But I've never done anything like this...
strings.19_base_ceremony_ready_15: Just say a few words. The vibe of the place will do all the work!
strings.19_base_ceremony_ready_16: By the way... did your Inquisition provide you a ceremony license?
strings.19_base_ceremony_ready_18: How in blazes?! Ok, let's calm down... Today I'll stick around.
strings.19_base_ceremony_ready_19: But next time don't even think of preaching without a license!
strings.19_base_ceremony_ready_6: It definitely was. A holy sign, and not the first one.
strings.19_base_ceremony_ready_8: I must hurry to the crossroads! That is my place.
strings.1_intro_prison_brake_1: The chains won't let me move.
strings.1_intro_prison_brake_11: Great job! What determination! Now get me outta this sarcophagus.
strings.1_intro_prison_brake_5: Well... just keep at it. You've been pulling at them for years.
strings.1_intro_prison_brake_6: The second one feels stronger though.
strings.1_intro_prison_brake_6_1: Those fairies, I never trust them...
strings.1_intro_prison_brake_7: Come on, don't give up that easily!
strings.1_intro_prison_brake_9: I have a feeling you're almost there!
strings.1_intro_prison_door_1: Looks like I need a key.
strings.1_intro_prison_door_2: Better bring everything from the chest.
strings.1_intro_prison_door_3: Try to look natural. We don't want to draw any unwanted attention.
strings.1_intro_prison_door_4: Between an escaped convict and a floating skull, you'll be the one drawing attention.
strings.1_intro_prison_door_5: I don't know what happened, and I don't want to stick around and find out.
strings.1_intro_prison_new_zone_1: Isn't a prison supposed to have guards?
strings.1_intro_prison_new_zone_10: That's what we need to open a door! Grab the lot!
strings.1_intro_prison_new_zone_2: Yeah, yeah — let's complain about how this isn't hard enough.
strings.1_intro_prison_new_zone_4: So what was in the stash?
strings.1_intro_prison_sarcophage_1: This pickaxe will do the job.
strings.1_intro_prison_sarcophage_10: I hate to break it to you, but you're a...
strings.1_intro_prison_sarcophage_11: Yes... I might be a skull, but I bet we'll be best friends.
strings.1_intro_prison_sarcophage_11_CORRECT: A talking skull?! No way, that's impossible.
strings.1_intro_prison_sarcophage_14: Thanks for getting me outta that can.
strings.1_intro_prison_sarcophage_15: I got a feeling we're gonna be best buddies. Ha ha.
strings.1_intro_prison_sarcophage_1_inventory: To open my inventory, I need to press .
strings.1_intro_prison_sarcophage_2: I need something to open it with.
strings.1_intro_prison_sarcophage_3: I guess I need to equip the pickaxe first.
strings.1_intro_prison_sarcophage_5: You're probably too weak and hungry. Do you see any food?
strings.1_intro_prison_sarcophage_6: I think I see some mushrooms.
strings.1_intro_prison_sarcophage_7: Very nutrient rich... and maybe even a little hallucinogenic he he...
strings.1_intro_prison_sarcophage_9: Well did you eat the mushrooms, genius?
strings.1_intro_prison_wake_12: Oh, this is harder than I thought... there's simply not enough faith left in the world...
strings.1_intro_prison_wake_13: I won't be able to break the second chain...
strings.1_intro_prison_wake_14: Well then, looks like saving the world will have to wait.
strings.1_intro_prison_wake_15: This is no joke... Time is short... Summon me as soon as you can...
strings.1_intro_prison_wake_16: Hey pal... Are you back? And conscious?
strings.1_intro_prison_wake_18_a_1: Larry. Nice to meet you. We've been roommates for nearly a decade... he he.
strings.1_intro_prison_wake_18_b_1: A five-star Inquisitor dungeon — where torturing is maintained at an exquisite standard.
strings.1_intro_prison_wake_19: I don't remember... Do I know you?
strings.1_intro_prison_wake_20: We've never had a chance to talk. You're always in the middle of being tortured...
strings.1_intro_prison_wake_21: Or unconscious... since the Inquisitors packed up and left...
strings.1_intro_prison_wake_22: But never mind all that... Now that the fairy helped you, we might actually have a chance!
strings.1_intro_prison_wake_4: Where am I? Who are you?
strings.1_intro_prison_wake_5: You can call me Soul... and it's time for you to step forward!
strings.1_intro_prison_wake_6: It took you eight years to ruin this world... Now it's your destiny to save it.
strings.1_intro_prison_wake_7: Sounds kind of... debatable... anyway, looks like I'm all chained up here.
strings.1_intro_prison_wake_8: I'll set you free, but you have to save us all. Do you promise?
strings.20_doctor_meeting_door_3: You got your sword with you? Let's jump him!
strings.20_doctor_meeting_door_4: First — yes. Second — no. We'll be polite.
strings.20_doctor_meeting_door_knocking_5: Sorry to bother you, but we're kind of... neighbors.
strings.20_doctor_meeting_door_knocking_6: So I decided to introduce myself.
strings.20_doctor_meeting_door_knocking_7: Hey, anybody know how to make a facepalm without any hands?
strings.20_doctor_meeting_door_open_1: It seems that someone has no fear of ancient evil.
strings.20_doctor_meeting_door_open_10: I'm an Inquisitor and now I run this base. You're basically living in my basement.
strings.20_doctor_meeting_door_open_13: No, we haven't. I have a medallion.
strings.20_doctor_meeting_door_open_14: Of course you do. I've been looking for one for years. And you just have one!
strings.20_doctor_meeting_door_open_16: We must get into the tower at... your base.
strings.20_doctor_meeting_door_open_17: To open the gate, you need... a medallion and a secret combination.
strings.20_doctor_meeting_door_open_18: And as circumstance would have it... I possess the combination.
strings.20_doctor_meeting_door_open_19: And I have the medallion. So...
strings.20_doctor_meeting_door_open_20: But I don't see why I should just...
strings.20_doctor_meeting_door_open_21: Why?! Are you nuts? A secret tower in an Inquisitor base?!
strings.20_doctor_meeting_door_open_24: I'm not even surprised anymore. You just have everything... An Inquisitor base...
strings.20_doctor_meeting_door_open_27: Just open the damn tower, and open the damn hatch so I can get in...
strings.20_doctor_meeting_door_open_4: Then what need have you of a doctor?
strings.20_doctor_meeting_door_open_6: Yeah, right... So I need you to tell me how to make Dream Dust!
strings.20_doctor_meeting_door_open_7: Dream Dust... is a most complicated substance...
strings.20_doctor_meeting_door_open_8: But I see no reason to tell you anything!
strings.20_doctor_meeting_footprints_1: Heh heh... See? That wasn't so hard.
strings.20_doctor_meeting_footprints_3: No, I don't see anything. Are you sure?
strings.20_doctor_meeting_footprints_4: Of course! You can't make out anything from that height.
strings.20_doctor_meeting_footprints_6: The guy with the long nose probably left them.
strings.21_base_donkey_1: Excuse me... but we may have a problem.
strings.21_base_donkey_3: The Nun said that... a filthy animal like me can't desecrate a holy place.
strings.21_base_donkey_4: She... she said she'd send me to the slaughter house once she takes over.
strings.21_base_donkey_5: Come on... She seems like a nice lady. She was probably just joking.
strings.21_base_donkey_6: I don't know... Larry seems to think otherwise.
strings.21_base_donkey_7: Then maybe you should ask Larry for help instead of me.
strings.22_doctor_tower_asking_10: I need to summon a fairy.
strings.22_doctor_tower_asking_12: Please bring the powder to me when it's ready...
strings.22_doctor_tower_asking_13: I'll check it, and give you a few... precautionary tips.
strings.22_doctor_tower_asking_14: Unless you're okay with summoning something much more hairy than fairy...
strings.22_doctor_tower_asking_16: Yeah... Still can't believe your luck...
strings.22_doctor_tower_asking_17: You know, despite first impressions, I'm beginning to like that guy.
strings.22_doctor_tower_asking_18: Only because he called you a cool skull.
strings.22_doctor_tower_asking_2: You know, I'm really starting to question your luck...
strings.22_doctor_tower_asking_4: You specifically needed this exact sort of laboratory to make Dream Dust.
strings.22_doctor_tower_asking_5: Heh... I guess I'm his lucky skull.
strings.22_doctor_tower_asking_7: And my notes on basic alchemy.
strings.22_doctor_tower_asking_9: And why, may I ask, do you need this powder?
strings.22_doctor_tower_entering_1: Let's see what we have here...
strings.22_doctor_tower_entering_4: But if you find a book with a screaming skull on the cover...
strings.22_doctor_tower_entering_5: I'd love to take a peek.
strings.22_doctor_tower_entering_7: Okay, let's let our sickly friend in...
strings.22_doctor_tower_hatch_opening_2: Where the sard are all the books?! Where's the library?
strings.22_doctor_tower_hatch_opening_5: Don't know what you were expecting.
strings.22_doctor_tower_hatch_opening_6: But this place looks kinda cool.
strings.22_doctor_tower_hatch_opening_7: What's cool about an abandoned alchemy laboratory?!
strings.22_doctor_tower_hatch_opening_8: Okay, okay... I'll start from the beginning...
strings.22_doctor_tower_opening_2: Seriously, pal, what is going on?!
strings.22_doctor_tower_opening_4: Whining and complaining — with Larry... Exploring a cool tower — without Larry!
strings.23_guards_mercenaries_meeting_2: Greetings! We've come to this town to provide our services.
strings.23_guards_mercenaries_meeting_3: We will fight for you. For a fee, of course.
strings.23_guards_mercenaries_meeting_4: Each fight requires payment up front.
strings.23_guards_mercenaries_meeting_5: And the harder it is, the bigger the payment.
strings.23_guards_mercenaries_meeting_6: How about some kind of free trial?
strings.23_guards_mercenaries_meeting_7: I wish I could help you with that, but alas, I cannot agree.
strings.23_guards_mercenaries_pay_2: Can I hire you for the next battle?
strings.24_doctor_zombies_asking_10: In this case, you're lucky... You can mix everything in your kitchen.
strings.24_doctor_zombies_asking_11: Just... mix? No magic rituals or ancient words?
strings.24_doctor_zombies_asking_13: Oh wait... You need to mix everything with a feather from a comet's tail.
strings.24_doctor_zombies_asking_14: A feather from... a comet's tail?!
strings.24_doctor_zombies_asking_15: Yes. There's an astrologer in the port area. He's got plenty.
strings.24_doctor_zombies_asking_16: Sells them for a fair price. Sailors love them. Very popular.
strings.24_doctor_zombies_asking_18: But... comets are celestial bodies. They don't have feathers.
strings.24_doctor_zombies_asking_19: Oh yeah? Then how is he selling them?
strings.24_doctor_zombies_asking_22: Is that a pair of zombies?
strings.24_doctor_zombies_asking_23: Yes. Do you have a better explanation for two rotting people nonchalantly walking around?
strings.24_doctor_zombies_asking_24: No... but they look pretty peaceful.
strings.24_doctor_zombies_asking_25: Yes. Peaceful, but useless. Although they're good for dumb labor.
strings.24_doctor_zombies_asking_26: Unfortunately, for the most part they just make more mess than progress.
strings.24_doctor_zombies_asking_27: Hey, this might also sound dumb... But would you like to take them?
strings.24_doctor_zombies_asking_29: Heck no! They can work for you.
strings.24_doctor_zombies_asking_30: Oh... an extra set of hands. I like it. Got any more?
strings.24_doctor_zombies_asking_31: Nope. The astrologer from the port sold them to me.
strings.24_doctor_zombies_asking_32: Told me they're very old and "very special."
strings.24_doctor_zombies_asking_34: I'm definitely paying the Astronomer a visit.
strings.24_doctor_zombies_asking_35: One more reason to make my way to the port.
strings.24_doctor_zombies_asking_36: You should also pay a visit to that blocked room beside your morgue...
strings.24_doctor_zombies_asking_37: The inquisitors, it would appear, were once in there dabbling in resurrection.
strings.24_doctor_zombies_asking_6: Ah yes, of course... you're right, I'm wrong.
strings.24_doctor_zombies_asking_9: So how exactly do I use this stuff to summon a fairy?
strings.24_doctor_zombies_hatch_1: I don't want to give this guy another reason to be mean.
strings.24_doctor_zombies_showing_3: Hmm... Dream Dust should be a different color.
strings.24_doctor_zombies_showing_4: But I followed the recipe exactly.
strings.25_village_watchmen_1_1: I see you've got an axe.
strings.25_village_watchmen_1_4: Very well equipped. But don't even think about using them here — it's forbidden!
strings.25_village_watchmen_2_1: Do you know where the zombies come from?
strings.25_village_watchmen_2_2: I think you turn into one if they bite you.
strings.25_village_watchmen_2_3: But who bit the first one?
strings.25_village_watchmen_2_5: What if a stork brought somebody a zombie instead of a baby?
strings.25_village_watchmen_3_1: Psst. Is that the guy who got the supplies?
strings.25_village_watchmen_3_3: Nah. We don't want him getting a big head and acting funny.
strings.25_village_watchmen_4_1: That Nun gives me the heebie-jeebies...
strings.25_village_watchmen_4_2: I just try not to look her in the eyes.
strings.25_village_watchmen_4_3: I try not to look at all.
strings.25_village_watchmen_4_4: Please tell me she's not behind me right now.
strings.25_village_watchmen_5_1: Sooo... what's up with this weather?
strings.25_village_watchmen_5_3: I'm just trying to have a conversation here.
strings.25_village_watchmen_6_1: What's your favorite kind of meat?
strings.26_port_foreman_14: Ahhh, boy am I glad to see you!
strings.26_port_foreman_16: ... Anyway, I never doubted you for a second.
strings.26_port_foreman_18: Do you know where I can find the Astrologer?
strings.26_port_foreman_19: Oh yeah, he's the one who told me about the bell!
strings.26_port_foreman_2: YOU! Over there on the other side!
strings.26_port_foreman_20: He should be at his observatory...
strings.26_port_foreman_21: It's a tower attached to a... foot.
strings.26_port_foreman_23: You'll understand when you see it.
strings.26_port_foreman_24: Ok, I've been waiting sooo long...
strings.26_port_foreman_25: Finally, I can go see what we have at the warehouse!
strings.26_port_foreman_26: I just need to figure out this door... Hmm... What do we have here...
strings.26_port_foreman_demo_11: Nothing new... I’ll keep bringing you corpses...
strings.26_port_foreman_demo_13: You should be pretty familiar with the routine by now.
strings.26_port_foreman_demo_15: So there’s nothing left to do?
strings.26_port_foreman_demo_18: But I'm not telling you anything new.
strings.26_port_foreman_demo_20: So there’s nothing left to do?
strings.26_port_foreman_demo_6: Trying to get to the other side is pointless.
strings.26_port_foreman_demo_7: But what about saving the Town? I wanted to be a real hero.
strings.26_port_foreman_demo_8: You know... everything comes at a price...
strings.27_port_astrologer_cards_2: I brought you your deck, Astrologer.
strings.27_port_astrologer_cards_3: Oh, thank you so much. Now my predictions will be accurate again!
strings.27_port_astrologer_cards_4: I'd also like to see your next ceremony.
strings.27_port_astrologer_cards_5: Sharing knowledge is always good in our line of work.
strings.27_port_astrologer_meeting_1: Holy... it's you... you actually found me...
strings.27_port_astrologer_meeting_2: Yeah. I need a word with you.
strings.27_port_astrologer_meeting_3: Hey, that's a weird way to greet your customers, you know.
strings.27_port_astrologer_meeting_5: I'm the Graveyard Keeper. New in town.
strings.27_port_astrologer_meeting_6: New? Hmm... sorry about all that. You just remind me of an old friend...
strings.27_port_astrologer_meeting_7: I am the Mysterious Guntarius... but you can call me Gunter.
strings.27_port_astrologer_meeting_9_a_1: I need something called a comet's tail... whatever people mean by that.
strings.27_port_astrologer_meeting_9_a_2: Ah, the tail of a comet! Have you seen one blaze through the sky?
strings.27_port_astrologer_meeting_9_a_3: Comets are celestial bodies. They don't have tails you can sell.
strings.27_port_astrologer_meeting_9_a_4: Ah, a fellow astrologer! Excellent. Then you qualify for the guild discount!
strings.27_port_astrologer_meeting_9_b_1: Albert gave me some of his "good" zombies. I need to know how you made them.
strings.27_port_astrologer_meeting_9_b_11: By the way, I found some bottles of smelly goo that came with the zombies.
strings.27_port_astrologer_meeting_9_b_12: It's for sale. Something that smells this awful must be worth a fortune.
strings.27_port_astrologer_meeting_9_b_2: Made them? No, no, I didn't make them...
strings.27_port_astrologer_meeting_9_b_4: I've got three more I can give you.
strings.27_port_astrologer_meeting_9_b_7: As you'd expect, during a zombie plague, house zombies drop in value quite precipitously...
strings.27_port_astrologer_meeting_9_b_8: And you know how to make new ones?
strings.27_port_astrologer_meeting_9_b_9: Kind of... but I'm not prepared to share that secret with just any old Graveyard Keeper.
strings.27_port_astrologer_meeting_9_c_1: So what's this small favor you mentioned?
strings.27_port_astrologer_meeting_9_c_2: That's easy... You need to go to the Broth... I mean, the local restaurant!
strings.27_port_astrologer_meeting_9_c_3: Find Linda and collect my tarot cards.
strings.27_port_astrologer_meeting_9_c_4: Why can't you get them yourself?
strings.27_port_astrologer_meeting_9_c_5: Last time I had to leave in a bit of a rush... to make some astrological observations.
strings.27_port_astrologer_meeting_9_c_6: And I may have forgot to pay my bill...
strings.27_port_astrologer_zombie_10: Whaaaaat? An astrologer trick someone? Unthinkable!
strings.27_port_astrologer_zombie_3: So... I can just take them now?
strings.27_port_astrologer_zombie_6: Relax! I'll deliver them to your place. I know... some alternative routes.
strings.27_port_astrologer_zombie_7: The last thing I need is someone seeing you leading zombies out of my observatory.
strings.27_port_astrologer_zombie_8: You can expect them by morning.
strings.27_port_astrologer_zombie_9: Okay... but don't you dare try to trick me.
strings.27_port_astrologer_zombie_larry_1: It's quite a delivery for you... some gnarly-looking zombies.
strings.27_port_astrologer_zombie_larry_2: I'll put them to use... I'm thinking about taking production in a greener direction.
strings.27_port_astrologer_zombie_larry_4: Just imagine... green zombies doing all the hard work instead of me.
strings.28_base_fairy_1: Ha! I knew it... All that fairy malarkey was a lie!
strings.28_base_fairy_10: Last time you told me I was the one behind the whole zombie thing. — But that's absolutely not true!
strings.28_base_fairy_11: It was you... well, not you, but... you.
strings.28_base_fairy_13: Do you remember your previous life? How you came into this world?
strings.28_base_fairy_14: Kind of... but it was so long ago... Maybe it wasn't real. I don't know.
strings.28_base_fairy_15: Hey! Stop messing with my friend! We've got a pretty happy life here.
strings.28_base_fairy_16: He's got a point. I do like my life here.
strings.28_base_fairy_17: That's exactly why the Ancient God split your soul!
strings.28_base_fairy_18: And while you were being dragged to the dungeon and tortured...
strings.28_base_fairy_2: Shouldn't be surprised... How do these people know so much about fairies anyway?
strings.28_base_fairy_20: The other you was out there, destroying everything that was left.
strings.28_base_fairy_20_1: He even destroyed the magic portal... the very core of the world!
strings.28_base_fairy_21: I'm sure he... I mean I... didn't mean it.
strings.28_base_fairy_22: Oh, I'm pretty sure he did. He was pure evil.
strings.28_base_fairy_23: I hope you're not like him. This world needs your help!
strings.28_base_fairy_24_a_1: Come on... I know myself. There were never any evil parts in me.
strings.28_base_fairy_24_a_10: Okay... that stuff definitely sounds like a big mistake.
strings.28_base_fairy_24_a_2: Okay... let's check. He fed people burgers made of the meat of corpses...
strings.28_base_fairy_24_a_4: Sold those burgers to the mob, during a witch burning that he himself helped organize...
strings.28_base_fairy_24_a_6: He also assisted some bloodsucking monsters and dark cultists.
strings.28_base_fairy_24_a_7: Okay, that is looking pretty evil... even for me.
strings.28_base_fairy_24_a_9: He created the first zombie... and used a magic portal for his own gain.
strings.28_base_fairy_24_b_1: So this whole zombie thing... You know how it started?
strings.28_base_fairy_24_b_10: I believe it's your other friend... the donkey... who knows how to resurrect zombies..
strings.28_base_fairy_24_b_11: You just need those shiny crystals, to prevent the Ancient God's magic from corrupting the strong ones.
strings.28_base_fairy_24_b_13: That's easy... They grow at my place — the Nature Goddess's temple at the lake. Although... now it's a swamp.
strings.28_base_fairy_24_b_2: I'm just a fairy, I'm not all-knowing. But I'm pretty sure the Evil Keeper started it.
strings.28_base_fairy_24_b_3: Can I make one? They're very helpful.
strings.28_base_fairy_24_b_5: I've got a couple zombies doing work for me around the house.
strings.28_base_fairy_24_b_7: Whoops. You might be in trouble...
strings.28_base_fairy_24_b_9: Seems like you've got a thing for... skulls... and zombies.
strings.28_base_fairy_24_c_1: So... hypothetically... if I did decide to save the world... what should I do?
strings.28_base_fairy_24_c_2: Hypothetically? The world's collapsing with you on board!
strings.28_base_fairy_24_c_3: Okay, okay... that sounds pretty convincing.
strings.28_base_fairy_24_c_4: You'll need to defeat yourself. Your evil half I mean.
strings.28_base_fairy_24_c_5: Heh... feels like I've been working on that my whole life...
strings.28_base_fairy_24_c_5_1: But most importantly, you must restore the magic portal!
strings.28_base_fairy_24_c_6: I'll need some guidance for this.
strings.28_base_fairy_24_c_7: Wise words. That is why you must travel to the temple of the Nature Goddess, in the swamp.
strings.28_base_fairy_24_c_8: She is weak... but she might answer you.
strings.28_base_fairy_24_c_9: How many temples do you people have around here?
strings.28_base_fairy_25: No more questions! You've got plenty to do.
strings.28_base_fairy_26: I'll be waiting for you... in the swamp!
strings.28_base_fairy_2_1: Well, at least we found some cheese in the cupboard...
strings.28_base_fairy_5: What took you so long? Doing side quests?
strings.28_base_fairy_6: Oh, Mother Nature... What's that skull doing there?
strings.28_base_fairy_8: Really? You have a strange appeal to skulls...
strings.28_base_fairy_9: Anyway... You've taken the first step in saving this world!
strings.29_port_linda_cards_12: Oh! I'd be so grateful! So very grateful...
strings.29_port_linda_cards_13: You manage that, and I'll definitely give you Gunter's deck.
strings.29_port_linda_cards_2: Did you happen to find a deck of tarot cards?
strings.29_port_linda_cards_4: Tell Gunter I'm not giving it back.
strings.29_port_linda_cards_6: Although he did say a hero would come...
strings.29_port_linda_cards_7: So can I get his deck back?
strings.29_port_linda_cards_8: Still... he also predicted that the old shop in the port would open again.
strings.29_port_linda_cards_9: Bringing this town back to life is very important for my... work.
strings.29_port_linda_meeting_2: Oh, of course... of course! Your fame precedes you!
strings.29_port_linda_meeting_3: We've all been waiting for a hero like you.
strings.29_port_linda_meeting_3_1: My name is Linda by the way.
strings.29_port_linda_meeting_6: Tavern? Oh no, it's much more than that...
strings.29_port_linda_meeting_7: We had all kinds of entertainment here, back in the day...
strings.2_intro_scout_bridge_1: Now what? The bridge is blocked.
strings.2_intro_scout_bridge_3: Lets hide in that building with the massive door.
strings.2_intro_scout_cross_the_corner_1: This place looks long abandoned, Larry...
strings.2_intro_scout_cross_the_corner_2: By the way, I never had a chance to ask your name.
strings.2_intro_scout_cross_the_corner_3: I'm not sure... all my memories feel like bad dreams.
strings.2_intro_scout_cross_the_corner_5: That's a good name... I like it.
strings.2_intro_scout_inside_1: Whoa, this is a pretty nice place.
strings.2_intro_scout_inside_2: Yeah. They even have a bed here, and some cheese.
strings.2_intro_scout_inside_3: Must be good cheese if they're even eating it in bed.
strings.2_intro_scout_inside_4: Let's start a fire. There's already a hole in the roof for the smoke.
strings.2_intro_scout_inside_5: No, no we better keep a low profile, at least until we know more.
strings.2_intro_scout_inside_6: Eat your cheese and go to bed. I'll stand guard.
strings.2_intro_scout_inside_7: You can trust your skull friend. He he.
strings.2_intro_scout_inside_8: I just hope nothing falls on me through that hole while I'm sleeping.
strings.2_intro_scout_inside_9: This is a good place — and I do need to rest.
strings.2_intro_scout_living_area_3: We better not follow this street... the gate leads to the palace.
strings.2_intro_scout_living_area_4: And you know what the palace means, right?
strings.2_intro_scout_living_area_7: You're right... we want to avoid any guards...
strings.2_intro_scout_living_area_8: Larry is right, we need to go the other way.
strings.2_intro_scout_new_zone_1: The best way to get lost is blend into the crowd...
strings.2_intro_scout_new_zone_3: We're in it... Well, inside the walls.
strings.2_intro_scout_new_zone_4: Just need to head down from Crown Hill...
strings.2_intro_scout_new_zone_5: Do you mind if I put you in my bag?
strings.2_intro_scout_new_zone_6: It's a bit humiliating... but you're right. A jumping skull might draw some unwanted attention... he he...
strings.2_intro_scout_road_baricade_1: Hm... Looks like they were defending themselves from something...
strings.2_intro_scout_road_baricade_2: Maybe... although everything looks safe enough now.
strings.2_intro_scout_road_baricade_5: So grab an axe... Clear the path.
strings.2_intro_scout_road_baricade_6: Alright, you stupid barricade. Game on!
strings.2_intro_scout_road_baricade_7: Good to see you dispatch such a formidable foe.
strings.2_intro_scout_sewers_1: How did you even get to this part of the Town?
strings.2_intro_scout_sewers_2: Well... I was just wandering around, you know...
strings.2_intro_scout_sewers_4: A guy who sleeps in the most dangerous part of the town...
strings.2_intro_scout_sewers_5: You're something else, you know. What is your name?
strings.2_intro_scout_sewers_6: Umm, it's Keeper.... You can call me Keeper.
strings.2_intro_scout_sewers_7: Anyway, we'll need to hurry for the last bit.
strings.2_intro_scout_sewers_8: Make sure the zombies don't catch you.
strings.2_intro_scout_squer_1: What happened here...? Where is everybody?
strings.2_intro_scout_squer_2: No idea... the place doesn't look like I remember it.
strings.2_intro_scout_squer_3: The fairy told me I ruined everything...
strings.2_intro_scout_squer_4: Don't worry... Looks like things went south while you were busy swinging in chains.
strings.2_intro_scout_squer_6: Anyway, we need to find somewhere quiet and safe to lay low.
strings.2_intro_scout_squer_7: It's quiet here... but it definitely doesn't feel safe.
strings.2_intro_scout_wake_up_11: You've got to demolish the outhouse! Hurry!
strings.2_intro_scout_wake_up_9: Follow me if you want to live!
strings.2_intro_scout_zombie_baricade_1: Hey there's a guy over there.
strings.2_intro_scout_zombie_baricade_10: Did you understand anything he said, Larry?
strings.2_intro_scout_zombie_baricade_11: Not sure. He might have said go left then down.
strings.2_intro_scout_zombie_baricade_12: Or it could have been something about your mother. He he...
strings.2_intro_scout_zombie_baricade_13: How could he be so rude?!
strings.2_intro_scout_zombie_baricade_3: I can't get past this barricade.
strings.30_port_warehouse_1: What happened? Did you find what you needed at the warehouse?
strings.30_port_warehouse_2: No! I was almost finished breaking in... and then this awful man showed up!
strings.30_port_warehouse_4: As I told you, the entirety of the contents technically belongs to the Town...
strings.30_port_warehouse_5: I've lived here my whole life!
strings.30_port_warehouse_6: But as you can see, if you'll allow me...
strings.30_port_warehouse_inside_10: We're the only ones who can get those supplies back.
strings.30_port_warehouse_inside_12: I don't know. I can grow crops, sure... but other resources are pretty limited.
strings.30_port_warehouse_inside_14: There's an old quarry and mine in the forest near the village.
strings.30_port_warehouse_inside_15: Those silly peasants closed off the forest... Gods know why.
strings.30_port_warehouse_inside_16: But I'm sure you'll find a way in.
strings.30_port_warehouse_inside_17: Some iron would be enough for a start...
strings.30_port_warehouse_inside_18: Okay, I'll see what I can do.
strings.30_port_warehouse_inside_19: Why are you doing all this?
strings.30_port_warehouse_inside_20: Why am I so obsessed with supplies and tech?
strings.30_port_warehouse_inside_21: Because that's the only thing that matters.
strings.30_port_warehouse_inside_22: And now... with your help ... I can finally bring science and progress to this world.
strings.30_port_warehouse_inside_26: Because I need a mechanical, fully automated hand, that's why!
strings.30_port_warehouse_inside_4: There's nothing left. I fear we're doomed.
strings.30_port_warehouse_inside_5: The only way to get more supplies is to wait for a new trade ship.
strings.30_port_warehouse_inside_6: And for that, I'll need to make preparations.
strings.30_port_warehouse_inside_7: If anyone wants to help the Town, meet me at the port.
strings.30_port_warehouse_inside_8: If anyone wants to help... blah blah blah...
strings.31_forest_guards_earlier_1: Can't let you go wandering into the forest...
strings.31_forest_guards_entrance_1: Halt! Where do you think you're going?
strings.31_forest_guards_entrance_10: ... for example, the Head of the Village, then I'll let you through.
strings.31_forest_guards_entrance_3: Sorry, can't let you through. Too dangerous.
strings.31_forest_guards_entrance_4: Yeah, it's like, full of goblins.
strings.31_forest_guards_entrance_5: Again with the goblins... Tibo, they don't exist.
strings.31_forest_guards_entrance_6: Then who's stealing all my right socks?!
strings.31_forest_guards_entrance_8: I really need to go into the forest though.
strings.31_forest_guards_entrance_9: If someone from the village vouched for you...
strings.32_guards_book_1: I can't help but notice how grim you are all the time.
strings.32_guards_book_10: Or maybe it's just the fresh air and all the physical activity.
strings.32_guards_book_11: Anyway... is there anything I can do to cheer you up?
strings.32_guards_book_12: Hm... Oh what the heck... Could you get me a love novel?
strings.32_guards_book_13: Yeah. I kept putting it off, and then everything went to hell.
strings.32_guards_book_15: Do you know where I could find one?
strings.32_guards_book_16: In the zombie-infested part of the Town... in my old house.
strings.32_guards_book_17: Right... any idea how I'm supposed to get there?
strings.32_guards_book_19: Maybe the looters' boss at the port tavern could help you.
strings.32_guards_book_20: I'd do it myself... but you know... those novels could ruin my reputation.
strings.32_guards_book_22: Whereas I'm the weirdo who lives in the graveyard.
strings.32_guards_book_3: Seriously, though. I think we're doing good.
strings.32_guards_book_4: Maybe, but... you still have a lot of time ahead of you.
strings.32_guards_book_5: And I'm just old... and looking for a little peace.
strings.32_guards_book_7: In my previous life, I think I wanted that too.
strings.32_guards_book_9: Maybe I found some balance now...
strings.33_base_complain_10: She's ordered... in the name of the Church... that all corpses are to remain with her for a time.
strings.33_base_complain_11: That's... weird. So you're refusing to collect bodies from her?
strings.33_base_complain_13: Any idea why she's doing this?
strings.33_base_complain_14: Of course I... I mean – no! No idea. She's just weird, okay?
strings.33_base_complain_15: Alright, fine. I'll talk to her. Those corpses need to get moving again.
strings.33_base_complain_16: I've got big plans for them.
strings.33_base_complain_18: The fairy from the swamp told me that you know how to resurrect corpses... how to make zombies.
strings.33_base_complain_19: Who, me? That must be some other donkey.
strings.33_base_complain_20: Yeah, sure... there are so many talking donkeys in the graveyard business.
strings.33_base_complain_21: Alright, alright. Maybe I have... a book!  The book may help you.
strings.33_base_complain_22: I've got some problems I need solved. You want the book? Help me out first.
strings.33_base_complain_23: Look who's talking. What if I just fired you? Remember — "Better to have a job than be turned into stew."
strings.33_base_complain_24: Ha! That was a long time ago — before the Town started getting back on its feet.
strings.33_base_complain_25: Nowadays, a clever donkey like me has plenty of options.
strings.33_base_complain_26: Lucky for you... hauling corpses is my true calling!
strings.33_base_complain_27: So, do we have a deal?
strings.33_base_complain_28: Necro....? Ok never mind, it's a deal.
strings.33_base_complain_3: Wait – you? On strike? I thought we were done with your whole commie phase.
strings.33_base_complain_4: Yeah yeah, no more red flags... But this time it's the unbearable working conditions.
strings.33_base_complain_6: That awful, scary woman. – She hates donkeys.
strings.33_base_complain_8: Yes! And now she's staying in the old well house... at  the crossroads.
strings.34_port_looters_first_1: If you're looking for small talk...
strings.34_port_looters_first_2: You definitely got the wrong guy.
strings.34_port_looters_keys_3: What a coincidence, I got your book.
strings.34_port_looters_keys_4: Wow, I didn't think you'd be so fast.
strings.34_port_looters_keys_5: Usually it takes a couple of days.
strings.34_port_looters_keys_6: You bring the keys, place an order, and I leave your item in the chest behind me.
strings.34_port_looters_keys_7: I'm here every <sprite name="day_lust">, collecting new orders.
strings.34_port_looters_meeting_1: I'm looking for the boss of the looters.
strings.34_port_looters_meeting_10: A love novel, actually. A specific book, from a specific house.
strings.34_port_looters_meeting_11: Heh... Now I get it. You know what?
strings.34_port_looters_meeting_13: You don't need the looters. Davy is your man.
strings.34_port_looters_meeting_14: I'll get it for you... in exchange for some swording.
strings.34_port_looters_meeting_16: I admire what you're doing... fighting back the undead.
strings.34_port_looters_meeting_17: I just need you to do it... in specific places.
strings.34_port_looters_meeting_2: Well that's lucky... you found me instead.
strings.34_port_looters_meeting_3: Yeah, that's very nice. But I still need to contact the looters.
strings.34_port_looters_meeting_4: You really don't. You found me... Davy...  Davy the Dagger!
strings.34_port_looters_meeting_6: So, what do you need the looters for?
strings.34_port_looters_meeting_8: But I need something retrieved from the infected part of the Town.
strings.34_port_looters_meeting_9: That is very strange indeed... you need looters to loot something for you...
strings.35_port_pop_new_people_10: Heh. I'll have to pack it with tons of Faith to make it even remotely believable.
strings.35_port_pop_new_people_2: Can you explain how exactly you plan to bring more folks here?
strings.35_port_pop_new_people_3: We have a very charming town... It's just missing one thing — actual townsfolk.
strings.35_port_pop_new_people_4: Once a week, on <sprite name="day_lust">, a merchant ship docks at the port.
strings.35_port_pop_new_people_6: I'll make sure the next one is carrying people looking for a fresh start.
strings.35_port_pop_new_people_7: But I'll need some advertising materials from you.
strings.35_port_pop_new_people_8: Like... a brochure? For the Town?
strings.35_port_pop_new_people_9: Exactly! Something to really sell the charm.
strings.35_port_pop_shop_10: Plus, I'm an expert at making things look better than they actually are.
strings.35_port_pop_shop_11: Speaking of how things look... don't you think this place could use a little freshening up?
strings.35_port_pop_shop_12: It's fine. Maybe slap on some paint — and say it's vintage.
strings.35_port_pop_shop_13: Exactly! You're absolutely right. It would be so lovely if you could bring me some paint.
strings.35_port_pop_shop_14: Alright, I'll see what I can do.
strings.35_port_pop_shop_2: How lovely it is to finally buy fresh food again...
strings.35_port_pop_shop_3: How did we ever manage without such a handy man!
strings.35_port_pop_shop_5: Ha! Sure, let's go with that.
strings.35_port_pop_shop_6: I like you... You can have Gunter's cards.
strings.35_port_pop_shop_7: The two of us together, we're ready to draw new people to the Town!
strings.35_port_pop_shop_8: Yeah, a zombie apocalypse would be the perfect sightseeing...
strings.35_port_pop_shop_9: Fiddlesticks... People see what they want to see.
strings.36_port_trademaster_lenses_2: Great! Now we can finish the lights and secure the bay.
strings.36_port_trademaster_lenses_3: I'm curious to see what exotic stuff the ships bring.
strings.36_port_trademaster_lenses_5: Stop by every <sprite name="day_lust">, and I'll have new exotic goods ready for you.
strings.36_port_trademaster_meeting_1: Ah. good! It's a pleasure to see you.
strings.36_port_trademaster_meeting_10: We need some kind of floating lighthouse to mark the most dangerous spots.
strings.36_port_trademaster_meeting_11: I've got everything ready... except we still don't have the lenses for the lamps.
strings.36_port_trademaster_meeting_12: I'll see what I can do.
strings.36_port_trademaster_meeting_13_a_1: Back then, we thought it was best to send away our departed...
strings.36_port_trademaster_meeting_13_a_10: Yes... I've heard about that. If it really works... then we might still have a chance.
strings.36_port_trademaster_meeting_13_a_3: Well, we had a problem sending their souls to rest, after the Bridge to the Afterlife was destroyed.
strings.36_port_trademaster_meeting_13_a_4: Whoa. Who would do a thing like that?
strings.36_port_trademaster_meeting_13_a_5: We did. Long ago, we abandoned our old faith... and betrayed our god.
strings.36_port_trademaster_meeting_13_a_6: You could still just bury them, you know.
strings.36_port_trademaster_meeting_13_a_7: That wouldn't put them to rest.
strings.36_port_trademaster_meeting_13_a_8: Well, it would... but only if a special Graveyard Keeper interred them in sacred soil.
strings.36_port_trademaster_meeting_13_a_9: That's exactly what I've been doing at my graveyard.
strings.36_port_trademaster_meeting_13_b_1: Why is it so important to bring in bigger ships?
strings.36_port_trademaster_meeting_13_b_2: Good question. The bigger the ship, the farther it sails.
strings.36_port_trademaster_meeting_13_b_3: Really unique and exotic items come from afar... and we need them.
strings.36_port_trademaster_meeting_13_b_5: That's not a great question, but I'll answer.
strings.36_port_trademaster_meeting_13_b_6: What's the point of living in a smelly and crowded place, if you can't get access to exotic things?
strings.36_port_trademaster_meeting_13_b_7: This might sound weird... but somehow I agree with you.
strings.36_port_trademaster_meeting_2: What was that about the merchant ship and helping the Town?
strings.36_port_trademaster_meeting_3: Right. Small ships come to the harbor, mostly taking away refugees...
strings.36_port_trademaster_meeting_4: Sometimes they bring a little food.
strings.36_port_trademaster_meeting_6: That's the spirit! I like it.
strings.36_port_trademaster_meeting_7: We definitely need to make it possible for big ships to enter the bay.
strings.36_port_trademaster_meeting_9: A lot of ships full of dead bodies sank in the bay.
strings.37_village_forest_pass_11: ... Deadly bandits live there. They've terrorized us for years!
strings.37_village_forest_pass_12: Yeah... I've seen your village guards. The only thing terrorizing them is hangovers.
strings.37_village_forest_pass_13: ... Magical, flying, glowing demons! They'll tear you apart!
strings.37_village_forest_pass_14: She wouldn't be happy to hear you call her a demon.
strings.37_village_forest_pass_15: Let's do it like last time...
strings.37_village_forest_pass_16: I help around the village, and you grant me access to the forest.
strings.37_village_forest_pass_17: Not so fast... Of course you'll need to help.
strings.37_village_forest_pass_18: But first, fix the Royal Post Box near the tavern.
strings.37_village_forest_pass_2: I know the forest is closed, but I really need to go in.
strings.37_village_forest_pass_20: Now that there's a competitor in the port, Januarius is nervous.
strings.37_village_forest_pass_21: We need ways to attract customers... A Royal Box would be a great start.
strings.37_village_forest_pass_22: The kingdom is in ruins. Will that even work?
strings.37_village_forest_pass_23: By the magic of Mother Nature...
strings.37_village_forest_pass_26: So yes, if you fix it, it will work.
strings.37_village_forest_pass_27: ... Right. I'll see what I can do.
strings.37_village_forest_pass_28: I'll need proof that you really fixed it.
strings.37_village_forest_pass_29: Bring me an official certificate from the Mailbox, confirming my status as Head of the Village.
strings.37_village_forest_pass_3: Oh my... you'll need to talk to Jully about that.
strings.37_village_forest_pass_4: The forest is a sensitive subject for him.
strings.37_village_forest_pass_6: I need your permission to enter the forest.
strings.37_village_forest_pass_7: You've got no business in that forest.
strings.37_village_forest_pass_8: I literally have a lot to do there.
strings.38_village_mailbox_2: How am I supposed to fix you?
strings.38_village_mailbox_5: I'm the Graveyard Keeper. I live on the hill across the river.
strings.38_village_mailbox_8: Your mail is very important to us...
strings.38_village_mailbox_certificate: Collect Head of the Village certificate.
strings.38_village_mailbox_certificate_2: Note: An official election is required for a permanent Head of the Village certificate.
strings.38_village_mailbox_repair_full_1: Thank you for participating in the Royal Mail Service restoration process.
strings.38_village_mailbox_request_deed_b_1: Long-abandoned Inquisitor's base transferred to Graveyard Keeper.
strings.38_village_mailbox_royal_signet_1: This Mailbox is now fully functional.
strings.38_village_mailbox_verification_1: Warning: You may proceed after completing the following 42 simple steps. Continue?
strings.38_village_mailbox_verification_1_a_10: This Mailbox is now fully functional.
strings.38_village_mailbox_verification_1_a_4: Warning: Royal Magenta running critically low...
strings.39_village_frill_asking_1: Did the port's liberation improve your inventory?
strings.39_village_frill_asking_3: But my clothes aren't in the best condition.
strings.39_village_frill_asking_4: I can't make a public appearance looking like this.
strings.39_village_frill_asking_5: Your frill does look a little worn out.
strings.39_village_frill_asking_6: Hey! You were supposed to say I still look good!
strings.39_village_frill_asking_7: Erm... How about I get you some new lace?
strings.39_village_frill_asking_8: Why, that would be a tremendous help!
strings.39_village_frill_lace_1: Here you go, your new lace.
strings.39_village_frill_lace_2: Thanks. You know, I almost want pay you.
strings.39_village_frill_lace_4: Yeah, this was obviously another trial run.
strings.39_village_frill_lace_6: You deserve to almost get paid.
strings.3_intro_defence_after_sewer_11: Don't tell me you're an Inquisitor... 'cause that's a familiar tale...
strings.3_intro_defence_after_sewer_12: Sir! A new wave of zombies is approaching!
strings.3_intro_defence_after_sewer_13: You're not a zombie... maybe you actually are an Inquisitor...
strings.3_intro_defence_after_sewer_14: Either way, you can hold a weapon.
strings.3_intro_defence_after_sewer_15: That's all that matters right now.
strings.3_intro_defence_after_sewer_16: You haven't got armor and a sword, though...
strings.3_intro_defence_after_sewer_17: Go get them from the workshop.
strings.3_intro_defence_after_sewer_2: I found him in the infected part of town...
strings.3_intro_defence_after_sewer_3: He was wandering around the Inquisitor district, completely lost.
strings.3_intro_defence_after_sewer_5: A looter. You know that's forbidden, right?
strings.3_intro_defence_after_sewer_7: Let me see what's in your bag...
strings.3_intro_defence_after_sewer_8: Hmm... an ugly skull, a royal signet, and an Inquisitor's medallion.
strings.3_intro_defence_armour_1: Hello. I need armor and a sword.
strings.3_intro_defence_armour_2: Sure. I just dish it out to whoever comes in here.
strings.3_intro_defence_armour_3_1: Lucky for you I invented these conveyor belts.
strings.3_intro_defence_armour_3_2: I can get resources to the workbench in no time!
strings.3_intro_defence_armour_3_3: Now, with the semi-automatic workbench, your armor will be ready in a snap.
strings.3_intro_defence_armour_3_6: Absolutely. I finally had enough time to get over my midlife crisis.
strings.3_intro_defence_armour_4: Never mind me, just take the armor and go.
strings.3_intro_defence_armour_5: Since you're carrying armor and a sword, you might as well equip them.
strings.3_intro_defence_armour_6: I might have trouble if I left without armor and a sword.
strings.3_intro_defence_fight_1: You look great in the armor. Just like a real Inquisitor.
strings.3_intro_defence_fight_10: What are you waiting for? Grab the banner and lead the guys to battle.
strings.3_intro_defence_fight_2: Speaking of which — our boys could use some motivation.
strings.3_intro_defence_fight_3: Look, guys, we've got a real Inquisitor here with us!
strings.3_intro_defence_fight_6: Take this party and go defend the right flank.
strings.3_intro_defence_fight_9: Look at you, climbing the ranks!
strings.3_intro_defence_retreat_1: Fall back to the port everyone!
strings.3_intro_defence_retreat_11: At least he bought us some time. Let's go for the gates.
strings.3_intro_defence_retreat_12: Dammit! Those village idiots blocked the gates again.
strings.3_intro_defence_retreat_14: No can do. The village chief says no-no.
strings.3_intro_defence_retreat_15: Since when does he have more authority than me?! Open up!
strings.3_intro_defence_retreat_18: I think those guys need our help.
strings.3_intro_defence_retreat_20: Looks like we're all gonna be eaten. Even my bones are about to get gnawed over.
strings.3_intro_defence_retreat_21: Maybe show them your fancy medallion?
strings.3_intro_defence_retreat_22: Look, I come from the Inquisition!
strings.3_intro_defence_retreat_23: What's an Inquisitor doing with you lot?
strings.3_intro_defence_retreat_24: You're here to save us, right?
strings.3_intro_defence_retreat_25: You know, to help us and restore the Inquisition in the Citadel.
strings.3_intro_defence_retreat_26_a: Open up right this second you losers!
strings.3_intro_defence_retreat_26_a_1: For I have the King's signet!
strings.3_intro_defence_retreat_26_b: Could you please open the gates?
strings.3_intro_defence_retreat_26_b_1: I bear the King's signet, after all...
strings.3_intro_defence_retreat_27: Wow, he has so much shiny stuff. Must be an Inquisitor.
strings.3_intro_defence_retreat_4: And I've come to vanquish all thy foes!
strings.3_intro_defence_retreat_5: It took me three days and three nights to get here, aboard a merchant ship.
strings.3_intro_defence_retreat_6: But now I'm ready to be your savior!
strings.40_village_fishing_bring: Plenty of Fish in the Sea
strings.40_village_fishing_catfish_11: And in exchange, we could teach you to make new bait for fishing.
strings.40_village_fishing_catfish_2: We almost caught such a huge catfish!
strings.40_village_fishing_catfish_3: It was the biggest catfish ever!
strings.40_village_fishing_catfish_5: Yeah, we even saw his mustache and stuff!
strings.40_village_fishing_catfish_6: I think what he means is — we didn't catch him.
strings.40_village_fishing_catfish_8: But only because we didn't have a strong enough fishing line!
strings.40_village_fishing_catfish_9: I could get you a stronger line.
strings.40_village_fishing_line_2: Look out, Mr. Catfish — the gloves are off!
strings.40_village_fishing_line_3: We're gonna make such a good soup out of him...
strings.40_village_fishing_line_4: Soup?! I thought we'd fry him.
strings.41_forest_bonfire_food_5: How about a recipe for cooking soldier's soup and ale?
strings.41_forest_bonfire_guards_2: Hello, hello! Welcome to our modest party.
strings.41_forest_bonfire_guards_4: Yes. And we're having the greatest time!
strings.41_forest_bonfire_guards_5: Any chance of getting something to eat or drink?
strings.41_forest_bonfire_guards_6: Sorry, but we've got nothing of the sort.
strings.41_forest_bonfire_guards_7: Oh, that's not a problem. I can get you something!
strings.41_forest_bonfire_guards_9: We're not very rich, but we'll try to reward you with something.
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey: The Nun with the Hairy Ass
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_10: I need those bodies, to put them to rest.
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_11: I see two problems here. Your graveyard... and that animal.
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_12_a_10: Fine. I'll give you a couple once a week. The poorest of the lot.
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_12_a_11: Come on <sprite name="day_wrath"> and take them.
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_12_a_2: It's unspeakable! Other than that, it's just fine.
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_12_a_3: Hey, I just started! It takes time!
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_12_a_4: You don't understand... All the living are sinners. – Cursed!
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_12_a_5: But the dead... they are blessed. Like all my poor sisters.
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_12_a_6: Now only I remain... and it is my duty not only to punish the living, but also to pray for the dead.
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_12_a_8: It is my destiny! And yours is to make the graveyard a nicer place for them to find peace.
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_12_a_9: But how can I do that without fresh dead bodies?
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_12_b_1: What's the problem with the donkey? He's good at delivering corpses.
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_12_b_10: Beneath us lies an ancient crypt. In its center, there stands a well.
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_12_b_11: Its water is said to be sacred... strong enough to defeat even this animal stench.
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_12_b_12: Repair it, and I may permit your creature to handle the corpses.
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_12_b_13: Water is water. Do I really need to crawl into a crypt for this?
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_12_b_14: Did I mention that your animal relieves himself all over my holy ground?
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_12_b_15: And guess who scrubs the stones afterward?
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_12_b_16: Maybe you'll find some carrot seeds among the evidence.
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_12_b_18: Nothing. I'll fix your sacred well.
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_12_b_2: No, no... he was in my prophetic vision!
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_12_b_3: But once I fix the graveyard, the bodies will need to arrive much faster...
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_12_b_4: And our long‑eared friend is crucial for that.
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_12_b_5: You know... maybe he deserves this suffering work. I'd rather enjoy seeing him carry something heavy.
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_12_b_6: Yet his foulsome filthiness still embraces this place of final rest.
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_12_b_7: I require water to clean everything up after him.
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_12_b_8: What's the problem? There's a whole river just a couple of meters away.
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_12_b_9: That river is foul. I've seen your animal drink from it. Contentedly.
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_2: My friend told me you're bringing dead bodies here now.
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_3: Yes! It is the prophecy! A holy sign led me to this place.
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_4: Those sinners used to just dump their dead over the wall...
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_5: Yeah, that's how things work. They dump them... the donkey takes them...
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_6: No! Not that filthy animal! I have seen him in my visions. He is an Emissary of Darkness!
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_7: Calm down, he's not a commie anymore... Besides, the corpses will just rot here.
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_8: No, they will not! They do not rot at this crossroads! Probably because of me.
strings.42_crossroad_nun_donkey_9: Many are gathered here now... Maybe because someone isn't doing their job properly!
strings.42_crossroad_nun_supplies_2: You know, your incompetence actually did me a favor.
strings.42_crossroad_nun_supplies_3: While I was waiting, I had plenty of time to watch and think!
strings.42_crossroad_nun_supplies_4: So I suppose I should... thank you.
strings.43_astrologer_pr_church_2: Oh, hi Gunter. What are you doing here?
strings.43_astrologer_pr_church_3: Shh! Quiet! Did you notice anything strange during the ceremony?
strings.43_astrologer_pr_church_4: Yeah... it was a much smaller gathering than I hoped.
strings.43_astrologer_pr_church_5: Exactly. And I know why... And more importantly, I know how to fix it.
strings.43_astrologer_pr_church_7: Not here. It's better we're not seen together.
strings.43_astrologer_pr_church_8: Meet me at my Shrine of Prediction. We'll talk there.
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_10: The guards on the wall are literally watching zombies do your landscaping.
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_11: I guess I never really thought about it like that...
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_12: You see? You're the hero! The preacher! The last hope of civilization... and the guy with the undead interns.
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_13: It's confusing. People panic easily. And they're already starting to panic.
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_14: Okay... I can hide them. Put 'em underground.
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_15: That's a good start. But it's not enough. The people love gossip and anxiety.
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_17: You know, before I got into the whole mystical prophecy racket, I was the best writer in the kingdom.
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_18: I could be your PR guy!
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_19: Because Panic Reduction is what you need.
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_2: So, you know why fewer people showed up last time at <sprite name="day_wrath"> service?
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_20: Ok I get the joke... not bad!
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_25: Well, ever since I was a kid, I've always been hungry for people's attention.
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_26: Until I learned the best way to get it...
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_27: Can we skip the whole tragic backstory part?
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_28: Sure, you're the boss. And lucky for you, I actually believe you're one of the good ones.
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_3: Oh yes, I know... Let me check if today is a good day to tell you...
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_30: Well, the Astrologer's Code won't let me lie to people.
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_31: But since it's me, you'll be ok with... half-truths?
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_32: Exactly! Just enough truth to sell the story.
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_33: So... here's what I need: some special hypno devices.
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_34: What devices? Where can I find them?
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_35: That's the good news! I sell exactly what you'll need... at an incredible discount!
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_36: Of course. I'm beginning to doubt they'll even work.
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_37: That's why you'll have to take them home... and put a little Faith into them.
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_38: Oh, and if you've got the right gear on you... you could even make some here.
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_39: I'll give you a little privacy.
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_4: Mmm, the stars are mildly annoyed... but never mind. Let's talk.
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_6: The zombies. The undead. You catching my drift?
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_7: Yeah, the town is swarmed... I'm literally fighting them off!
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_8: Right, right... let me clarify. People have grown a little concerned about the undead helpers working in your graveyard.
strings.43_astrologer_pr_tower_9: You know, we're a tight knit community... people talk. This might not be so obvious from your perspective.
strings.44_port_violine_11: I actually do know... someone who can play... but I still need an instrument. A violin.
strings.44_port_violine_12: Oh no. It would take me forever to learn how to craft one...
strings.44_port_violine_13: You don't need to make one. Just bring me one and I'll play it.
strings.44_port_violine_14: It belonged to my best friend Aleksta. She doesn't need it anymore, sadly.
strings.44_port_violine_16: Her creepy brother still has it. He's a doctor. Why do the sweetest girls always have weird brothers?
strings.44_port_violine_18: Yeah, I think he lives somewhere below the Town. Ask around. I hope he's still alive...
strings.44_port_violine_19: Yeah... I know that guy. He's still alive, he's just constantly coughing.
strings.44_port_violine_2: I found some paint that suits your club.
strings.44_port_violine_20: Perfect! Bring me that violin, and then we can talk about new citizens.
strings.44_port_violine_21: Hmm... we had a deal, and now you're changing it? What happened to being an honorable woman?
strings.44_port_violine_22: Oh sweetheart, I am definitely not that kind of woman... He he...
strings.44_port_violine_23: But I can be good to you... after you bring me that violin.
strings.44_port_violine_3: Oh, how lovely. I do like a man of his word!
strings.44_port_violine_5: So... can we finally talk about bringing more people to the Town?
strings.44_port_violine_6: Yes and no. The paint will help the look... but the music...
strings.44_port_violine_8: Exactly! No music... and people love music.
strings.44_port_violine_9: Problem is, there aren't many musicians left. Carrying around those awkward instruments makes it harder to outrun the undead.
strings.45_guards_reading_10: No! None of the soldiers can know! It would be humiliating.
strings.45_guards_reading_12: Hey, you don't by any chance know the lady who lives by the crossroads, in the ruined well house?
strings.45_guards_reading_14: Yeah. I've heard her praying. Her voice is... kind of nice.
strings.45_guards_reading_15: Sister Agatha has a nice voice?
strings.45_guards_reading_16: Could you ask her to read it to me?
strings.45_guards_reading_17: She'd have to be in a really good mood to agree.
strings.45_guards_reading_2: Here's your novel. Hope you enjoy it.
strings.45_guards_reading_3: Thanks. It will be nice to finally put it on the shelf... maybe even read it someday.
strings.45_guards_reading_4: Why not read it now? Why put it off? Life's short.
strings.45_guards_reading_5: Yeah... if only I could read.
strings.45_guards_reading_6: Wait... what? You can't read? You're practically a general!
strings.45_guards_reading_7: I told you... I was just a sergeant. Now I'm in charge of everything!
strings.45_guards_reading_8: Thank mercy for maps and little wooden figures. But anything with real words? Nope.
strings.45_guards_reading_9: Heh, maybe there's someone who can teach you? Or at least read you the damn book?
strings.46_pre_A_fights_10: Hopefully that way won't be as crowded as town square near the bridge.
strings.46_pre_A_fights_11: But in the meantime, we should scout the square, the area near the main gate.
strings.46_pre_A_fights_12: And by "we", of course, I mean you... It's best to be prepared.
strings.46_pre_A_fights_13: Okay, I got the basic plan.
strings.46_pre_A_fights_14: And talk to my lads at the barricades.
strings.46_pre_A_fights_15: The people on ground level often have the best intel.
strings.46_pre_A_fights_17: I've already stationed guards at key positions.
strings.46_pre_A_fights_18: We... You will advance from those points.
strings.46_pre_A_fights_2: The port is safe for now. There's a lot to rebuild.
strings.46_pre_A_fights_20: Just look for a bunch of gloomy lads standing around a blue banner.
strings.46_pre_A_fights_21: Heh, those red banners always make people gloomy.
strings.46_pre_A_fights_3: But I think... we can push forward.
strings.46_pre_A_fights_5: It was lucky things went our way this time.
strings.46_pre_A_fights_6: This part of town was pretty isolated. The rest is still brimming with zombies.
strings.46_pre_A_fights_7: But you're right... we need to clear a path up to the next canal.
strings.46_pre_A_fights_8: The one where we first met? We can secure the square.
strings.46_pre_A_fights_9: Right. But next time, we should attack from the port side.
strings.47_after_A2_2_fights_1: So strange... running forward instead of running backward.
strings.47_after_A2_2_fights_12: No, no... I'm too old for that stuff.
strings.47_after_A2_2_fights_15: The main horde is to the west... They're occupying two main streets in the district.
strings.47_after_A2_2_fights_16: There's a lot of them. The smart move is to clear out the gate square first.
strings.47_after_A2_2_fights_17: That'll cut the horde off from the rest of the town.
strings.47_after_A2_2_fights_18: But, of course — it's your call.
strings.47_after_A2_2_fights_2: Come on, let's take that new barricade.
strings.47_after_A2_2_fights_3: Good job. But I don't envy the sorry sot who has to rebuild all of this.
strings.47_after_A2_2_fights_6: So much space here... We could really get things up and running again.
strings.47_after_A2_2_fights_9: That's Linda... she runs a club at the port.
strings.47_pre_A2_2_fights_1: I think we've seen everything we need to see.
strings.47_pre_A2_2_fights_2: Yeah... there's still plenty of them around.
strings.47_pre_A2_2_fights_3: But the main horde is to the west.
strings.47_pre_A2_2_fights_4: We'll clear this area and push the barricades further that way. Are you ready?
strings.47_pre_A2_2_fights_6: Good thing the bridge on this side is still barricaded.
strings.47_pre_A2_fights_10: Make some noise, see what crawls out. No surprises that way.
strings.47_pre_A2_fights_2: Good, sir. The rations are better, now that we're getting along with the villagers again.
strings.47_pre_A2_fights_3: I saw from the wall how you fought off those undead!
strings.47_pre_A2_fights_5: What do you think — can we advance from here and take more ground?
strings.47_pre_A2_fights_6: That's hard to say... It doesn't look like many of them got through this far.
strings.47_pre_A2_fights_7: But with those bastards, you never know. They could be swarming inside any of these houses.
strings.48_after_A3_fights_1: Hurry! We need to fortify the bridges!
strings.48_after_A3_fights_11: He did promise to teach me some mechanics.
strings.48_after_A3_fights_12: You're a man of many talents.
strings.48_after_A3_fights_13: I was wrong about you when we first met...
strings.48_after_A3_fights_2: Give me a minute... I stashed a couple of bottles around here somewhere.
strings.48_after_A3_fights_3: Let's just hope the undead aren't wine enthusiasts...
strings.48_after_A3_fights_4: You've got to find those bottles, man! I can manage to hold them off without you... for a while.
strings.48_after_A3_fights_5: Oh... my workshop... my dear workshop...
strings.48_after_A3_fights_6: So, we're back where it all started.
strings.48_after_A3_fights_7: Oh nooo... What did they dooo to it?!
strings.48_after_A3_fights_8: Heh... you might want to calm your friend down.
strings.48_after_A3_fights_9: He's a good guy... just a little emotional. And a total snob.
strings.48_pre_A3_fights_1: Memorable square, sir... It was here that you led us into battle the first time.
strings.48_pre_A3_fights_2: That's true... but this time we'll be well prepared!
strings.48_pre_A3_fights_3: Yeah... The square looks calm now, but the undead are all hiding inside the houses.
strings.48_pre_A3_fights_4: Sometimes they make their way out... dragging smashed doors like trophies.
strings.48_pre_A3_fights_5: Heh... yeah, they do look kinda funny.
strings.48_pre_A3_fights_6: It's not so funny when those doors are blocking our arrows...
strings.48_pre_A3_fights_8: Then we'll have to get smarter too.
strings.48_pre_A3_fights_9: Fortify the center of the square, ring the bell... and wait.
strings.49_after_A4_2_fights_1: I heard every guard is gonna get one of the houses here.
strings.49_after_A4_2_fights_10: Think there's a place for a theater here?
strings.49_after_A4_2_fights_12: I'll just have to find out myself.
strings.49_after_A4_2_fights_13: By the way, are you sure it's safe here?
strings.49_after_A4_2_fights_14: Couldn't be safer. Just hurry up.
strings.49_after_A4_2_fights_15: Good guy... just hangs too much on other people's attention.
strings.49_after_A4_2_fights_16: Back to business. We still need to fight.
strings.49_after_A4_2_fights_17: I recently heard that the best defense is a good offense.
strings.49_after_A4_2_fights_19: I'll meet you at HQ, and we'll discuss the next phase of the plan.
strings.49_after_A4_2_fights_2: Hurry up, I want the corner one... with a good view of the channel.
strings.49_after_A4_2_fights_3: You mean a good view of the undead horde on the other side of the channel?
strings.49_after_A4_2_fights_5: We'll have to stop here. We're hitting our limits.
strings.49_after_A4_2_fights_6: What are you talking about? We're stronger than ever!
strings.49_after_A4_2_fights_9: We'll call it a new beginning... better than it was before.
strings.49_pre_A4_2_fights_3: We're just taking back what was ours not so long ago.
strings.49_pre_A4_2_fights_5: The Town will be ours again!
strings.49_pre_A4_fights_10: You boys really know your job.
strings.49_pre_A4_fights_2: We're inspired. You're really doing good out there.
strings.49_pre_A4_fights_3: Sometimes it's tough holding this position... There's so many undead on the other side.
strings.49_pre_A4_fights_4: Good thing we get a break every <sprite name="day_sloth">.
strings.49_pre_A4_fights_5: But don't worry... we'll hold 'em off. Take all the time you need to prepare.
strings.49_pre_A4_fights_7: I think you should attack from here first... then retreat.
strings.49_pre_A4_fights_8: Yeah, there's too many of them to crush in one go.
strings.49_pre_A4_fights_9: Then strike them again from the square... hit them from the rear.
strings.4_intro_base_after_retreat_10: We need to save it... Fight them back!
strings.4_intro_base_after_retreat_11: Sure, you bet... but for now, I need you to check all our supplies.
strings.4_intro_base_after_retreat_13: Meet you all at the guard tower...
strings.4_intro_base_after_retreat_15: I know you're not an Inquisitor...
strings.4_intro_base_after_retreat_18: Even an impostor may be of use right now.
strings.4_intro_base_after_retreat_19: We need to bury the fallen on this side of the gate
strings.4_intro_base_after_retreat_20: Since you call yourself a Keeper... You do it.
strings.4_intro_base_after_retreat_22: There's an abandoned Inquisitor base to the west.
strings.4_intro_base_after_retreat_23: So... as an Inquisitor, I have rights to the place, right?
strings.4_intro_base_after_retreat_24: Whatever... Sure, I guess you do...
strings.4_intro_base_after_retreat_25: Find a place for a graveyard there.
strings.4_intro_base_after_retreat_26: I'll arrange the body delivery in the morning.
strings.4_intro_base_after_retreat_27: When you're done, return to me with the burial certificates.
strings.4_intro_base_after_retreat_28: The Inquisitor's base sounds like a great place to crash.
strings.4_intro_base_after_retreat_30: Well, we're basically homeless — and it's a whole fricking base!
strings.4_intro_base_after_retreat_31: You're right... I think it might be a good place to stay...
strings.4_intro_base_after_retreat_4: Argh... You know what? You can stay here!
strings.4_intro_base_after_retreat_5: But you're definitely not allowed to enter the village without permission.
strings.4_intro_base_after_retreat_6: As you wish... I'll have a few words with your boss tomorrow!
strings.4_intro_base_after_retreat_7: Oh nooo... all my favorite equipment is in there!
strings.4_intro_base_after_retreat_8: I've been setting it up for ages!
strings.4_intro_base_after_retreat_9: I wish there was something we could do about it, my friend...
strings.4_intro_base_home_2: I heard you living types kinda need sleep.
strings.4_intro_base_home_3: And put me on the box by the bed. I don't like being stuck in a dark sack.
strings.4_intro_base_home_4: Heh... So dusty... But it's better than the Inquisitor dungeon...
strings.4_intro_base_home_5: Much better. I actually like this place.
strings.4_intro_base_home_6: We found a place to lay low... he he.
strings.4_intro_base_home_7: We just need to clean it up and fix a few things.
strings.4_intro_base_home_8: Yeah... it's so dusty I'm gonna sneeze.
strings.4_intro_base_home_9: You literally have nothing to sneeze with.
strings.4_intro_base_near_church_1: Look... the ruins of an ancient god's temple...
strings.4_intro_base_near_church_2: Can't think of a better place for a graveyard...
strings.4_intro_base_near_church_3: It's the closest thing to a holy place we're gonna find...
strings.4_intro_base_near_church_4: There's even a spot for a cozy little morgue..
strings.4_intro_base_near_church_5: Sounds like an easy job to me.
strings.4_intro_base_near_church_6: Let's move... and check out our new property.
strings.4_intro_base_near_church_8: Who knows... maybe it comes with a complimentary skeleton for you.
strings.4_intro_base_near_church_9: Ha ha... hilarious! You're on fire...
strings.4_intro_base_village_1: Hold it right there. No one passes through.
strings.4_intro_base_village_2: Not until the Head of the Village says otherwise.
strings.4_intro_base_waking_2: I'll wait for you by the morgue.
strings.50_pre_S1_fights_1: Hey guys. You notice anything strange down there?
strings.50_pre_S1_fights_10: That'll be great! Those looters give us a cut. He he
strings.50_pre_S1_fights_2: Nothing unusual... just the usual growling and shambling.
strings.50_pre_S1_fights_3: Good thing they don't know how to use ladders.
strings.50_pre_S1_fights_4: Yeah, we're pretty safe up here... Duty here almost feels like a perk.
strings.50_pre_S1_fights_5: Too bad for me, but I'll need to head down there.
strings.50_pre_S1_fights_6: When you gotta go, you gotta go.
strings.50_pre_S1_fights_7: Just be careful... it's a maze down there. Connects all parts of the town.
strings.50_pre_S1_fights_8: That's exactly why I need to clear it.
strings.50_pre_S1_fights_9: Make it safer for everyone to use.
strings.51_crossroad_fixed_better_corpse_2: What exactly makes for a better corpse?
strings.51_crossroad_fixed_better_corpse_3: I can pray harder before sending them to you...Then they'll have more <sprite name="skull">.
strings.51_crossroad_fixed_better_corpse_4: But right now I don't really feel like it.
strings.51_crossroad_fixed_better_corpse_7: Unless you could fix things up around here.
strings.51_crossroad_fixed_better_corpse_8: Nicer digs would definitely make my prayers more... effective.
strings.51_crossroad_fixed_delivery_2: Okay... seems like I've finally met all your requirements.
strings.51_crossroad_fixed_delivery_4: So... my donkey can come and collect fresh corpses now?
strings.51_crossroad_fixed_delivery_6: You may ask me every <sprite name="day_wrath"> how many corpses you'll need for the week.
strings.51_crossroad_fixed_delivery_7: If nothing changes, I'll keep sending the same amount.
strings.51_crossroad_fixed_delivery_8: That's what I needed to hear.
strings.51_crossroad_fixed_graveyard_2: The graveyard is still small, but I think it looks good.
strings.51_crossroad_fixed_graveyard_3: Of course it's small... and it's definitely not good yet.
strings.51_crossroad_fixed_graveyard_5: It takes knowledge to properly keep a graveyard, and bring forth its true greatness.
strings.51_crossroad_fixed_graveyard_6: Yeah, I'm starting to realize how complicated it is.
strings.51_crossroad_fixed_graveyard_7: Lucky for you, my order once possessed such knowledge.
strings.51_crossroad_fixed_path_10: And me watching... powerless to help...
strings.51_crossroad_fixed_path_11: Okay, okay... of course we couldn't know...
strings.51_crossroad_fixed_path_2: I fixed your well. The sacred water is restored... although it smells a little suspicious.
strings.51_crossroad_fixed_path_3: Good... I rather like the idea of that filthy donkey enduring a sacred bath.
strings.51_crossroad_fixed_path_4: From now on, he washes his hooves before every visit. No exceptions.
strings.51_crossroad_fixed_path_7: What do you or your donkey know of suffering?
strings.51_crossroad_fixed_path_8: What do you or your donkey know of pain...
strings.51_crossroad_fixed_path_9: Pain... Can you imagine the pain of my blessed sisters — burning alive?
strings.51_crossroad_fixed_path_before_2: Can you remind me what I'm supposed to do underground?
strings.51_crossroad_fixed_path_before_3: Oh Lord... You were the one who wanted the debris cleared.
strings.51_crossroad_fixed_path_before_4: So I can use the water from the sacred well.
strings.52_village_pass_forest_2: Could you ask Jully about the Forest Pass?
strings.52_village_pass_forest_3: Oh yes, here — Jully asked me to give you this.
strings.52_village_pass_forest_4: Thanks.... Tell him... he has my vote.
strings.52_village_pass_papers_10: He can be a little dramatic, sure... but I don't think he's that bad.
strings.52_village_pass_papers_11: That's easy for you to say. You can come and go as you please.
strings.52_village_pass_papers_12: I'm the one who has to stick around and deal with his... leadership.
strings.52_village_pass_papers_13: He used to be alright... until the whole "authority" thing went to his head.
strings.52_village_pass_papers_14: Just give me the paper. I'll take care of it.
strings.52_village_pass_papers_2: Hey, Januarius... there might be a problem with the Head of the Village papers.
strings.52_village_pass_papers_20: Anyway, let's give him some time to cool off.
strings.52_village_pass_papers_21: I'll let you know when Jully's ready to talk about the election.
strings.52_village_pass_papers_22: Sure, take all the time you need.
strings.52_village_pass_papers_23: I've got plenty on my plate besides politics.
strings.52_village_pass_papers_3: Hmm... They look good to me.
strings.52_village_pass_papers_4: You see the word "Temporary" on them?
strings.52_village_pass_papers_7: Exactly. The mailbox said we need an election to make it official.
strings.52_village_pass_papers_8: Hmm... You know what? That might actually be really good!
strings.52_village_pass_papers_9: An election could finally free us from Jully's little dictatorship.
strings.53_forest_pass_11: He's an old miner. Lives out in the forest.
strings.53_forest_pass_12: He and his buddy Sven used to make the best moonshine.
strings.53_forest_pass_13: Wait... Sven? I thought he was the leader of the bandits.
strings.53_forest_pass_14: No no, the bandits killed Sven. Their leader is Robert now.
strings.53_forest_pass_17: Why's there a miner living in the forest?
strings.53_forest_pass_18: Because there's an old abandoned mine there.
strings.53_forest_pass_2: Wow... is that a real Forest Pass?
strings.53_forest_pass_22: Wait... have you already been to the forest?
strings.53_forest_pass_23: Ohhh! I knew it... I knew he had a way!
strings.53_forest_pass_24: Hans told us the mines are connected to the Inquisitor's dungeons.
strings.53_forest_pass_26_a_1: This Hans sounds like a fun guy. Where can I find him?
strings.53_forest_pass_26_a_2: He's got a camp just down the road.
strings.53_forest_pass_26_a_3: Right before the bridge to the other side of the river.
strings.53_forest_pass_26_a_4: Yeah... the bridge to the cursed swamp!
strings.53_forest_pass_26_b_1: I thought there used to be a lake over there.
strings.53_forest_pass_26_b_2: Pfffft. There was a lake. Back in the Old God days.
strings.53_forest_pass_26_b_3: Then someone carved a channel to the sea... drained it all.
strings.53_forest_pass_26_b_4: Now it's just a stinky swamp.
strings.53_forest_pass_3: Hey, come here... have a look at this! This guy's got a Forest Pass!
strings.53_forest_pass_4: Oh man, I'm so jealous. All those juicy mushrooms just waiting to be picked...
strings.53_forest_pass_5: So what stops you from going?
strings.53_forest_pass_7: Also, we're kind of, you know... scared of ghostly killers and bandits.
strings.53_forest_pass_8: Have you ever actually seen any?
