strings.54_forest_bandits_10: Who plans meetings in a swamp?
strings.54_forest_bandits_11: I need access to the old mine.
strings.54_forest_bandits_12: You look like a miner... is there any iron still left down there?
strings.54_forest_bandits_14: Hans, there's no such thing as a talking hedgehog... you little liar!
strings.54_forest_bandits_15: And who the sard is this?
strings.54_forest_bandits_16: Oh, he's a messenger from the king... we've been pardoned!
strings.54_forest_bandits_17: No, I'm not. As far as I know, there is no king anymore.
strings.54_forest_bandits_18: So that means... I can beat the soul outta you!
strings.54_forest_bandits_19: It's okay, I'm okay! Just give me a minute. Or an hour. Maybe two.
strings.54_forest_bandits_20_a_1: I need to cross the bridge to the swamp.
strings.54_forest_bandits_20_a_10: Everyone calls me the Graveyard Keeper.
strings.54_forest_bandits_20_a_12: Second question: What is your favorite color?
strings.54_forest_bandits_20_a_17: Alright, now let's get to the third question.
strings.54_forest_bandits_20_a_19: Bring us a Royal Pardon from the Royal Mailbox!
strings.54_forest_bandits_20_a_20: Wait... that's not even a question!
strings.54_forest_bandits_20_a_21: Robert gets the third question. But... he's not really in the mood to talk today.
strings.54_forest_bandits_20_a_4: Try it... and we'll cut the bridge while you're still on it. Right, Sven?
strings.54_forest_bandits_20_a_6: So... is there a way to get permission?
strings.54_forest_bandits_20_a_7: Yes! You just need to answer three of our questions!
strings.54_forest_bandits_20_b_1: Is the mine even safe to use?
strings.54_forest_bandits_20_b_11: We have explosives... But we're not giving them to you!
strings.54_forest_bandits_20_b_12: Not unless you help us find our treasure!
strings.54_forest_bandits_20_b_14: Only Robert knows where it is. And he's... not exactly a chatty skull.
strings.54_forest_bandits_20_b_15: Well, I have a good idea who I could ask.
strings.54_forest_bandits_20_b_2: No way. We planted tons of explosives down there.
strings.54_forest_bandits_20_b_4: Okay, okay... it's safe. We just forgot to take down the warning signs.
strings.54_forest_bandits_20_b_5: Yeah, but the main tunnel is blocked with rocks.
strings.54_forest_bandits_20_b_6: You'll need explosives to open it up.
strings.54_forest_bandits_20_b_7: Okay... and where am I supposed to get the stuff to make explosives?
strings.54_forest_bandits_20_b_8: Down the main tunnel. There's plenty of sulfur down there.
strings.54_forest_bandits_20_b_9: But I can't get down there without explosives.
strings.54_forest_bandits_3: I'm the Graveyard Keeper. I live up on the hill at the old Inquisitor base.
strings.54_forest_bandits_4: So what's a Graveyard Keeper doing in my forest?
strings.54_forest_bandits_7: Hans also wants to know what you're doing here.
strings.54_forest_bandits_8: First I need to get to the island in the swamp. I have a meeting there.
strings.55_base_strike_10: Why are you happy? You like your job that much?
strings.55_base_strike_11: Not that much, no... but now I think I'm safe.
strings.55_base_strike_12: You see, our deal was — you help me, and I give you the Necronomicon.
strings.55_base_strike_13: The thing is... I don't have it. But I do know a guy who might know where it is.
strings.55_base_strike_15: No, no "hmm"... remember, you're the one who messed up. All this water torture? That's on you.
strings.55_base_strike_17: I guess that's okay. So who is the guy?
strings.55_base_strike_18: Good, good... Larry warned me you'd be furious, but you're taking it very well... ha ha.
strings.55_base_strike_2: I figured everything out with Sister Agatha...
strings.55_base_strike_20: Okay, okay... you know, you got a real temper buddy...
strings.55_base_strike_21: It's the Poet... now he's an Astrologer... calls himself Gunter.
strings.55_base_strike_23: Very awkward name choice. I once knew another guy named Gunter...
strings.55_base_strike_3: It's not a perfect solution... but the corpses will keep coming.
strings.55_base_strike_5: ... and you can keep bringing them.
strings.55_base_strike_7: Yeah... from now on, you have to wash your hooves every time you go collect a corpse.
strings.55_base_strike_8: And absolutely no relieving yourself at the crossroads.
strings.55_base_strike_9: Ohhh... sard... that was close. Good!
strings.56_forest_pardon_11: By the way... do you like cheese?
strings.56_forest_pardon_13: Yeah, we found a wheel of cheese today. Sitting there on the bridge... just appeared out of nowhere.
strings.56_forest_pardon_14: Too bad our family has such a tragic history with dairy...
strings.56_forest_pardon_17: So, now that you've got your pardon... any big plans?
strings.56_forest_pardon_18: Well... I'm gonna collect some mushrooms. For a stew.
strings.56_forest_pardon_19: Me... I'm still figuring it out.
strings.56_forest_pardon_20: No, I mean like... in general. You gonna move back to the village or something?
strings.56_forest_pardon_21: No way! We like it out here. It's peaceful.
strings.56_forest_pardon_23: Oh! And let's open a shop. I've always wanted to haggle!
strings.56_forest_pardon_3: Wait, why isn't it on official royal paper?
strings.56_forest_pardon_4: Well, we don't really have a king anymore...
strings.56_forest_pardon_6: Hey, I know that guy... the weird dude in the wooden mask?
strings.56_forest_pardon_8: He was trying to pick our mushrooms, so we chased him off.
strings.56_forest_pardon_9: So now I can cross the bridge?
strings.56_forest_pardon_bridge_try_1: Where do you think you're going?
strings.56_forest_pardon_bridge_try_2: What, you want us to chop down this bridge while you're standing on it?
strings.56_forest_pardon_bridge_try_3: Relax, relax... I'm only looking at it.
strings.57_forest_mine_before_2: Explosive traps inside. Do not enter. Hans
strings.57_forest_mine_before_4: Looks like only Hans can defuse it.
strings.57_forest_mine_before_continues_1: No... If it collapses, I won't get any iron.
strings.57_forest_mine_convince: Can't See The Forest for the Iron
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_10: We should do it at night. It's more dramatic.
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_12: Just remember to bring a candle. I want to look my spooky best.
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_2: Larry. I need the help of a talking skull.
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_3: That's very specific. What's the job?
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_4: I need you to pretend you're a different skull...
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_5: The skull of a bandit leader...
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_6: And convince them to give me their explosives.
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_7: Hmm... do we even look alike?
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_9: A skull is a skull... although he might have had a stronger chin.
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_robert_10: You're always so good at it.
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_robert_12: Robert! See, I told you Sven! He can talk!
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_robert_13: Oh Robert, we've missed you so much...
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_robert_14: Yeah, Sven is such a bore.
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_robert_15: Because I get tired of your endless foolery.
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_robert_16: It's not foolery... it's called having an "imagination".
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_robert_17: Friends, friends... I'm here to tell you...
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_robert_18: You need to give all your explosives...
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_robert_19: ... to my good friend, the Graveyard Keeper!
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_robert_2: Ok, lets do this! I'll be in your bag.
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_robert_20: What?! No way! He still hasn't found our treasure!
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_robert_21: Yeah, where is it, Robert? You're the one who hid it, right?
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_robert_23: Yeah. You never even showed us.
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_robert_24: Yeah. You just told us it was in a safe place.
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_robert_26: The real treasure... was our friendship!
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_robert_27: That's what I've been keeping safe. And now... it's yours!
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_robert_28: Be good to each other... my friends.
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_robert_3: What did I tell you about doing it at night?
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_robert_30: Yeah... when Robert was still around, we really were better friends.
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_robert_31: And now the Graveyard Keeper is also your friend.
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_robert_34: Larry's really killing it. Time to grab him.
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_robert_37: Take me home... I feel so empty now. That performance took a lot out of me.
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_robert_6: Hey, he doesn't have a big chin! You liar!
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_robert_8: Here they are — this is your moment.
strings.57_forest_mine_larry_robert_9: Oh man, I really miss beating people up...
strings.58_port_supplies_10: Good thing I invented conveyor belts and automated workbenches before the zombies showed up.
strings.58_port_supplies_11: Too bad we lost it all when they did.
strings.58_port_supplies_12: Lost it? Ha! Nothing's lost. I'll get my workshop back. I'll rebuild everything.
strings.58_port_supplies_14: Sure. But I'm smart enough to not be afraid of problems.
strings.58_port_supplies_15: I'll handle the production plans at my workshop.
strings.58_port_supplies_16: But the easy stuff? Well that's on you.
strings.58_port_supplies_18: Yeah... You'll just need to clear out all those undead barbarians.
strings.58_port_supplies_2: I brought that iron you asked for.
strings.58_port_supplies_20: Ok then. Guess it's time for some easy stuff.
strings.58_port_supplies_3: Ah, finally... You know, you're the one person I can trust!
strings.58_port_supplies_4: And I'm the only hope this town's got...
strings.58_port_supplies_5: Seems like I'm the last one left who remembers how to hammer a nail.
strings.58_port_supplies_8: But what we're talking about here is a little more complicated than nails.
strings.58_port_supplies_9: All alone... keeping the fragile flame of civilization alive.
strings.59_town_sewrena_10: Exactly. An arena in the sewers — a Sewrena.
strings.59_town_sewrena_11: Clearing out the undead there would help my business a lot.
strings.59_town_sewrena_12: I'd be very grateful, and you could exchange that gratitude for something more valuable.
strings.59_town_sewrena_13: Now that sounds like a deal, Davy.
strings.59_town_sewrena_2: I see you have some new looting orders, Davy.
strings.59_town_sewrena_3: Yes, demand is growing along with the Town.
strings.59_town_sewrena_4: And you've been helping quite a bit, making the sewers safer for my crew.
strings.59_town_sewrena_5: I try my best. But to keep things fair, my sewer expeditions should be more rewarding.
strings.59_town_sewrena_6: Fair point. Hunting zombies through endless tunnels isn't exactly efficient.
strings.59_town_sewrena_7: There's an old collection reservoir down there. Zombies tend to wash down into it.
strings.59_town_sewrena_8: You could deal with them all in one place, before they spread through the sewer network.
strings.59_town_sewrena_9: You're telling me there's a fighting arena somewhere in the sewers?
strings.5_intro_graveyard_autopsy_10: Are you crazy? How do you even come up with this stuff?
strings.5_intro_graveyard_autopsy_11: A much better plan would be taking everything from his pockets!
strings.5_intro_graveyard_autopsy_13: I'm sure at some point we'll figure out the whole autopsy thing.
strings.5_intro_graveyard_autopsy_14: Oh look — there's actually a book on precisely that!
strings.5_intro_graveyard_autopsy_15: Okay, take the body and follow me.
strings.5_intro_graveyard_autopsy_3: While you were sleeping, I stretched my bones a bit.
strings.5_intro_graveyard_autopsy_4: Now put the body on the autopsy table.
strings.5_intro_graveyard_autopsy_5: How did you manage to lose the body already? Go get it!
strings.5_intro_graveyard_autopsy_9: ... maybe we should cut a piece off and sell it?
strings.5_intro_graveyard_burial_1: Hey, where's the body? Get it back!
strings.5_intro_graveyard_burial_10: Good job. Now we can go and show this certificate to the Head of the Guards.
strings.5_intro_graveyard_burial_4: It's not right to just throw him into a hole.
strings.5_intro_graveyard_burial_5: He needs some kind of gravestone... or at least a sign.
strings.5_intro_graveyard_burial_6: You're free to use whatever you find in that chest.
strings.5_intro_graveyard_burial_8: Now put the sign on the grave...
strings.5_intro_graveyard_donkey_1: I'm a respectable, distinguished, magical animal!
strings.5_intro_graveyard_donkey_10: Okay, grab the body and follow me.
strings.5_intro_graveyard_donkey_2: And what do they ask of me? Carry dead bodies.
strings.5_intro_graveyard_donkey_3: This world has no sense of justice.
strings.5_intro_graveyard_donkey_4: You do have quite an advanced vocabulary for a donkey...
strings.5_intro_graveyard_donkey_5: I think I'm having a deja vu.
strings.5_intro_graveyard_donkey_6: What were you saying about justice?
strings.5_intro_graveyard_donkey_7: Never mind that, I'm actually happy doing any work at all.
strings.5_intro_graveyard_donkey_8: It's way better than becoming lunch meat.
strings.5_intro_graveyard_donkey_9: Speaking of which, I brought you a dead body. It needs to be buried.
strings.60_port_workshop_1: So you got your workshop back. Are you happy?
strings.60_port_workshop_10: But I still need to do what I need to do!
strings.60_port_workshop_12: To fix my workshop... I need my workshop!
strings.60_port_workshop_14: Do you? Great. Then you can also see it's a disaster.
strings.60_port_workshop_15: Starting from scratch is... not my thing.
strings.60_port_workshop_16: Well, I do have an old Inquisitor workshop under my base. Maybe I could use that?
strings.60_port_workshop_17: Perfect. Here's a list of what I need. You can use my blueprints... They're the only thing that survived.
strings.60_port_workshop_18: Sure... if I ever get any spare time.
strings.60_port_workshop_2: Happy? That's pretty much the opposite of what I'm feeling right now...
strings.60_port_workshop_21: Well... I do have a workshop... but it’s not as advanced... I don’t know where I can make all this.
strings.60_port_workshop_22: Be creative, my friend... I’ve heard rumors of an Inquisitor workshop buried somewhere under your base.
strings.60_port_workshop_23: If even half the stories are true, you might find exactly what you need down there.
strings.60_port_workshop_24: Here’s a list of what I need. Use my blueprints... they’re the only thing that survived.
strings.60_port_workshop_25: Alright... I’ll take a look. My basement is big enough to hide a one more secret.
strings.60_port_workshop_3: Hey, it should be easy for such a talented and handy engineer to fix everything up around here.
strings.60_port_workshop_32: Can you tell me something about the workshop under my base?
strings.60_port_workshop_33: Not much, to be honest... but the Inquisitors were way ahead of their time. No doubt about that.
strings.60_port_workshop_34: There might still be something left down there... artifacts, devices... trouble.
strings.60_port_workshop_35: Hm... now you’ve got my attention.
strings.60_port_workshop_36: What worries me is the power source.
strings.60_port_workshop_37: I have my water wheel... but the power they were using is a mystery to me.
strings.60_port_workshop_38: I hope I’ll solve this one.
strings.60_port_workshop_4: Talented, yes. Handy, yes. But they ruined everything!
strings.60_port_workshop_5: And for what? None of this stuff even tastes that good!
strings.60_port_workshop_6: You should have kicked those undead out of my workshop sooner!
strings.60_port_workshop_7: I did my best! I have a workshop I'm setting up too.
strings.60_port_workshop_8: There's a big shop under my base that still needs fixing.
strings.60_port_workshop_9: Fine, that's fine. I'm sure you're doing your best...
strings.61_after_clearing_A_10: See if you can focus on something peaceful.
strings.61_after_clearing_A_11: Still... there might be something valuable across the river. Survivors, maybe.
strings.61_after_clearing_A_12: Maybe there are, maybe there aren't. We'll talk about an attack when we have a clear and meaningful target.
strings.61_after_clearing_A_13: You speak with such wisdom. It's just a shame to waste such a well-prepared army.
strings.61_after_clearing_A_14: If you're itching for a fight, the sewers are always full of trouble. Davy would be delighted.
strings.61_after_clearing_A_16: Great. It's nice to see wisdom prevail. I'll be here if you need any help.
strings.61_after_clearing_A_2: We secured the Town from the walls to the river. It's a good foothold.
strings.61_after_clearing_A_3: I'm ready to push the zombies back even further.
strings.61_after_clearing_A_4: Ah, the passion of youth... but why do we need to push now?
strings.61_after_clearing_A_5: We've reclaimed a good piece of the Town, and we need to rebuild.
strings.61_after_clearing_A_6: I know... I've been helping with the repairs myself.
strings.61_after_clearing_A_7: Right now we don't need more space. We need more people.
strings.61_after_clearing_A_9: Of course I'm right. The river makes a fine natural defense.
strings.62_swamp_fairy_1: At last. We've been waiting for you...
strings.62_swamp_fairy_11: I couldn't trust anyone who's betrayed us twice.
strings.62_swamp_fairy_12: Interesting... anyway, he stayed at home.
strings.62_swamp_fairy_14: I'll be waiting in the heart of the swamp.
strings.62_swamp_fairy_2: I know things move at your own pace around here.
strings.62_swamp_fairy_3: But keeping us waiting is still rude.
strings.62_swamp_fairy_4: I did what I could... as always...
strings.62_swamp_fairy_5: My lady grows weaker with each passing day.
strings.62_swamp_fairy_7: You didn't bring that traitor, did you?
strings.62_swamp_fairy_8: My lady wouldn't want to see him.
strings.63_swamp_goddess_1: How many ruined churches do you have around here?
strings.63_swamp_goddess_10: The one who serves your brother.
strings.63_swamp_goddess_11: With respect, my lady... I serve no one.
strings.63_swamp_goddess_12: Oh, of course... you're just next in the cycle...
strings.63_swamp_goddess_13: In a role my brother has already tired of...
strings.63_swamp_goddess_14: Who is your brother, by the way?
strings.63_swamp_goddess_15: The Man with the Red eye...
strings.63_swamp_goddess_16: A role none asked for — but many desired.
strings.63_swamp_goddess_18: But could we just skip to the "save the world" part?
strings.63_swamp_goddess_20: Naturally, he chose someone like himself...
strings.63_swamp_goddess_21: Now it's your turn to save this world.
strings.63_swamp_goddess_22: From what? We've mostly handled the zombie problem...
strings.63_swamp_goddess_23: From extinction.... Lose the world, and you will lose yourself.
strings.63_swamp_goddess_24: I've been too weak for ages... It was just my brother and the magic portal holding everything together.
strings.63_swamp_goddess_25: Now he's weak too... something bad happened to him...
strings.63_swamp_goddess_26: Your helper said my other half destroyed the world...
strings.63_swamp_goddess_27: Yes... and no. My brother began the process...
strings.63_swamp_goddess_28: But your other part... the previous Keeper... used the magic portal...
strings.63_swamp_goddess_29: Somehow he nearly destroyed my brother and the portal itself.
strings.63_swamp_goddess_3: Follow me... You'll be the first to see her in years!
strings.63_swamp_goddess_31: And you must find and restore the portal.
strings.63_swamp_goddess_32_a_1: Yes. Ancient God. Old God. Many names.
strings.63_swamp_goddess_32_a_3: Somewhere in this world... trapped... nearly powerless.
strings.63_swamp_goddess_32_a_4: I could try to find where he is... but I'm too weak...
strings.63_swamp_goddess_32_a_5: If only one of my worshipers could perform a ritual here...
strings.63_swamp_goddess_32_a_6: I know one. A man in a wooden mask... He's obsessed with nature.
strings.63_swamp_goddess_32_a_7: He sounds just right. He should know the ritual. Bring him here.
strings.63_swamp_goddess_32_a_8: ... and I'll tell you where my brother is.
strings.63_swamp_goddess_32_b_1: What kind of magic are we talking about?
strings.63_swamp_goddess_32_b_10: Someone in this world is always bound to the portal, even when it lies shattered in fragments.
strings.63_swamp_goddess_32_b_11: The portal may have corrupted his soul, and driven him a little mad...
strings.63_swamp_goddess_32_b_12: He would be obsessed with the symbols of the days...
strings.63_swamp_goddess_32_b_13: He should know where it is...
strings.63_swamp_goddess_32_b_14: Okay... I'll talk to my friend and try to figure out who that is.
strings.63_swamp_goddess_32_b_2: When we arrived in this world, there was nothing.
strings.63_swamp_goddess_32_b_4: It links worlds... and grants wishes.
strings.63_swamp_goddess_32_b_5: Our wishes made us gods. Then we shaped everything.
strings.63_swamp_goddess_32_b_6: So I just wish to save the world?
strings.63_swamp_goddess_32_b_7: Wish whatever you want... but there's a trick to how it grants wishes...
strings.63_swamp_goddess_32_b_8: You just need to restore it and activate it to bring its magic back.
strings.63_swamp_goddess_32_b_9: Alright... how do I find the portal?
strings.63_swamp_goddess_32_c_1: The fairy told me I could find blue crystals here.
strings.63_swamp_goddess_32_c_3: I shed them every <sprite name="day_envy">. Grieving over what has happened to this world.
strings.63_swamp_goddess_32_c_4: They can suppress my brother's red-eye magic.
strings.63_swamp_goddess_32_c_5: If that magic controls the undead...
strings.63_swamp_goddess_32_c_6: Does that mean the undead are his doing?
strings.63_swamp_goddess_32_c_8: I don't know... I'm so tired...
strings.63_swamp_goddess_6: Ah... what a pleasant dream that was...
strings.63_swamp_goddess_8: Oh. Is that who I think it is?
strings.63_swamp_goddess_9: Yes, my lady. The man from another world...
strings.64_doctor_violine_10: Is Linda... is she well? Is she healthy?
strings.64_doctor_violine_11: As far as I can tell, yes. She looks stunning.
strings.64_doctor_violine_12: Thoughtless of her... both to me and to Aleksta... On that fateful day they were together...
strings.64_doctor_violine_15: It would be... good to hear Aleksta's violin again.
strings.64_doctor_violine_17: Not so fast. That violin is very precious to me.
strings.64_doctor_violine_18: Before I give it away, I want to restore the varnish coating.
strings.64_doctor_violine_19: I guess that means you need some protective lacquer?
strings.64_doctor_violine_2: Albert, do you have a violin by any chance?
strings.64_doctor_violine_20: Exactly. But I don't have any left... and I must give priority to my experiments.
strings.64_doctor_violine_21: No problem. I can find some... or make it myself. Do you happen to know a recipe?
strings.64_doctor_violine_22: Of course I know. You're rather nonchalant for someone who only just started alchemy.
strings.64_doctor_violine_3: No... Music is pathetic. I never played.
strings.64_doctor_violine_4: Maybe it's not yours. Could it have belonged to your sister?
strings.64_doctor_violine_5: My sister? — What do you know? Who told you that?
strings.64_doctor_violine_7: Calm down. Linda from the port is looking for a musical instrument.
strings.64_doctor_violine_8: She says she was a friend of your sister, and wants to play the violin at her club.
strings.64_doctor_violine_9: ... Linda. Yes, she is a friend of Aleksta.
strings.65_doctor_lacquer_10: So... can I take the violin now?
strings.65_doctor_lacquer_11: Alright... Tell Linda I'll come hear her play it.
strings.65_doctor_lacquer_12: Do you need a special invitation? A time and date?
strings.65_doctor_lacquer_14: I have a way of showing up... on time.
strings.65_doctor_lacquer_2: Here, I brought that lacquer you asked for.
strings.65_doctor_lacquer_3: Oh... *cough-cough* I already made some myself and covered the violin.
strings.65_doctor_lacquer_4: I couldn't trust a rookie with something so delicate.
strings.65_doctor_lacquer_5: Still... let's see what you made.
strings.65_doctor_lacquer_6: Unbelievable! I've been doing this for years... and you just started!
strings.65_doctor_lacquer_7: Look at that consistency... that shine...
strings.65_doctor_lacquer_9: No.... But I'll still keep it. I can fix it. *cough-cough*
strings.66_port_smell_11: Hmm, sounded sure... and how did he smell?
strings.66_port_smell_12: Smell? Uh... I didn't really notice.
strings.66_port_smell_13: My bad for asking a Graveyard Keeper about smells.
strings.66_port_smell_14: I remember him always reeking of chemicals and weird reagents...
strings.66_port_smell_15: Well look, you're the one who invited him... You deal with the smell.
strings.66_port_smell_16: Wait a second — the deal was just to bring you the violin!
strings.66_port_smell_17: Sure, sure. And now we have everything we need to attract more people.
strings.66_port_smell_18: But if you want this whole thing to actually work... then help me make this concert a success.
strings.66_port_smell_19: Okay, fine. How can I help?
strings.66_port_smell_20: Buy some exotic incense from the trade ship, and bring it to me.
strings.66_port_smell_4: By the way... who is Albert?
strings.66_port_smell_6: Right, right... then it looks like I'm all set.
strings.66_port_smell_7: Well, almost. There's one more thing...
strings.66_port_smell_8: Albert said he'd come to hear you play his sister's violin.
strings.66_port_smell_9: Are you sure he's actually going to show up?
strings.67_port_incense_2: They smell really good... I'll give them that.
strings.67_port_incense_3: Nice... what fine quality! We never had anything this classy in our town before.
strings.67_port_incense_4: Everything's ready now. I even had some time to practice.
strings.67_port_incense_5: Please stick around...  I want you to hear how amazing I sound!
strings.67_port_incense_6: Be sure to come by on <sprite name="day_lust">... I want you to hear how amazing I sound!
strings.68_port_concert_13: Thanks for helping organize all this.
strings.68_port_concert_14: I like good music. And she knows how to handle a violin.
strings.68_port_concert_15: Yes, she's good... *cough-cough* ... although my sister is... was better.
strings.68_port_concert_17: Of the two girls, of course it was my sister who would be stricken...
strings.68_port_concert_20: You know what... this music, it gives me hope again.
strings.68_port_concert_21: I saw your little helpers learning some new tricks.
strings.68_port_concert_22: Work is what separates humans from the animals.
strings.68_port_concert_23: Huh... interesting theory. I think we need to talk about that more.
strings.68_port_concert_24: I'll be waiting for you in my lab.
strings.68_port_concert_3: I don't see Albert... You told me he'd come.
strings.68_port_concert_30: Let's find a nice quiet place we can talk for a bit, alright?
strings.68_port_concert_36: See you there. We have zombies to discuss!
strings.68_port_concert_4: Just start. He said he has his way of being on time.
strings.69_doctor-project_10: Wow. I don't even know if that's possible.
strings.69_doctor-project_11: It has to be. You are the one who has given me hope again...
strings.69_doctor-project_12: I just need one good, smart zombie.
strings.69_doctor-project_14: But I must to test it in practice.
strings.69_doctor-project_15: Bring me a good zombie. One with 8 <sprite name="rskull">.
strings.69_doctor-project_16: That's... not so easy to achieve.
strings.69_doctor-project_17: Do it, and I'll share the whole of my alchemical knowledge with you.
strings.69_doctor-project_18: Alright, I'll see what I can do.
strings.69_doctor-project_19: Put the zombie on this examination table when you're ready.
strings.69_doctor-project_2: Hi Albert, what do you want to talk about?
strings.69_doctor-project_3: Yes, yes... I've got a little side project. *cough-cough*
strings.69_doctor-project_4: I'm aware you know how to create the undead...
strings.69_doctor-project_6: Don't be so modest. The sad fact is — you're quite gifted.
strings.69_doctor-project_7: But my work is different. I'm seeking to reverse the process.
strings.69_doctor-project_8: What — to make a corpse out of a zombie? That doesn't sound so hard.
strings.69_doctor-project_9: No... to heal a zombie. To bring it back as a person.
strings.69_doctor-project_table: This is where I need to put an 8 <sprite name="rskull"> zombie.
strings.6_intro_guards_foreman_2: We don't have much to offer.
strings.6_intro_guards_head_10: I'd say you two weirdos kind of speak the same language.
strings.6_intro_guards_head_12: Glad to hear it... especially considering how bad things are right now.
strings.6_intro_guards_head_13: There's too few people left... just a handful of guards, and a company of mercenary swordsmen.
strings.6_intro_guards_head_16: After all, you're talking to an Inquisitor... and the Graveyard Keeper...
strings.6_intro_guards_head_17: Maybe a better-looking graveyard would boost the morale of the poor souls around here.
strings.6_intro_guards_head_18: You're actually serious, aren't you? Since, like... we're all gonna end up there soon...
strings.6_intro_guards_head_19: What the sard... the lads might actually appreciate the irony!
strings.6_intro_guards_head_20: Sure, spruce up the graveyard... and I'll owe you a favor.
strings.6_intro_guards_head_3: I had a friendly chat with the Head of the Village.
strings.6_intro_guards_head_4: He also owns the village tavern. You can find him there.
strings.6_intro_guards_head_5: He goes in for fairy tales and mumbo jumbo, but he'll pay good money for every burial from now on.
strings.6_intro_guards_head_6: You said fairy? Do you think he'd know how to summon one?
strings.6_intro_guards_head_8: A fairy told me to summon her... so I can save the world...
strings.6_intro_guards_head_9: Heh... yeah, that sounds like his sort of thing.
strings.70_guards_bells_10: It rings every <sprite name="day_sloth"> morning, and most of them seem to withdraw back to the town center.
strings.70_guards_bells_11: Not all of them, but most.
strings.70_guards_bells_12: Yeah... probably the ones who sang with you in your choir.
strings.70_guards_bells_13: And the evening on the same day, a second bell rings and the zombies come back again.
strings.70_guards_bells_14: Hmm... who do you think is ringing the bell?
strings.70_guards_bells_2: We use a little bell to make the zombies go away, but I still don't quite understand how it works.
strings.70_guards_bells_3: Can you tell me more about these mysterious bells?
strings.70_guards_bells_4: There's a bell somewhere in the town center.
strings.70_guards_bells_5: Actually... there's two. A morning one and an evening one.
strings.70_guards_bells_6: Hmm... sounds like the same one to me.
strings.70_guards_bells_7: I used to sing in the church boys' choir. I know a thing or two about bells.
strings.70_guards_bells_8: Anyway, the first time people started turning into zombies, that bell was ringing in the evening.
strings.70_guards_bells_9: Yeah... we had zombies before that, but they weren't aggressive, and only the dead could turn.
strings.71_doctor_sister_10: If I were you, I'd focus on finding a recipe for cough medicine.
strings.71_doctor_sister_13: We don't get many visitors here.
strings.71_doctor_sister_15: I still don't understand why it happened to her...
strings.71_doctor_sister_17: A lot of people have lost someone they love.
strings.71_doctor_sister_19: The only person who ever truly cared about me...
strings.71_doctor_sister_2: Yes... this one's interesting. I think I see a flicker of a soul in its eyes.
strings.71_doctor_sister_20: What's the point of all this knowledge... if I can't even save my Aleksta?
strings.71_doctor_sister_21: Albert... I'll do my best to help you.
strings.71_doctor_sister_22: Maybe I can find the old god who brought me here.
strings.71_doctor_sister_23: He might have the power to help you...
strings.71_doctor_sister_24: Don't be pathetic. What god? That's all fairy tales.
strings.71_doctor_sister_25: All we have is ourselves... and this sickness that cries out for a cure!
strings.71_doctor_sister_26: Sure, Albert. I'll try to help you.
strings.71_doctor_sister_27: Hmm... after Aleksta, you're the second person who's ever cared.
strings.71_doctor_sister_3: That's unlikely. Their souls are trapped. Caught between two worlds.
strings.71_doctor_sister_4: I was merely speaking metaphorically. It's an illness. And I'll find the cure.
strings.71_doctor_sister_5: He was definitely dead before, Albert. So... what kind of cure are we talking about here?
strings.71_doctor_sister_6: There has to be a cure! *cough-cough*
strings.71_doctor_sister_8: And I have little time to find it...
strings.71_doctor_sister_9: Albert, why are you so obsessed with turning a zombie back into a human?
strings.72_crossroad_reader_10: Is there anything, even the remotest possibility of changing your mind?
strings.72_crossroad_reader_12: ... Although... if, somehow, you managed to get a proper choir singing at your church...
strings.72_crossroad_reader_13: But it's impossible! You can't find any decent singers these days... They're all dead!
strings.72_crossroad_reader_14: Hmm... They're all dead, you say? That's actually... an interesting hint.
strings.72_crossroad_reader_15: Ha! Good luck with that, then.
strings.72_crossroad_reader_2: I have a strange favor to ask... for a friend of mine.
strings.72_crossroad_reader_3: How dare you! Go to the club at the port if you're looking for funny business!
strings.72_crossroad_reader_4: No, no! It's not what you think... I wanted to ask if you could read a book. Out loud.
strings.72_crossroad_reader_6: Yeah... it's a romance novel. Would you be willing to read it aloud for Herbert?
strings.72_crossroad_reader_7: Herbert? The Master of the Guard? I'd never have thought he'd be interested in tales of romance...
strings.72_crossroad_reader_8: He is. But he can't read. And he said you have the sweetest voice he's ever heard.
strings.72_crossroad_reader_9: Oh, I'm flattered! But no. I have far more important things to do!
strings.73_crossroad_bigger_better_corpses_2: Can I start getting better corpses now?
strings.73_crossroad_bigger_better_corpses_4: But on the other hand... I also feel even more like resenting the living.
strings.73_crossroad_bigger_crossroad_2: Everything looks much better around here now.
strings.73_crossroad_bigger_crossroad_3: I hope you'll be able to focus on your prayers more.
strings.73_crossroad_bigger_crossroad_4: Still far from what these poor souls deserve... But I'll have to suffer it.
strings.73_crossroad_bigger_crossroad_5: So if I managed to improve your living conditions, would you be able to prepare the corpses even better?
strings.73_crossroad_bigger_crossroad_6: It's not just the living conditions... it's also the working conditions. I work from home, as you know...
strings.73_crossroad_bigger_crossroad_7: But to answer your question... yes.
strings.74_crossroad_chore_10: Hmm... as a priest, and the highest church official in... the area... I hereby grant you permission.
strings.74_crossroad_chore_11: What... wait... actually... that should work.
strings.74_crossroad_chore_12: Now that you mention you're a priest...
strings.74_crossroad_chore_13: I could also do with a confession after the ceremony.
strings.74_crossroad_chore_15: Great. My soul needs a good rinsing out. It's been too long.
strings.74_crossroad_chore_2: About that choir... I've got one now at the church, and they're singing pretty well.
strings.74_crossroad_chore_5: You know I've taken a vow... I can't leave this crossroads.
strings.74_crossroad_chore_6: So you've obviously decided to fool me!
strings.74_crossroad_chore_7: Come to the next ceremony and see for yourself.
strings.74_crossroad_chore_after_sermon_1: So I'm ready... I hope you're good at this.
strings.74_crossroad_chore_after_sermon_10: I was so scared I didn't bury my sisters properly...
strings.74_crossroad_chore_after_sermon_11: I didn't brush my teeth... and I ate too much candy...
strings.74_crossroad_chore_after_sermon_13: What are you talking about? This is my confession... and it's over!
strings.74_crossroad_chore_after_sermon_14: Fine. I forgive you... I guess. Can I also suggest being nicer to people?
strings.74_crossroad_chore_after_sermon_15: Yeah, like I promised... I'm going to read to Herbert.
strings.74_crossroad_chore_after_sermon_16: But he'll have to come to my place!
strings.74_crossroad_chore_after_sermon_17: Okay, I'll tell him. He'll be pleased.
strings.74_crossroad_chore_after_sermon_2: So, was I right? My choir is pretty good, isn't it?
strings.74_crossroad_chore_after_sermon_3: The choir? Yeah... not great, but I guess it's okay. So let's start...
strings.74_crossroad_chore_after_sermon_6: Wait, wait... can you not call me Father?
strings.74_crossroad_chore_after_sermon_7: Then what should I call you?
strings.74_crossroad_chore_ask_2: Can you help me assemble a choir?
strings.74_crossroad_chore_ask_3: No... because frankly it's impossible. I knew you couldn't do it!
strings.74_crossroad_chore_ask_4: You'd have to bring your singers back from the dead. Ha ha...
strings.75_forest_explosives_6: Just be careful in the mine... It's dangerous.
strings.75_forest_explosives_7: I'm always careful. That's why I'm the last one still alive.
strings.75_forest_explosives_8: Hold on a minute... I'm alive too!
strings.75_forest_explosives_9: Sven... calm down. Remember what Robert said... Be nice to me!
strings.75_forest_explosives_no_pardon_1: So... maybe you'll can let me cross the bridge now too?
strings.75_forest_explosives_no_pardon_2: Mmm... no. Robert only said to give you the explosives.
strings.75_forest_explosives_no_pardon_3: Okay... sounds like you and Robert need to have another chat.
strings.75_forest_explosives_no_pardon_5: Oh, we threw him in the river.
strings.75_forest_explosives_no_pardon_6: He always wanted to visit the sea.
strings.76_astrologer_press_after_sermon_1: Hey... I still had the debuff.
strings.76_astrologer_press_after_sermon_11: On my PR services, of course! I just need a bit of Faith to power my dispatches.
strings.76_astrologer_press_after_sermon_13: No tricks. Cross my heart. Just me, doing my level best for your public image.
strings.76_astrologer_press_after_sermon_16: Like I said... the more undead you raise, the more Faith I'll need.
strings.76_astrologer_press_after_sermon_17: And at the rate you're going... we'll be looking at some very big numbers.
strings.76_astrologer_press_after_sermon_18: There's got to be a better way to reduce panic.
strings.76_astrologer_press_after_sermon_19: Well... persuading people one-on-one is a lovely idea, but it's not exactly efficient.
strings.76_astrologer_press_after_sermon_2: Yeah... it turns out the hypno devices don't work so well on people.
strings.76_astrologer_press_after_sermon_20: We need to open a media outlet. A newspaper!
strings.76_astrologer_press_after_sermon_21: That would massively increase our reach...
strings.76_astrologer_press_after_sermon_22: You mean, like... with actual news?
strings.76_astrologer_press_after_sermon_23: Not necessarily. It doesn't have to be real. The main thing is that it's good news.
strings.76_astrologer_press_after_sermon_24: You just need to sprinkle in a bit of Faith to make it work.
strings.76_astrologer_press_after_sermon_25: And that way I spend less Faith per week?
strings.76_astrologer_press_after_sermon_26: Exactly. But you'll need a lot of writing...
strings.76_astrologer_press_after_sermon_27: Oh, speaking of which... My friend Jack mentioned this thing... a printing press.
strings.76_astrologer_press_after_sermon_28: If you manage to build one, maybe you could also print a few copies of my poetry?
strings.76_astrologer_press_after_sermon_29: Newspaper first. We'll see about the poetry later.
strings.76_astrologer_press_after_sermon_30: Fair enough. Just remember... every week we'll need to spend some PR resources.
strings.76_astrologer_press_after_sermon_31: And if you want to be smart, you can always keep a few extra on my desk.
strings.76_astrologer_press_after_sermon_32: I’ll set up a special board for newspapers and hypno devices near my house at the port.
strings.76_astrologer_press_after_sermon_33: You’ll need to leave fresh papers there every week, if you want to keep the townsfolk happy.
strings.76_astrologer_press_after_sermon_34: I thought you said those hypno devices don’t work.
strings.76_astrologer_press_after_sermon_35: Not on their own... but paired with the newspapers, they add a nice touch.
strings.76_astrologer_press_after_sermon_36: Which reminds me — I still have a few uncharged ones for sale... in case you're still interested, ha ha.
strings.76_astrologer_press_after_sermon_4: Yeah, yeah... I was a fool to believe something so silly could actually work.
strings.76_astrologer_press_after_sermon_5: But hey, one positive thing came out of all this.
strings.76_astrologer_press_after_sermon_7: I finally got rid of all those useless hypno devices.
strings.76_astrologer_press_after_sermon_9: Sorry, we have a strict "no refund" policy. But... I can offer you a discount.
strings.76_astrologer_press_device_10: Good! Now go ahead and hold your next ceremony. I'll make sure the "debuff" is gone in time.
strings.76_astrologer_press_device_2: Here are the hypno devices you asked for. I hope they actually work.
strings.76_astrologer_press_device_3: Oh, of course they will! I've poured all my knowledge and experience into the idea.
strings.76_astrologer_press_device_4: Anyway, I'll give them a trial. After that, we can talk about how many I'll need each week.
strings.76_astrologer_press_device_5: Wait a second... I have to bring you new ones every week?
strings.76_astrologer_press_device_6: Yep. The more undead you raise, the more I'll need. It's simple math.
strings.76_astrologer_press_device_8: Oh please... You're the one scamming nature. No salaries, no social benefits...
strings.77_ astrologer_printing_12: We need a new frontman... someone with a powerful image.
strings.77_ astrologer_printing_13: Someone who symbolizes progress, and overcoming hardship.
strings.77_ astrologer_printing_14: Don't tell me... someone like you?
strings.77_ astrologer_printing_15: No, no! I mean... of course I enjoy attention... but no. We need someone else.
strings.77_ astrologer_printing_18: You just need to convince him. Get him to sign this agreement. I'll take care of the rest.
strings.77_ astrologer_printing_19: Just get him to sign this agreement...
strings.77_ astrologer_printing_2: Here's the book with your poetry. But... why is the author somebody named "Vagner"?
strings.77_ astrologer_printing_20: And your gratitude will be boundless, right?
strings.77_ astrologer_printing_21: Well, it's in our mutual interests... But yes, my gratitude will be boundless.
strings.77_ astrologer_printing_3: Ah, Vagner... That's my pen name. I'm a man of many talents.
strings.77_ astrologer_printing_4: Anyway, thank you... I've been waiting for this for many years...
strings.77_ astrologer_printing_5: Well I'm glad you're happy. Now you can finally focus on your PR job.
strings.77_ astrologer_printing_6: Yes, right... Speaking of which... we need to make some changes.
strings.77_ astrologer_printing_7: What is it now? The media outlet is working just as well as your hypno gadgets?
strings.77_ astrologer_printing_8: No, no, the media outlet is working great!
strings.77_ astrologer_printing_9: But it's become unbearably difficult for me... to keep you on as the face of our campaign.
strings.78_astrologer_jack_10: Jack is the perfect role model.
strings.78_astrologer_jack_11: Thanks again. My work will be so much easier now...
strings.78_astrologer_jack_12: Maybe I'll finally find some time to get back to poetry.
strings.78_astrologer_jack_2: Jack agreed... he looked really excited.
strings.78_astrologer_jack_3: That's just great... Thank you... Graveyard Keeper.
strings.78_astrologer_jack_4: It's so strange, getting help from you again...
strings.78_astrologer_jack_6: Yeah, seems like I'm the real Jack of all trades! Ha ha.
strings.78_astrologer_jack_7: Ha ha... right. I hope Jack will give me some confidence.
strings.78_astrologer_jack_8: I've struggled with it my whole life...
strings.78_astrologer_jack_9: Desperately seeking other people's attention, yet fearful of it at the same time.
strings.79_village_goddess_10: I need you to perform a spring ritual at her shrine.
strings.79_village_goddess_11: You know where her shrine is? For real?
strings.79_village_goddess_13: Hm... then I'll need to prepare everything...
strings.79_village_goddess_15: On the other hand... why should I trust you?
strings.79_village_goddess_16: You just want to make a fool out of me!
strings.79_village_goddess_18: I need a sign. I want her to help me win the election!
strings.79_village_goddess_2: Can't you see?! I'm busy being outraged!
strings.79_village_goddess_20: Is she a Goddess or not?! I'll wait.
strings.79_village_goddess_21: Seems like I need to become the hand of God.
strings.79_village_goddess_22: I should talk to Januarius about this election.
strings.79_village_goddess_3: Yeah... but you're going to love what I have for you.
strings.79_village_goddess_5: The Goddess of Nature needs your help!
strings.79_village_goddess_7: She told me herself. You're her most fervent worshiper.
strings.79_village_goddess_8: Her only worshiper, to be honest...
strings.79_village_goddess_near_tavern_2: Stupid election! How is one person supposed to organize all this?!
strings.7_intro_village_foreman_2: Doesn't he... don't you understand how important this is?!
strings.7_intro_village_foreman_3: We just need more resources and manpower!
strings.7_intro_village_foreman_4: There's nothing we can do... we don't even have enough food here.
strings.7_intro_village_januarius_1: Ah, the man of the hour! I'm glad someone finally took up the burial business...
strings.7_intro_village_januarius_2: I'll be buying those burial certificates from you.
strings.7_intro_village_januarius_3: It's kind of an old tradition... Though funny enough, we've never had a graveyard before.
strings.7_intro_village_januarius_5: I heard you know a lot about fairies?
strings.7_intro_village_januarius_6: I've got a fairy-related question for you.
strings.7_intro_village_januarius_7: Oh, then you need Jully... wait a sec...
strings.7_intro_village_januarius_again_1: So... how did your conversation with the Head of the Village go?
strings.7_intro_village_januarius_again_10: He might have some seeds for you as well.
strings.7_intro_village_januarius_again_4: Right.... Listen... Can you tell me how I can help the village?
strings.7_intro_village_januarius_again_5: Hmm... It seems our main problem is the lack of food. And firewood.
strings.7_intro_village_januarius_again_6: I actually have some spare land at my place.
strings.7_intro_village_januarius_again_9: You should talk to the Merchant about the food supplies...
strings.7_intro_village_jully_11: I'm the Graveyard Keeper... and part-time Inquisitor!
strings.7_intro_village_jully_12: Not impressed. You townsfolk always need something...
strings.7_intro_village_jully_14: Help the village, and maybe... just maybe... one day I'll share my secrets.
strings.7_intro_village_jully_15: Just tell me how I can help.
strings.7_intro_village_jully_17: Could you be a little more specific?
strings.7_intro_village_jully_18: You know what? I don't have time for this... go ask Januarius.
strings.7_intro_village_jully_3: Not that I recall. State your business!
strings.7_intro_village_jully_4: I need to summon a fairy.
strings.7_intro_village_jully_5: Do you know what I should do?
strings.7_intro_village_jully_6: Of course I know... In matters of nature, my knowledge is complete!
strings.7_intro_village_jully_7: So... would you be so kind as to tell me?
strings.7_intro_village_jully_9: Who are you, anyway? Another schmuck from the hill?
strings.80_village_candidates_10: And I'd hate myself if he wins...
strings.80_village_candidates_11: Still, he's very excited about being elected.
strings.80_village_candidates_12: This book is enormous... I'll find a rule saying he can't.
strings.80_village_candidates_14: We need someone bright, young, and honest...
strings.80_village_candidates_15: Jeffry and Heffry would be the perfect candidates.
strings.80_village_candidates_16: The twins? But they're... they're... well...
strings.80_village_candidates_17: Exactly. With your support and my organization, it's a win-win.
strings.80_village_candidates_19: All we need is for Julius to be satisfied.
strings.80_village_candidates_22: First, you must perform a ceremony...
strings.80_village_candidates_23: So everyone believes things are going well.
strings.80_village_candidates_24: Second, we need an alternate voting location.
strings.80_village_candidates_25: I'll talk to Linda. Her club would be perfect.
strings.80_village_candidates_27: Alright. I'll talk to Herbert. His guards will do.
strings.80_village_candidates_28: Fourth... we need a PR campaign.
strings.80_village_candidates_29: I honestly have no idea what that is.
strings.80_village_candidates_3: Yeah... I'm excited. We never elected anyone before...
strings.80_village_candidates_30: Luckily, I have a PR agent and an astrologer.
strings.80_village_candidates_33: Alright... I'll come back when everything's ready.
strings.80_village_candidates_4: I just happened to find a big book about elections in the mailbox.
strings.80_village_candidates_5: Let's see... we need at least two candidates...
strings.80_village_candidates_6: One could be you... our beloved hero...
strings.80_village_candidates_7: Oh wait... no, you can't. You weren't born here. Ha ha.
strings.80_village_candidates_8: Why not you and Jully? A perfect win-win.
strings.80_village_candidates_9: Oh no... Jully would hate me if I won.
strings.81_guards_elections_ask_2: You know, we're having an election for the town leader.
strings.81_guards_elections_ask_5: I still don't see why we need the hassle...
strings.81_guards_elections_ask_6: It'll just complicate everything and make things boring...
strings.81_guards_elections_ask_7: I know what you mean. But the town is growing. It needs a capable leader.
strings.81_guards_elections_ask_8: Capable? Have you seen the candidates? I have my doubts...
strings.81_guards_elections_ask_9: Looks like I'll have to convince you.
strings.81_guards_elections_convince_3: More people means more deaths... Agatha will be pleased.
strings.81_guards_elections_convince_4: Hm... when you put it like that...
strings.81_guards_elections_convince_5: Alright. I'm in. My guards will help.
strings.82_port_elections_ask_2: Linda, we're holding an election for town leader...
strings.82_port_elections_ask_3: But that's a terrible idea. People come here for the freedom.
strings.82_port_elections_ask_4: Now we need a leader? What's next.... prohibition? Moral police?
strings.82_port_elections_ask_5: We're surrounded by zombies. We need some stability.
strings.82_port_elections_ask_6: And we'd like to have a voting location at your club.
strings.82_port_elections_ask_7: I'm not so sure. This election sounds suspicious.
strings.82_port_elections_ask_8: I guess I'll just have to convince you.
strings.82_port_elections_convince_3: Which means money. And exciting exotic diseases!
strings.82_port_elections_convince_4: Maybe Albert could finally open a practice...
strings.82_port_elections_convince_6: Maybe he'd even find a cure for Aleksta.
strings.82_port_elections_convince_8: Fine. You can use my club.
strings.83_astrologer_elections_ask_2: Gunter, we're holding an election for town leader...
strings.83_astrologer_elections_ask_3: You really should have asked me first.
strings.83_astrologer_elections_ask_4: Those candidates are a complete disaster.
strings.83_astrologer_elections_ask_5: Which is exactly why we need you to handle their campaign.
strings.83_astrologer_elections_ask_6: Whoa... no chance. That's way above my pay grade.
strings.83_astrologer_elections_ask_7: Then I guess I'll have to convince you.
strings.83_astrologer_elections_convince_2: An election campaign would be the perfect stage for our hero.
strings.83_astrologer_elections_convince_3: Jack could publicly support one of the candidates.
strings.83_astrologer_elections_convince_4: Working together would definitely strengthen your friendship.
strings.83_astrologer_elections_convince_5: Hm... we could brand this place the "Town of Heroes"...
strings.83_astrologer_elections_convince_6: I've even been thinking about opening a tourist bureau.
strings.84_astrologer_necronomicon_11: So... could you go down and find the book for me?
strings.84_astrologer_necronomicon_12: No. Not right now, I mean.
strings.84_astrologer_necronomicon_13: I'm busy with your PR stuff.
strings.84_astrologer_necronomicon_14: Can't you put that on pause? I really need that book.
strings.84_astrologer_necronomicon_15: Look... I offered to help you, and I'm helping you.
strings.84_astrologer_necronomicon_16: If you want me to have time for your book...
strings.84_astrologer_necronomicon_17: Then I need you to help me help you. Got it?
strings.84_astrologer_necronomicon_2: My friend the Donkey tells me that you...
strings.84_astrologer_necronomicon_3: Oh, that little traitor! So what exactly did he tell you?
strings.84_astrologer_necronomicon_4: He said you know where the Necronomicon is.
strings.84_astrologer_necronomicon_6: Yes. So... do you know where it is?
strings.84_astrologer_necronomicon_7: Feh... yeah, it's somewhere in my old stuff... from my former life.
strings.84_astrologer_necronomicon_rep_10: By the way, if you need stones for the collars... I know a guy who can sell you some.
strings.84_astrologer_necronomicon_rep_2: Maybe now you'll have time to look for that book?
strings.84_astrologer_necronomicon_rep_3: You know what? I already found it.
strings.84_astrologer_necronomicon_rep_4: Wow... seems like you didn't need that much time after all.
strings.84_astrologer_necronomicon_rep_5: Ha ha... I just enjoyed how well we were working together, partner. I couldn't bring myself to stop you.
strings.84_astrologer_necronomicon_rep_6: Turns out it was under my bed. No wonder I've been having all those nightmares...
strings.84_astrologer_necronomicon_rep_7: So really I should be thanking you for reminding me. Here — take it.
strings.84_astrologer_necronomicon_rep_8: Does it have the ritual for resurrecting a zombie?
strings.84_astrologer_necronomicon_rep_9: Oh yeah. It even includes some commentary from the last Graveyard Keeper.
strings.85_guards_reader_10: Alright, if you'll excuse me... I need to go get ready.
strings.85_guards_reader_11: Meanwhile, you just keep doing what you're doing...
strings.85_guards_reader_2: I arranged everything. Agatha will read for you.
strings.85_guards_reader_3: Thanks... Feels like I'm finally getting a proper work-life balance.
strings.85_guards_reader_4: Yeah, I bet. She says she'll read to you at her place.
strings.85_guards_reader_5: Sure, sure... this barracks isn't the right place for quality literature.
strings.85_guards_reader_7: Maybe one day there will be no more enemies to fight.
strings.85_guards_reader_8: There's always someone to fight, for fighting men like us.
strings.86_port_notebook_1: It felt so good to play for an audience again...
strings.86_port_notebook_10: How completely he's changed... so mysterious, so unique.
strings.86_port_notebook_12: But... why do you want to visit him? You're not sick, are you?
strings.86_port_notebook_13: Oh, I've never felt better! I'm thrilled, intrigued!
strings.86_port_notebook_14: He was so confident... so not into me.
strings.86_port_notebook_15: But you're right... I can't just show up empty-handed.
strings.86_port_notebook_16: I could bake him a pie... No, that's too obvious.
strings.86_port_notebook_19: My mother always said... a book is the best gift.
strings.86_port_notebook_20: A book! Yes... or better, a notebook.
strings.86_port_notebook_21: Let me guess... you want me to get you one?
strings.86_port_notebook_22: Where else is a girl supposed to find one around here?
strings.86_port_notebook_23: Should I even ask... what's in it for me?
strings.86_port_notebook_24: Oh, stop pretending. I know you're all about helping people...
strings.86_port_notebook_3: By the way. Do you know Albert well? Are you two friends?
strings.86_port_notebook_5: So... you know where he lives?
strings.86_port_notebook_7: That's perfect. I need to pay him a visit... We didn't get to finish our little chat.
strings.86_port_notebook_8: I think he's not exactly... seeing visitors.
strings.86_port_notebook_9: Of course he's not. How charming.
strings.87_doctor_linda_after_albert_1: What a notebook! Did you make it?
strings.87_doctor_linda_after_albert_2: Yeah, I helped Linda... Seems like she's into you, Albert...
strings.87_doctor_linda_after_albert_3: She was kind. I'm not used to that. But... "into me"?
strings.87_doctor_linda_after_albert_6: Thank you for the notebook... Keeper.
strings.87_doctor_linda_after_albert_7: Yeah right... as if she likes me. Can you even imagine...
strings.87_doctor_linda_after_linda_1: Sorry I followed you to Albert's laboratory...
strings.87_doctor_linda_after_linda_4: And he cares for poor Aleksta so much... the poor girl...
strings.87_doctor_linda_after_linda_5: Yeah, he's obsessed with finding a cure... but I'm not sure it's possible...
strings.87_doctor_linda_after_linda_6: Fiddlesticks! Don't be so skeptical. In fact... we're gonna help him find it.
strings.87_doctor_linda_after_linda_7: And by "we" you definitely mean me...
strings.87_doctor_linda_after_linda_8: Well, I'm sure you have a plan... And if you need anything from me, I'll be glad to help.
strings.87_doctor_linda_after_linda_9: Of course I have a plan! I just need to find an Old God!
strings.87_doctor_linda_asking_2: What are you staring at me for?
strings.87_doctor_linda_asking_3: Heh... visitors. I don't like them myself... They're too much...
strings.87_doctor_linda_asking_4: He needs to be in a really good mood...
strings.87_doctor_linda_asking_5: Ok... now you've got me worried... what are you mumbling?
strings.87_doctor_linda_asking_second_10: Ok... I've got things to do, so...
strings.87_doctor_linda_asking_second_11: I'll leave you two alone... and see you later, Albert...
strings.87_doctor_linda_asking_second_3: She's... here to visit you, apparently...
strings.87_doctor_linda_asking_second_4: You know full well, I scarcely have...
strings.87_doctor_linda_asking_second_6: A gorgeous notebook, with a cover made from the finest human leather!
strings.87_doctor_linda_asking_second_7: The finest quality, I can assure you...
strings.87_doctor_linda_asking_second_9: Well then... you're welcome, I guess...
strings.87_doctor_linda_notebook_2: Got you the best notebook you can find.
strings.87_doctor_linda_notebook_3: That's so lovely of you... Now you just need to ask Albert if it's okay for me to visit him.
strings.87_doctor_linda_notebook_4: Oh you people... How did you ever manage your lives before I showed up?
strings.87_doctor_linda_notebook_5: Poorly, as you can see... The Town is in ruins, there's zombies everywhere...
strings.88_larry_portal_10: The Goddess said it could be someone a little strange...
strings.88_larry_portal_12: Hey, what about our comrade, the donkey?
strings.88_larry_portal_15: Hey, speaking of redheads... our astrologer fits that description.
strings.88_larry_portal_16: He has symbols all over his floor.
strings.88_larry_portal_17: I should pay him a visit...
strings.88_larry_portal_18: Thanks, Larry... what would I do without you?
strings.88_larry_portal_19: Yep... that's me. A very helpful skull.
strings.88_larry_portal_2: Do you know anything about the magic portal?
strings.88_larry_portal_3: North of town. Granted wishes. Never ended well.
strings.88_larry_portal_5: According to the Inquisitors' notes I found... no. It's not.
strings.88_larry_portal_6: It vanished from the hill, right before the undead outbreak.
strings.88_larry_portal_7: Nobody really knows what happened in the North after that.
strings.88_larry_portal_8: Alright... next question. Whose soul could be bound to it?
strings.89_astrologer_portal_10: On a scale from 0 to 100, how close are we, really?
strings.89_astrologer_portal_12: Figures... Sard, when you showed up I knew this would end badly.
strings.89_astrologer_portal_13: Focus. Where's the portal, and how do I use it?
strings.89_astrologer_portal_14: You knew someone who looked like me... you must know something.
strings.89_astrologer_portal_15: Yes, but I stayed out of his whole portal business.
strings.89_astrologer_portal_16: Like I said, I was just a side character.
strings.89_astrologer_portal_17: But I do know the man who activated the portal with you... I mean him.
strings.89_astrologer_portal_18: He knows where it is. Probably how it works, too.
strings.89_astrologer_portal_19: If he does, he's the only one.
strings.89_astrologer_portal_2: I need to know everything you have about the magic portal.
strings.89_astrologer_portal_21: Last time I saw him, he was in the underground foundry beneath the old bathhouse.
strings.89_astrologer_portal_22: I'm not local... where can I find this bathhouse?
strings.89_astrologer_portal_24: So... just need to get past the zombie horde?
strings.89_astrologer_portal_25: Yes. But there's a shortcut... the foundry's water tunnel.
strings.89_astrologer_portal_26: The entrance isn't far from here, near the navigation lock.
strings.89_astrologer_portal_27: And how does an astrologer know about that?
strings.89_astrologer_portal_28: My best friend Jack told me about it.
strings.89_astrologer_portal_29: He used to maintain the lock and the tunnel.
strings.89_astrologer_portal_30: So I go to the foundry to meet — a blacksmith?
strings.89_astrologer_portal_31: Not a blacksmith. A bishop. Well... now a monk.
strings.89_astrologer_portal_32: So... through the tunnel, into the foundry under the bathhouse, and meet a monk.
strings.89_astrologer_portal_34_a: Alright. I'll ask Jack if he knows anything about it.
strings.89_astrologer_portal_34_b: Great. Jack told me about this foundry already. I'm working on it.
strings.89_astrologer_portal_4: For someone who knows so much... you sure never learn from your mistakes.
strings.89_astrologer_portal_5: So, the magic portal... do you know where it is?
strings.89_astrologer_portal_6: It's happening again... just like last time...
strings.89_astrologer_portal_7: I was just a side character, and I still got into a lot of trouble...
strings.89_astrologer_portal_8: Tell me... where do we stand with each other?
strings.8_5_base_foreman_boat_10: What? What do I owe you for?
strings.8_5_base_foreman_boat_11: I gave you some great armor! What, you thought it was free?
strings.8_5_base_foreman_boat_12: Don't worry, I'll build the boat myself.
strings.8_5_base_foreman_boat_13: That's a piece of cake for a professional like me.
strings.8_5_base_foreman_boat_16: Sure, sure... just let me get some sleep first!
strings.8_5_base_foreman_boat_18: I'll wait for you in the village... on the beach across the bridge.
strings.8_5_base_foreman_boat_19: Wow... better him a friend than an enemy.
strings.8_5_base_foreman_boat_20: Anyway... we seriously need a lock on that door.
strings.8_5_base_foreman_boat_3: Holy... Jack! It's night and you're in my house!
strings.8_5_base_foreman_boat_4: So I have this plan — it's genius.
strings.8_5_base_foreman_boat_5: There was a stronghold at the port. Some people might have remained there.
strings.8_5_base_foreman_boat_6: I hoped the brothers would help me get there, but their boat sank.
strings.8_5_base_foreman_boat_7: Wasn't this the Merchant's plan? I heard you discussing it.
strings.8_5_base_foreman_boat_8: Umm... who cares who came up with it, alright?
strings.8_5_base_foreman_boat_9: I need a boat, and you owe me.
strings.8_village_trader_foreman_1: What kind of merchant are you?!
strings.8_village_trader_foreman_2: No materials, no tools. How can we fight to get my workshop back?!
strings.8_village_trader_foreman_3: I guess you could try finding stuff at the port.
strings.8_village_trader_foreman_4: The twins have a boat. You could get there that way.
strings.8_village_trader_foreman_5: Okay. I'll go talk to them.
strings.8_village_trader_meeting_10: Of course! Good will is the essence of business.
strings.8_village_trader_meeting_11: Ok, then I just need some seeds.
strings.8_village_trader_meeting_12: I'd be glad to sell you some.
strings.8_village_trader_meeting_13: Wait... that sounds a little unfair.
strings.8_village_trader_meeting_14: I'm not proud of it, but I've got to make ends meet somehow.
strings.8_village_trader_meeting_16: Is there any other way I could help you with provisions?
strings.8_village_trader_meeting_17: It would be nice if I sold you a fishing rod.
strings.8_village_trader_meeting_18: Then I could buy fish from you.
strings.8_village_trader_meeting_19: You need free samples of the fish?
strings.8_village_trader_meeting_2: I'm the new Graveyard Keeper. From the hill.
strings.8_village_trader_meeting_20: That's a great idea! Except the twins took my fishing rod.
strings.8_village_trader_meeting_21: Come to think of it, they were supposed to give it back a whole week ago.
strings.8_village_trader_meeting_22: Could you go check on them?
strings.8_village_trader_meeting_23: They live on the other side of the river.
strings.8_village_trader_meeting_3: Very interesting. Always good to see a new face. Good for business!
strings.8_village_trader_meeting_4: Speaking of business — I heard you're having problems with the food supply?
strings.8_village_trader_meeting_5: Oh ho ho! We're short on everything. Not much land to grow food.
strings.8_village_trader_meeting_6: No woodcutting either — thanks to Jully's spiritual beliefs.
strings.8_village_trader_meeting_7: Well, I do have plenty of land to farm and trees to cut on the hill.
strings.8_village_trader_meeting_8: That's just marvelous! I'd gladly accept some samples.
strings.90_village_elections_1: Another round for Jack! Our hero, savior of the city!
strings.90_village_elections_11: She's displeased with me because I have too little faith.
strings.90_village_elections_12: Can you spare me some? I'll give it back... one day.
strings.90_village_elections_13: How much are we talking about?
strings.90_village_elections_16: Yeah... I've squandered quite a bit...
strings.90_village_elections_17: Bring the faith, and I'll be ready for the ritual.
strings.90_village_elections_2: Jack, the man who gave us everything!
strings.90_village_elections_3: And our newly elected leader... Jeffry!
strings.90_village_elections_6: It might not be obvious... but I'm a man of my word!
strings.90_village_elections_7: So you'll help me with the ritual?
strings.90_village_elections_8: The signs are clear... and the Goddess is not very pleased with me.
strings.90_village_elections_9: But she's giving me a chance to prove myself.
strings.90_village_elections_after_jack_1: So how does it feel to be a hero?
strings.90_village_elections_after_jack_2: Oh, come on... you know that was all Gunter's idea.
strings.90_village_elections_after_jack_3: I don't need the praises of these people.
strings.90_village_elections_after_jack_4: Ah. Now I see why you're so gloomy.
strings.90_village_elections_after_jack_5: No, you don't. Come to my workshop and I'll show you some calculations.
strings.90_village_elections_after_jack_6: Maybe you can even help... after all, you're the real hero here.
strings.90_village_elections_after_jack_7: Alright. I'll drop by as soon as I can... to see those calculations.
strings.90_village_elections_after_leave_1: It would be rude to leave without talking to everyone first.
strings.90_village_elections_after_linda_1: Hey... I didn't expect to see you here.
strings.90_village_elections_after_linda_10: Come to my club later. I'll be waiting. I need to go now.
strings.90_village_elections_after_linda_2: How's the voting going at your club?
strings.90_village_elections_after_linda_3: Very well. Free drinks for anyone who casts a vote.
strings.90_village_elections_after_linda_4: The turnout has already exceeded the number of actual townsfolk. Ha ha.
strings.90_village_elections_after_linda_6: Yes... but I'm here because I'm worried about Albert's health.
strings.90_village_elections_after_linda_7: He's pouring everything into saving his sister, but he's neglecting himself.
strings.90_village_elections_after_linda_9: I looked into it. I think I found a way to help him.
strings.90_village_elections_after_nun_1: I'm surprised to see you here.
strings.90_village_elections_after_nun_2: If only they'd elected someone like me...
strings.90_village_elections_after_nun_4: Anyway... I knew you'd show up.
strings.90_village_elections_after_nun_7: Not here... it could hurt my reputation.
strings.90_village_elections_after_nun_8: Come talk to me later at my place.
strings.90_village_elections_ready_11: Just don't forget who helped you get here.
strings.90_village_elections_ready_12: So... ready to start the election?
strings.90_village_elections_ready_14: Oh yes. The book says never delay. Fast and smooth.
strings.90_village_elections_ready_3: How did Jully take the news about his disqualification?
strings.90_village_elections_ready_4: Oh, perfectly fine. I explained that we'd handle everything...
strings.90_village_elections_ready_5: This time, it'll be just me and him...
strings.90_village_elections_ready_6: So how will it work with Jeffry or Heffry as elected leaders?
strings.90_village_elections_ready_7: The election manual has a whole chapter called "Tips and Tricks."
strings.90_village_elections_ready_8: It's mostly about choosing the right candidates... ha ha...
strings.90_village_elections_ready_9: Naturally, the people who can read... and own the manual... get to run everything.
strings.91_linda_cough_11: Some refugees. They want to settle in our town.
strings.91_linda_cough_12: I thought we agreed I help decide when new people are allowed in.
strings.91_linda_cough_13: Apparently, things were bad where they come from... and they couldn't wait.
strings.91_linda_cough_14: But they brought a magical plant with them from distant lands. They claim it can cure Albert.
strings.91_linda_cough_16: So you want a house in exchange for the plant?
strings.91_linda_cough_17: No, no... we need land. Fertile soil where we can live and farm.
strings.91_linda_cough_18: We'll cultivate it. And give you half of our first harvest... and your friend's cough will be cured.
strings.91_linda_cough_2: You wanted to talk about how we can help Albert's health?
strings.91_linda_cough_20: Fine. But where am I supposed to find the land?
strings.91_linda_cough_21: Mind if I help? You can find land like that at the bottom of the ship lock.
strings.91_linda_cough_22: Back when it was drained for repairs, the people got an excellent harvest there.
strings.91_linda_cough_23: Thank you, Captain. See? There's an option.
strings.91_linda_cough_24_a_1: I'll speak with the Head of the Guard about the lock.
strings.91_linda_cough_24_a_2: Maybe we can arrange something for you.
strings.91_linda_cough_24_b_1: I've already drained it. Meet me there, guys.
strings.91_linda_cough_24_b_2: Alright then. We'll go take a look at the soil. Meet us there.
strings.91_linda_cough_26: But we can do even more.
strings.91_linda_cough_28: What else can we do for Albert?
strings.91_linda_cough_29: The medicine will help his body.
strings.91_linda_cough_3: Yes... he's so gentle. So intelligent... so devoted to his sister...
strings.91_linda_cough_30: But I have to insist on getting him out of his basement.
strings.91_linda_cough_32: Oh he'll never agree to leave it.
strings.91_linda_cough_33: Then I'll ask him to open a proper practice here. I have rooms to spare.
strings.91_linda_cough_34: That might not be so simple...
strings.91_linda_cough_35: We just need to supply the town with high-quality goods.
strings.91_linda_cough_36: That will make life easier, and will attract wealthy older people.
strings.91_linda_cough_37: Wealthy patients need a doctor. Albert will feel valued again.
strings.91_linda_cough_38: I'm not so sure he'll agree.
strings.91_linda_cough_39: Leave Albert to me. You focus on strengthening the town.
strings.91_linda_cough_4: I never imagined a man could be so selfless.
strings.91_linda_cough_40: Tell me when the supplies are ready.
strings.91_linda_cough_5: I've visited him again recently. Every time, I admire him more.
strings.91_linda_cough_6: It would be so tragic if he coughed his lungs out...
strings.91_linda_cough_7: Exactly. Many people have been coming through the port... and the club.
strings.91_linda_cough_8: I've been asking all of them about medical recipes.
strings.91_linda_cough_9: No luck... until those guys in green showed up.
strings.92_doctor_cure_10: That sounds manageable... but will you come with me? I'm a little squeamish about medical treatments.
strings.92_doctor_cure_11: I've never tested anything on myself. cough-cough
strings.92_doctor_cure_13: Thank you. I don't want to seem weak in front of Linda.
strings.92_doctor_cure_14: I think she cares about me... and I care about her...
strings.92_doctor_cure_15: That's adorable. I feel like a little Cupid.
strings.92_doctor_cure_16: She probably wants me to leave this old basement and live closer to her.
strings.92_doctor_cure_17: But what would I do on the surface? Where would I live? And I'd need to take Aleksta with me!
strings.92_doctor_cure_18: Maybe you should just relax and let Linda help you with all this.
strings.92_doctor_cure_19: You're right... I don't want to disappoint her.
strings.92_doctor_cure_2: Linda and I think we found something that could cure you.
strings.92_doctor_cure_20: Let's go then. She's waiting for you.
strings.92_doctor_cure_22: It's just that... maybe this was supposed to be a surprise...
strings.92_doctor_cure_23: Or was that the church organ...
strings.92_doctor_cure_24: Yes, but you already told me everything. cough-cough
strings.92_doctor_cure_25: My mistake... anyway, just pretend to be surprised.
strings.92_doctor_cure_3: If this is a joke, it's not a very kind one. cough-cough
strings.92_doctor_cure_4: It's no joke. The refugees brought a strange plant.
strings.92_doctor_cure_6: I've read about it... or was that a to-ma-to? Some exotic plant from the edge of the world.
strings.92_doctor_cure_7: Linda thinks she can make a remedy. I just need you at the club.
strings.92_doctor_cure_8: Since when did Linda become an alchemist?
strings.92_doctor_cure_club_1: Did the Keeper tell you already?
strings.92_doctor_cure_club_13: Hey... it's better... I can't even force one out...
strings.92_doctor_cure_club_15: But you'll need to continue the treatment for a week.
strings.92_doctor_cure_club_17: I'll return the pot to the kitchen.
strings.92_doctor_cure_club_18: You did it... you found a cure...
strings.92_doctor_cure_club_19: Not alone. Linda gets the credit too.
strings.92_doctor_cure_club_2: Did you tell me... Keeper? cough-cough
strings.92_doctor_cure_club_20: Of course... now I have all the time in the world.
strings.92_doctor_cure_club_21: It's good seeing you like this, my friend.
strings.92_doctor_cure_club_23: You've already done plenty. A healthy man can stand on his own two feet. Ha ha.
strings.92_doctor_cure_club_3: Well... sure... Surprise — we found a cure for your cough!
strings.92_doctor_cure_club_5: You boys are acting really weird. But yes, Albert, we found it.
strings.93_linda_potato_10: Trust me... he's starting to think differently about that.
strings.93_linda_potato_2: I got the so-called magic plant.
strings.93_linda_potato_3: We need to boil it and have Albert inhale the steam.
strings.93_linda_potato_4: I hope it really is magical... or I don't know what I'll do to those guys in green.
strings.93_linda_potato_5: They don't look like the type who would lie. They seem alright.
strings.93_linda_potato_6: Fine. I'll get a pot and a towel ready.
strings.93_linda_potato_7: You go and bring him here. You're the only one he'll listen to.
strings.93_linda_potato_8: I'll need you to help convince him to try it.
strings.93_linda_potato_9: He always refuses to look after himself.
strings.94_crossroad_repitation_11: I lost all my sisters... the nuns. And he lost his retirement.
strings.94_crossroad_repitation_13: Exactly. But I still have my anger... he has only sadness...
strings.94_crossroad_repitation_14: Though that romantic novel of his is enough to make even me sentimental.
strings.94_crossroad_repitation_15: So you want me to make him angry?
strings.94_crossroad_repitation_16: No. I want you to rebuild the chapel organ.
strings.94_crossroad_repitation_18: And that will make him angry how?
strings.94_crossroad_repitation_19: The organ's thunder and the church's glory will awaken his righteous fury!
strings.94_crossroad_repitation_2: I have to admit, you got me curious... How could Herbert ruin your reputation?
strings.94_crossroad_repitation_21: I really think that's a bad idea... we could just steal his sword instead.
strings.94_crossroad_repitation_22: Of course it's a bad idea, if I'm relying on you to sort out your church properly!
strings.94_crossroad_repitation_23: And you need to find a special wood, and a carving master, to make the organ sound good.
strings.94_crossroad_repitation_24: And don't tell Herbert. It has to be a surprise.
strings.94_crossroad_repitation_3: Oh dear... where can I start? Herbert is... kind.
strings.94_crossroad_repitation_4: He's not afraid of me. He actually enjoys my presence.
strings.94_crossroad_repitation_5: And I enjoy reading to him...
strings.94_crossroad_repitation_6: How can that be bad for you reputation?
strings.94_crossroad_repitation_7: Because everyone fears my anger! That's my reputation!
strings.94_crossroad_repitation_8: It's what helps me get through the day...
strings.94_crossroad_repitation_wood_2: What wood, and what carving master are you talking about?
strings.94_crossroad_repitation_wood_3: The masters gathered driftwood from the shore.
strings.94_crossroad_repitation_wood_4: They lived in stilt houses on the western lake.
strings.94_crossroad_repitation_wood_6: The middle of the lake is the safest place around.
strings.94_crossroad_repitation_wood_7: There should be a wooden bridge leading to them.
strings.94_crossroad_repitation_wood_8: Though now it's in the infected district.
strings.94_crossroad_repitation_wood_9: Fine. I'll talk to Herbert and we'll find a way across.
strings.95_guards_organ_built_10: The next time you visit her to read, I bet she'll invite you herself.
strings.95_guards_organ_built_2: It wasn't easy, but I built the church organ like you asked.
strings.95_guards_organ_built_3: That's fantastic... although now I'm nervous about asking her to come hear it.
strings.95_guards_organ_built_4: I don't want her to feel pressured...
strings.95_guards_organ_built_5: Leave it to me. I'll tell her about the organ...
strings.95_guards_organ_built_6: And gently suggest that she invite you.
strings.95_guards_organ_built_7: You really think she'd want to share the moment with me?
strings.95_guards_organ_built_9: Then I'll trust you, Keeper. Thank you.
strings.95_guards_organ_not_built_3: Still working on it. The wood is hard to get.
