strings.95_guards_organ_not_built_4: I understand... but you know Agatha's smile will be worth the trouble.
strings.96_crossroad_organ_built_11: You build one organ, and now suddenly you're all full of yourself.
strings.96_crossroad_organ_built_2: It wasn't easy, but I built the organ you wanted.
strings.96_crossroad_organ_built_3: With the special wood from the lake?
strings.96_crossroad_organ_built_4: From the most special wood in town.
strings.96_crossroad_organ_built_6: It may not fill him with holy wrath...
strings.96_crossroad_organ_built_7: But his delicate soul will certainly enjoy it.
strings.96_crossroad_organ_built_8: Speaking of delicate matters... I might need another favor...
strings.96_crossroad_organ_not_built_2: How's the church organ coming along?
strings.96_crossroad_organ_not_built_3: Still working on it. Good wood is hard to find.
strings.96_crossroad_organ_not_built_4: As I expected... an organ is a work of art, not just another piece of furniture.
strings.98_workshop_tunnel_10: Sounds doable... and apparently there's no other way to save the world.
strings.98_workshop_tunnel_11: First you'll need to get through all those zombies.
strings.98_workshop_tunnel_12: That's exactly what I'm going to talk about with Herbert.
strings.98_workshop_tunnel_2: So I really can get there through the tunnel?
strings.98_workshop_tunnel_3: You can. But first you'll need to reach the tunnel itself.
strings.98_workshop_tunnel_4: It's in the infected part of the town.
strings.98_workshop_tunnel_5: Right now the entrance is flooded, and sealed by a valve.
strings.98_workshop_tunnel_7: Yes. You just need to drain the ship lock.
strings.98_workshop_tunnel_8: You close the gate on the left side...
strings.98_workshop_tunnel_9: Then open the tunnel by lifting the valve on the right side of the ship lock.
strings.98_workshop_tunnel_not_101_1: Can you tell me where the water tunnel to the foundry is, and how I can get through it?
strings.98_workshop_tunnel_not_101_2: That tunnel is the only way to reach the area.
strings.98_workshop_tunnel_not_101_4: That foundry produced the best steel.
strings.99_workshop_repair_complete_10: Ha ha... of course I am. Now, let's see if I can remember where I left off...
strings.99_workshop_repair_complete_11: Ah yes, I was working on some armor...
strings.99_workshop_repair_complete_13: Oh! I almost forgot... you're officially my apprentice now.
strings.99_workshop_repair_complete_2: Now I have everything I need.
strings.99_workshop_repair_complete_4: You know, "thank you" would be enough.
strings.99_workshop_repair_complete_7: Wait... how... how did you fix everything so fast?
strings.99_workshop_repair_complete_8: Ha ha! That's the third time I rebuilt everything. I know a few tricks...
strings.99_workshop_repair_complete_9: Well, you truly are a master.
strings.99_workshop_repair_material_4: Only I can make them this good.
strings.99_workshop_repair_pr_10: The people will laugh at me... I can't go stand up in front of them.
strings.99_workshop_repair_pr_2: Gunter asked me to talk to you about being the frontman for our Restore the Town campaign.
strings.99_workshop_repair_pr_3: Hm... perfectly understandable. I do fit perfectly. Who else is...
strings.99_workshop_repair_pr_4: So talented... so brilliant... so thoughtful...
strings.99_workshop_repair_pr_6: Be careful... I might make him my favorite apprentice instead of you! Ha ha...
strings.99_workshop_repair_pr_7: Glad you agree. I just need your signature here...
strings.99_workshop_repair_pr_9: It's ridiculous... me, a master craftsman — without a proper workshop?
strings.99_workshop_repair_pr_get_2: Now that your workshop is restored, there's nothing holding you back from signing.
strings.99_workshop_repair_pr_get_3: I guess it's my duty to show these people the light of progress.
strings.9_village_brothers_discussion_5: That's right. You thought you were steering, and that's why this is your fault!
strings.9_village_brothers_foreman_2: I don't get what he wants...
strings.9_village_brothers_foreman_5: You've got to be kidding me.
strings.9_village_brothers_heffry_1: While you're figuring out your... relationship issues...
strings.9_village_brothers_heffry_10: Tell him I want to be his brother again.
strings.9_village_brothers_heffry_2: Could you give me your fishing rod?
strings.9_village_brothers_heffry_4: Uhh... maybe Jeffry knows where it is. He's the smart one.
strings.9_village_brothers_heffry_6: Down the road... then turn... uhh...
strings.9_village_brothers_heffry_8: Uhh... not to the bridge... behind the tree...
strings.9_village_brothers_jeffry_1: Hi... your brother told me you know where the fishing rod is.
strings.9_village_brothers_jeffry_10: We sank the boat with some pottery... meant for Herm...
strings.9_village_brothers_jeffry_11: Ok, I can make pottery for you. And you can go find that fishing rod.
strings.9_village_brothers_jeffry_12: I'll go to him. We'll be waiting for the pottery.
strings.9_village_brothers_jeffry_2: Oh yeah... the rod... it's somewhere... I can't remember... too much stress...
strings.9_village_brothers_jeffry_5: How's Heffry getting by without me?
strings.9_village_brothers_jeffry_6: But — you only just left. Whatever...
strings.9_village_brothers_jeffry_7: He misses you. He wants you to be his brother again.
strings.9_village_brothers_jeffry_8: We're both just too nervous. It's all on account of the pottery...
strings.9_village_brothers_pottery_4: Take this fishing rod. As a thank you.
strings.ach_agatha_herbert_d: Agatha and Herbert have found common ground.
strings.ach_alchemist_25_d: You've brewed 25 potions. The eyebrows will grow back.
strings.ach_alcohol_100_d: You have produced 100 bottles of alcohol... Handle with care.
strings.ach_biuld_houses_d: You've restored all the houses in the Town. It's never looked so good!
strings.ach_build_market_stalls_d: You built all the market stalls in the Town.
strings.ach_bury_bodies_d: You've buried 50 corpses! Now you are The True Graveyard Keeper!

strings.intro_prison_note_note:
Ever since that immortal prisoner arrived, everything has gone to pot. None of the scouting parties have returned. I’m all alone. I’ll try getting into the Citadel at the outskirts of the city. If there’s any way to save everyone, it must be there.

P.S. I left a spare key, the royal signet, and an Inquisitor medallion in the wall stash. At least they'll go to someone who can read...

strings.note_lab_tower_note: Today I had a strange dream... I can't understand it, but I feel the sudden urge to hide all this in a chest and flee the base.
strings.note_resurrection_note: The dead are not as quiet as we once believed. A strong electrical charge appears capable of restarting a corpse. The body may walk again, though the results are... unpredictable. Is it science? Is it heresy? That depends on who is asking.
strings.nun_asking_about_corpses_many_1: Let's hope people die fast enough.

strings.perk_alchemist_d: If it smells disturbing, then you're on the right track. Sometimes alchemy yields more items.
strings.perk_artist_d: Is it just a piece of stone? For you, it’s art. You gain a quality bonus when crafting statues and decorations.
strings.perk_axeman_d: The axe is your friend, and it’s a sharp friend! You sometimes get extra logs when chopping trees. You can also make more firewood and wedges from logs. Chopping wood is so relaxing!
strings.perk_bellmaster_d: The bell rings for the Keeper! You can restart fights on the same day.
strings.perk_beltmaster_d: You know how to keep things rolling. Your zombies produce more <sprite name="gear">.
strings.perk_blacksmith_d: You enjoy working with red-hot iron. Hammering relaxes you. When the work is done, you always find time to make some extra nails.
strings.perk_bookworm_d:
You've read so many books that writing one seems easier.

+4 <sprite name="talent_yellow"> when writing books.
strings.perk_brewer_d: Brewing beer isn’t an addiction. You just make more of it.
strings.perk_builder_d: Who says cutting corners is a bad thing? You recover some resources when restoring buildings.
strings.perk_butcher_d: You know how to handle meat. Non-critical failures leave organs intact.
strings.perk_cardinal_d: The church isn't just a triumph of the spirit. It's also a collection of buildings and properties. You've learned to manage them, so ceremonies give you extra money.
strings.perk_carpenter_d: You know how to work with wood! Circular saws are more productive in your hands. You also find the work very relaxing.
strings.perk_chimera_d: Anything can become a work of art. Your organ improvement crafting improves.
strings.perk_church_materialist_d:
Faith may move mountains, but candles help too.

+4 <sprite name="talent_blue"> when crafting church supplies.
strings.perk_compost_chemist_d: You overcame your disgust, and mastered the finer points of fermentation: yields more fertilizer.
strings.perk_cook_2_d: How dare you cook so well? You create extra portions of complex dishes.
strings.perk_cook_d: It’s not haute cuisine, but there’s plenty of it. You create extra portions of basic dishes.
strings.perk_cremator_d: The hottest job in town. Receive more rewards for cremating corpses.

strings.perk_dark_wraith_sloth_d: Calm can be deadly... or are the cobwebs putting gloomy thoughts into your head again?

+4 <sprite name="talent_blue"> when working at an Autopsy Table.

strings.perk_extra_overhead_2_d: The pile is getting dangerously ambitious. Carry even more items on your head.
strings.perk_extra_overhead_3_d: At this point, you're basically a walking warehouse. Carry a huge number of items on your head.

strings.perk_farmer_d: You're not afraid of getting your hands dirty. You can pick better seeds and harvest bigger crops.
strings.perk_fireman_d: The dancing flame fascinates you. You know how to increase productivity, and smelt more ore per load.
strings.perk_fishcutter_d: There’s no such thing as a small fish... you just need to cut it right. You get more fillets.
strings.perk_fisherman_d: You know how to handle your fishing rod. Now it’s stronger than ever.

Every mystery deserves another questionable experiment.

You've come to appreciate the wonders that come of a sealed barrel and a little patience.

Your hands are so calloused, splinters break against your skin, not inside it.

Paper doesn't grow on trees anymore.

strings.quest_open_14_guard_faith_bring_d: Bring Faith to Herbert to boost the morale of the guards. He's at the Crossroads.

strings.quest_open_150_base_90not_god_d: It seems I cannot convince the six. It's time to ask the Old God in the attic what to do.
strings.quest_open_151_base_90yes_god_d: I convinced the six. It's time to speak with the Old God in Mauritzio’s cheese cellar.
strings.quest_open_152_astrologer_dark_come_d: Something strange is happening. Visit Jack and Gunter in the Port Area near the Main Pier.
strings.quest_open_152_astrologer_dark_hand_d: Bring an Elegant Hand to Jack in the Port Area near the Main Pier.
strings.quest_open_153_crossroad_dark_chair_d: Bring a Comfortable Chair to Agatha at the Crossroads.
strings.quest_open_153_crossroad_dark_come_d: Something strange is happening. Visit Agatha and Herbert at the Crossroads.
strings.quest_open_154_linda_dark_come_d: Something strange is happening. Visit Linda and Albert at the Dockside Club.
strings.quest_open_154_linda_dark_drape_d: Bring Luxury Drapes to Albert at the Dockside Club.
strings.quest_open_155_guards_bridge_ask_d: Speak with Herbert in the Barracks about the plan to fight through to the woodcarvers.
strings.quest_open_156_base_pieces_sixth_d: Find the sixth portal fragment. It is somewhere in the debris in the Inquisition Base.
strings.quest_open_157_base_palace_ask_d: Speak with Davy the Dagger at the Dockside Club.
strings.quest_open_157_base_palace_home_d: Go home and wait for Davy the Dagger to provide information about the Palace.
strings.quest_open_157_base_palace_pay_d: Pay Davy the Dagger for the intel about the Palace. He frequents the Dockside Club.
strings.quest_open_158_astrologer_palace_help_d: Ask Jack and Gunter to help you restore the portal. They're in the Port Area near the Main Pier.
strings.quest_open_158_astrologer_palace_press_d: Give the Small Printing Press to Gunter in the Port Area near the Main Pier.
strings.quest_open_158_astrologer_palace_prothes: Bring the Prosthetic Hand to Jack. He's with his friend at the Port by the Main Pier.
strings.quest_open_159_crossroad_palace_device_d: Bring the Automatic Writing Device to Agatha at the Crossroads.
strings.quest_open_159_crossroad_palace_help_d: Ask Agatha and Herbert to help you restore the portal. They live at the Crossroads.
strings.quest_open_159_crossroad_palace_trilogy_: Bring the Trilogy to Herbert at the Crossroads.
strings.quest_open_15_guards_fightback_prepare_1: Speak with Herbert in front of the Barracks to begin the battle.
strings.quest_open_15_guards_fightback_win_d: Win my first battle against the zombies.
strings.quest_open_160_linda_palace_bottles_d: Bring Bottles to Albert at the Dockside Club.
strings.quest_open_160_linda_palace_chocolate_d: Bring Chocolate to Linda at the Dockside Club.
strings.quest_open_160_linda_palace_help_d: Ask Linda and Albert to help you restore the portal. They're at the Dockside Club.
strings.quest_open_162_village_pardon_ask_d: Get a Royal Pardon from the Mailbox in the Village.
strings.quest_open_162_village_pardon_ink_d: Refill the ink in the Village Mailbox.
strings.quest_open_162_village_pardon_pay_d: Pay the fine to the Village Mailbox.
strings.quest_open_163_village_fish_bring_d: Catch a fish and bring it to Herm at his store. There's a couple of fishing spots: one to the left of the house at the Inquisition Base, and another along the road to the Village.
strings.quest_open_163_village_fish_rod_d: Get a fishing rod from the Twin Brothers. They're somewhere in the southern part of the village, over the bridge in Twins’ Land.
strings.quest_open_16_foreman_letter_wake_d: I need to wait for news from Jack. Some rest would help too.
strings.quest_open_17_village_nun_tavern_d: Go to the Village Tavern to meet the Nun.
strings.quest_open_18_base_doctor_closed_d: Open the closed hatch in your new home.
strings.quest_open_18_base_doctor_encounter_d: Go down into the dungeon under your house.
strings.quest_open_19_base_ceremony_quality_d: Upgrade the church so the Nun can deliver sermons there. She's already there waiting.
strings.quest_open_19_base_ceremony_sermon_d: It turns out I'll need to give the sermons in the Church myself.
strings.quest_open_20_doctor_meeting_blockage_d: Get rid of the blockage in the dungeon under your house.
strings.quest_open_20_doctor_meeting_door_d: Knock on the Plague Doctor's door.
strings.quest_open_22_doctor_tower_door_d: Open the prison bars into the Abandoned Tower.
strings.quest_open_22_doctor_tower_hatch_d: Open the hatch and let the Plague Doctor into the tower.
strings.quest_open_22_doctor_tower_powder_d: Ask the Plague Doctor in the Abandoned Tower how to make Dream Dust.
strings.quest_open_23_guards_mercenaries_hire_d: Pay the mercenaries in the Barracks to fight in the next battle.
strings.quest_open_23_guards_mercenaries_meet_d: There's mercenaries in the Barracks. I need to make a deal with them.
strings.quest_open_24_doctor_zombies_lab_0_d: Follow Albert using the hatch in the Alchemy Lab.
strings.quest_open_24_doctor_zombies_powder_d: Bring the Dream Dust to the Plague Doctor in the Abandoned Tower.
strings.quest_open_26_port_foreman_reunite_d: Find Jack — he must be in the Port Area, in the liberated part of the Town.
strings.quest_open_27_port_astrologer_cards_d: Bring the tarot cards to the Astrologer in his tower. To find the cards, I need to speak with Linda, the hostess of the Dockside Club at the Port.
strings.quest_open_27_port_astrologer_meet_d: Find the Astrologer at the port, he's somewhere in the tower there.
strings.quest_open_27_port_astrologer_wait_d: To summon the Fairy, I need the Astrologer. He's somewhere in the Town Port. So first I'll need to help Herbert liberate the Town.
strings.quest_open_27_port_astrologer_zombie_get: Get zombies from the Astrologer in his tower.
strings.quest_open_27_port_astrologer_zombie_hom: Gunter said his zombies will be waiting for me at home. Time to go check.
strings.quest_open_28_base_fairy_summon_d: Summon the Fairy in your home by the Kitchen table. But first find a way to Town with the help of Herbert. The Astrologer lives there, who sells Comet's Tails.
strings.quest_open_29_port_linda_meet_d: Meet Linda, the hostess of the Dockside Club at the Port.
strings.quest_open_31_forest_guards_pass_d: Jack says there's iron in the forest. I guess it's time to take a look. The forest is West of the Village.
strings.quest_open_32_guards_book_bring_d: Herbert was sad. Speak with him in the Barracks.
strings.quest_open_34_port_looters_book_d: Bring looter keys to Davy the Dagger at the Dockside Club.
strings.quest_open_34_port_looters_meet_d: Ask the mysterious person at the Dockside Club about a romance novel.
strings.quest_open_35_port_pop_repair_d: Restore the old shop at the Port near the Dockside Club.
strings.quest_open_35_port_pop_shop_d: Tell Linda that you restored the old shop.
strings.quest_open_36_port_trademaster_lenses_d: Bring the optic glass to the Manager at the Main Pier.
strings.quest_open_37_village_forest_pass_d: The guards won't let me into the forest. I should ask Jully in the Village Tavern about it.
strings.quest_open_38_village_mailbox_certificat: Get the Head of Village Certificate from the Royal Postbox.
strings.quest_open_38_village_mailbox_repair_d: Jully asked me to fix the village's Royal Postbox. It's by the Village Tavern.
strings.quest_open_39_village_frill_bring_d: Bring Herm some lace. He's at his store in the Village.
strings.quest_open_40_village_fishing_bring_d: Bring the fishing line to the Twin Brothers. They have their own land in the Village.
strings.quest_open_41_forest_bonfire_food_d: I should bring some yummies to the guards by the fire. They gather every night near the Hangman's House.
strings.quest_open_42_crossroad_nun_donkey_d: Ask Agatha what her problem is with the Donkey. She lives at the Crossroads.
strings.quest_open_42_crossroad_nun_writing_d: Bring writing supplies to Agatha, the Nun. She lives at the Crossroads.
strings.quest_open_43_astrologer_pr_after_ceremo: Meet Gunter after your next Ceremony.
strings.quest_open_43_astrologer_pr_tower_d: Ask the Astrologer why your parishioners are losing interest in the sermons. He can be found in the Astrologer's Tower.
strings.quest_open_44_port_violine_paint_d: Bring Linda some paint to freshen up her Dockside Club at the Port.
strings.quest_open_45_guards_reading_book_d: Procure the Romance Novel through a mysterious person in the Dockside Club. Then bring it to Herbert in the Barracks.
strings.quest_open_46_pre_A_fights_clean_d: I should tell Herbert that the first region of Town is clear and secured.
strings.quest_open_47_pre_A2_fights_before_1_d: To win the next battle, I need to speak with the guards at the outpost.
strings.quest_open_51_crossroad_fixed_corpse_del: Speak with Agatha at the Crossroads to restore corpse delivery.
strings.quest_open_51_crossroad_fixed_graveyard_: Improve the Graveyard and return to Agatha at the Crossroads.
strings.quest_open_51_crossroad_fixed_path_compl: Fix the Manhole at the Crossroad, and report to Agatha at her nearby residence.
strings.quest_open_52_village_pass_ask_d: Get a Forest Pass from Jully. He stays at the Village Tavern. I just need to ask Januarius to call him.
strings.quest_open_52_village_pass_papers_d: Deliver the Temporary Head of Village Certificate to Jully in the Village Tavern.
strings.quest_open_53_forest_pass_return_d: Show the Forest Pass to the guards at the Forest Outpost.
strings.quest_open_55_base_strike_donkey_d: Tell Donkey that he can continue bringing corpses. He's likely by the Graveyard, in front of the Morgue.
strings.quest_open_56_forest_pardon_give_d: Bring the royal pardon to the Bandits at their Forest Camp.
strings.quest_open_57_forest_mine_candle_d: Give Larry a candle. He's probably at home, or somewhere in the Inquisition Base.
strings.quest_open_57_forest_mine_convince_d: Persuade Larry the skull to impersonate Robert the skeleton. Larry is probably at home, or somewhere in the Inquisition Base.
strings.quest_open_58_port_supplies_order_d: I need to fulfill Orders, and then talk to Jack in the Town Warehouse.
strings.quest_open_60_port_workshop_free_d: I need to clear the zombies around Jack's workshop, and then bring him the good news. He's staying at the Town Warehouse.
strings.quest_open_61_after_clearing_A_complete_: Win every battle on this side of the river.
strings.quest_open_62_swamp_fairy_find_d: I need to find a way to the Swamp. Apparently I need to enter the Forest, and then head south.
strings.quest_open_63_swamp_goddess_speak_d: Go to the Heart of the Swamp and meet the Goddess.
strings.quest_open_64_doctor_violine_ask_d: Ask the Plague Doctor about his sister's violin for Linda. He's always in his Lab in the dungeon under my house.
strings.quest_open_65_doctor_lacquer_give_d: Bring wood varnish for the violin to Plague Doctor, in his Lab in the dungeon under my house.
strings.quest_open_66_port_smell_violine_d: I have the violin. I just need to give it to Linda at her Dockside Club.
strings.quest_open_67_port_incense_give_d: Bring some incense to Linda at her Dockside Club.
strings.quest_open_68_port_concert_start_d: Everything is ready for the concert. Speak with Linda at her Dockside Club.
strings.quest_open_69_doctor_project_ask_d: I need to speak to Albert. He's always in his Lab in the dungeon under my house.
strings.quest_open_6_intro_guards_burial_d: Bring a Burial Certificate to Herbert, head of the guards. He's at the Crossroads.
strings.quest_open_71_doctor_sister_corpse_d: Albert needs a really good zombie. Like with 8 <sprite name="rskull">! I need to place it in a special spot in the Plague's Doctor Lab.
strings.quest_open_72_crossroad_reader_convence_: Ask Agatha, the Nun, if she can read for Herbert. She lives at the Crossroads.
strings.quest_open_73_crossroad_better_corpses_d: Speak with Agatha at the Crossroads to get better corpses.
strings.quest_open_73_crossroad_better_upgraded_: I need to improve the Crossroads by bringing materials to Agatha.
strings.quest_open_74_crossroad_chore_ceremony_d: Hold a ceremony at the Church.
strings.quest_open_74_crossroad_chore_ready_d: Assemble a Choir at the Church, and then tell Agatha at the Crossroads.
strings.quest_open_75_forest_explosives_take_d: Get the explosives from the Bandits. They're at their camp in the Forest.
strings.quest_open_76_astrologer_press_ceremony_: Hold a sermon to try out the new Hypno-device.
strings.quest_open_76_astrologer_press_hypno_d: Buy a Hypno-device from the Astrologer in his Tower, charge it in the Abandoned Tower, and return it to him.
strings.quest_open_77_astrologer_printing_book_d: Print the Poetry Book and bring it to the Astrologer in his tower.
strings.quest_open_78_astrologer_jack_signed_d: Bring the signed agreement to the Astrologer in his Tower.
strings.quest_open_79_village_goddess_speak_d: Ask Jully to help with the ritual for the Goddess in the Swamp. He's staying at the Village Tavern. I just need to ask Januarius to call him.
strings.quest_open_7_village_head_meet_d: Talk to the Head of the Village, collect the money for the Burial Certificate, and ask about fairies. Look for him in the Village Tavern.
strings.quest_open_80_village_candidates_plan_d: Speak with Januarius about candidates for the Village election. He's in the Tavern.
strings.quest_open_81_guards_elections_ask_d: Speak with Herbert in Barracks about security during the elections.
strings.quest_open_81_guards_elections_convince_: Convince Herbert in the Barracks to handle security for the elections.
strings.quest_open_82_port_elections_ask_d: Ask Linda at her Dockside Club for permission to use her place as a voting site.
strings.quest_open_82_port_elections_convince_d: Convince Linda at her Dockside Club to allow her place to be used as a voting site.
strings.quest_open_83_astrologer_elections_ask_d: Speak with the Astrologer in his Tower about a PR campaign for the elections.
strings.quest_open_83_astrologer_elections_convi: Convince the Astrologer in his Tower about a PR campaign for the elections.
strings.quest_open_84_astrologer_necronomicon_as: Speak with the Astrologer in his tower about the Necronomicon.
strings.quest_open_84_astrologer_necronomicon_ge: Return to the Astrologer's Tower and ask him about the Necronomicon again.
strings.quest_open_85_guards_reader_tell_d: Tell Herbert that Agatha will read for him. He's in the Barracks.
strings.quest_open_86_port_notebook_speak_d: Speak with Linda in Dockside Club after concert.
strings.quest_open_87_doctor_linda_ask_albert_d: Go see Albert in his Lab in the dungeon under my house.
strings.quest_open_87_doctor_linda_ask_linda_d: Pay a visit to Linda at her Dockside Club at the Port.
strings.quest_open_87_doctor_linda_get_out_d: Give Albert and Linda some time alone.
strings.quest_open_87_doctor_linda_notebook_d: Bring a notebook to Linda at the Dockside Club. The best gift?
strings.quest_open_87_doctor_linda_sleep_d: After some time, visit Linda and Albert again.
strings.quest_open_87_doctor_linda_visit_tell_d: Again, ask Albert if Linda can come visit him. He's always in his Lab in the dungeon under my house.
strings.quest_open_87_doctor_linda_visit_try_d: Ask Albert if Linda can come visit him. He's always in his Lab in the dungeon under my house.
strings.quest_open_88_larry_portal_ask_d: Ask Larry about the portal. He must be at home.
strings.quest_open_89_astrologer_portal_ask_d: Ask Gunter about the portal. He lives in his Astrologer's Tower.
strings.quest_open_8_village_trader_meet_d: Ask the Merchant about helping supply the village. His name is Herm, just like the name of his store.
strings.quest_open_90_village_elections_ready_d: Go to the Village Tavern for the election. Who will win — Jeffry or Heffry?
strings.quest_open_91_linda_cough_ask_d: Speak with Linda about Albert's health. She's always at her Dockside Club.
strings.quest_open_92_doctor_cure_tell_d: It seems we found a remedy for Albert's cough. I should speak with him in his Lab.
strings.quest_open_93_linda_potato_give_d: Bring the po-ta-to to Linda in her Dockside Club. It should help Albert's cough.
strings.quest_open_94_crossroad_reputation_ask_d: I should find out more from Agatha about the precarious state of her reputation. She lives at the Crossroads.
strings.quest_open_95_guards_organ_tell_d: I tell Herbert in the Barracks that I finished the organ.
strings.quest_open_96_crossroad_organ_build_d: Build an Organ for the Church. I'll need special wood from the Stilt Houses.
strings.quest_open_96_crossroad_organ_tell_d: I should speak with Agatha at the Crossroads about the new organ at the church.
strings.quest_open_98_workshop_tunnel_ask_d: Ask Jack about the water tunnel to the Royal Foundry. He's at the Town Workshop.
strings.quest_open_98_workshop_tunnel_ask_portal: Ask Jack about the Water Tunnel.
strings.quest_open_99_workshop_repair_contract_d: Ask Jack to be frontman for the Restore the Town campaign. He's probably in the Town Warehouse or Town Workshop.
strings.quest_open_99_workshop_repair_material_1: Provide Jack with materials to help him to restore his workshop. He's normally there.
strings.quest_open_9_village_brothers_discussion: Find the twin brothers. They're somewhere in the southern part of the village, over the bridge in Twins’ Land.
strings.quest_open_9_village_brothers_heffry_d: Ask Heffry what happened. He's in Twin's Land.
strings.quest_open_9_village_brothers_jeffry_d: Talk to Jeffry and make peace between the twins. He's further along in the southern part of the village, near the Hangman's House.
strings.quest_open_9_village_brothers_pottery_d: Bring pottery to the twins. They're in their land.

strings.tt_alchemy_2: Add ingredients to split them into alchemy runes
strings.tt_alchemy_6:
Alchemy properties

To craft something new, you need to discover its formula
(<sprite name="rune_r"> + <sprite name="rune_g"> + <sprite name="rune_b">).

All the formulas you've discovered are recorded in the [Folio].
strings.tt_alchemy_flasks:
Available flasks

Add flasks to the shelf to increase this number.
strings.tt_craft_fire:
Available fuel

Stock the firewood shed to increase supply.
strings.tt_factory_gears: Add zombies to zombie carousels to get more <sprite name="gear">.
strings.tt_garden_4:
Additional yield

Awarded when progress reaches this point.
strings.tt_garden_6:
Crop quality requirement

Minimum requirement for base yield. Exceeding this value gets more growth per tick.
strings.tt_grave_1:
Grave quality

<sprite name="skull"> + <sprite name="wr"> = <sprite name="wskull">

The quality of each grave contributes to the total graveyard quality.
strings.tt_prefight_2: Your total power / Minimum required power
strings.tt_study_faith: Total in your inventory and storage.
strings.tt_study_science: Get more by studying and decomposing items that contain <sprite name="science">, like [Paper] and [Science kits].
strings.tt_town_happiness: Get <sprite name="happiness"> from [Town Gratitude], trading special items, and completing town orders.
strings.tt_trade_hap_bar:
Current progress to the next <sprite name="happiness">.

Sell items with the <sprite name="happiness"> label. Once it reaches 100%, you gain +<sprite name="happiness">.

Vendors only need a limited number of each item every week.
strings.tt_trade_hap_likes:
Maximum <sprite name="happiness"> you can get from this vendor this week.

Resets every <sprite name="day_pride">
strings.tt_zombie_2: Use these to obtain new perks
strings.tt_zombie_3:
Determined by body parts.
Each <sprite name="rskull"> unlocks a perk slot.
strings.tut_alchemy_craft: Crafting alchemical recipes requires <sprite name="alchemy_flask">. You'll need to load them in the Flask shelf.
strings.tut_alchemy_folio: All the formulas you've discovered are recorded in the Folio.
strings.tut_alchemy_items: Items with <sprite name="rune_r">, <sprite name="rune_g">, or <sprite name="rune_b"> are used to craft alchemical recipes.
strings.tut_alchemy_mech: You'll also need the exact amount of <sprite name="rune_r">, <sprite name="rune_g">, and <sprite name="rune_b"> from your ingredients.
strings.tut_alchemy_price:
Crafting alchemical recipes requires <sprite name="alchemy_flask"> and <sprite name="fire">.
You also need the exact amount of <sprite name="rune_r">, <sprite name="rune_g">, and <sprite name="rune_b"> from your ingredients.
strings.tut_alchemy_properties: Some items have alchemical properties: <sprite name="rune_r">, <sprite name="rune_g">, and <sprite name="rune_b">.
strings.tut_alchemy_science: Spend <sprite name="science"> to study items at the Study Table. Studying items is rewarded with <sprite name="tech_red">, <sprite name="tech_green">, and <sprite name="tech_blue">.
strings.tut_alchemy_survey: Study can also uncover the alchemical properties from some items: <sprite name="rune_r">, <sprite name="rune_g">, and <sprite name="rune_b">.
strings.tut_battle_banner: To command a squad, pick up and carry their banner. You can lead them, or leave them to defend a position.
strings.tut_battle_bars: During battle, watch the bars at the top to know when and where the zombies will attack.
strings.tut_battle_build: To prepare for battle, build defensive structures near your base.
strings.tut_battle_defense: <sprite name="barracks"> are provided by defensive structures and your troops from the barracks.
strings.tut_battle_flag: To capture a flag, defeat nearby enemies and hold the position. The more troops near a flag, the faster you'll capture it.
strings.tut_battle_lose: If enemies capture your base, or your health runs out, you lose.
strings.tut_battle_start: Start a battle by interacting with the guard post.
strings.tut_battle_swords: Each battle has a <sprite name="barracks"> requirement.
strings.tut_battle_win: To win, capture all the enemy flags, and hold them until the battle ends.
strings.tut_commerce_day: You can only accept town orders on <sprite name="day_pride">. Completing them rewards <sprite name="happiness"> and <sprite name="brz-m"><sprite name="slv-m"><sprite name="gld-m">.
strings.tut_commerce_delivery: Deliver the required goods to the Town Warehouse to complete orders. You can sell extra goods there for money.
strings.tut_commerce_urgent: There are different orders. Urgent ones <sprite name="icon_time"> must be completed in full within one week.
strings.tut_craft_auto: After selecting a recipe, you need to craft it. Some workbenches automatically craft over time <sprite name="cell_time"> using fuel <sprite name="fire">.
strings.tut_craft_extensions: Advanced items require special extensions to the workbench.
strings.tut_craft_req:
Crafts requires ingredients, <sprite name="energy">,
and <sprite name="talent_orange">/<sprite name="talent_red">/<sprite name="talent_green">/<sprite name="talent_yellow">/<sprite name="talent_blue">.
strings.tut_craft_star: Some recipes are <sprite name="icon_star">. Results vary based on ingredients and talent. The higher your talent, the better the quality of your crafted items.
strings.tut_craft_workbench: You can craft any recipe you know at the corresponding workbench.
strings.tut_energy_1:
Some actions in the game spend your [Energy].

Crafting, gathering, and fighting take energy.
strings.tut_energy_2:
Certain tasks or exhaustion produce <sprite name="insanity">. 
Insanity reduces your maximum <sprite name="energy">.
strings.tut_energy_3: You can always refill your energy with [Food] and [Potions]. Just right-click to use them from your inventory.
strings.tut_energy_4: [Sleeping] will also restore your <sprite name="energy"> and probably reduce <sprite name="insanity">.
strings.tut_energy_spend: You spend <sprite name="energy"> on various actions.
strings.tut_factory_gear: <sprite name="gear"> limits your Factory's capacity. Operate more Carousels to increase it.
strings.tut_factory_town: The Factory allows you to fully automate town supplies, including both production and delivery.
strings.tut_factory_work: Factory workstations need zombies to work, and must be linked by conveyor belts.
strings.tut_farming_seeds: To plant seeds, take them from your inventory. Planting costs 4 seeds.
strings.tut_farming_talent: The higher your and bed's <sprite name="talent_green">, the greater the harvest.
strings.tut_fishing_bait: First, select your bait — although sometimes you can fish without it. Once you get a bite, quickly press  to start the minigame.
strings.tut_fishing_bite: When you get a bite, quickly press  to start the minigame.
strings.tut_fishing_game: During the minigame, hold  to reel the fish in. Avoid pulling when the fish is fighting back, or the line will snap. If you're having trouble catching fish, increase your <sprite name="talent_green">.
strings.tut_fishing_spots: You can fish at designated spots.
strings.tut_fishing_talent: If you're having trouble catching fish, increase your <sprite name="talent_green">.
strings.tut_grave_1: Use the [blueprint desk] at the graveyard. Mark a site for the grave, then dig it with your shovel.
strings.tut_grave_1_1: Use the Blueprint Desk to mark a site for the grave, then dig it with your shovel.
strings.tut_grave_1_2: Put the corpse in the grave. Bury it, and mark it with a sign. Later you can unlock better headstones and fences.
strings.tut_grave_2: Carefully put the body (or what remains of it) in the grave. And bury it.
strings.tut_insanity_generate: Some actions generate <sprite name="insanity">. When you are tired, any action will generate <sprite name="insanity">.
strings.tut_insanity_spend: Sleeping when you're tired is the best way to reduce <sprite name="insanity">.
strings.tut_insp_talents_insp: By performing various actions, you earn different inspirations: <sprite name="inspiration_point-orange">, <sprite name="inspiration_point-red">, <sprite name="inspiration_point-green">, <sprite name="inspiration_point-yellow">, and <sprite name="inspiration_point-blue">.
strings.tut_insp_talents_talents: Inspiration points can be spent on perks and increasing talents: <sprite name="talent_orange">, <sprite name="talent_red">, <sprite name="talent_green">, <sprite name="talent_yellow">, and <sprite name="talent_blue">.
strings.tut_modules_limited: There's a limited number of modules.
strings.tut_modules_place: Place a module first, then build on it.
strings.tut_pr_machine_cap: There's a limit to how many zombies you can have. To create more zombies, use the PR Machine.
strings.tut_pr_machine_charge: Place Newspapers and Charged Hypno Devices on the PR Machine every <sprite name="day_gluttony"> to increase the limit for the week.
strings.tut_pr_machine_debuff: Exceeding the zombie limit will give you a debuff until the limit is met.
strings.tut_resurrection_day:
Here you can resurrect zombies every <sprite name="day_envy">.
Prepare everything in advance.
strings.tut_resurrection_device: During <sprite name="day_envy"> the room is powered. Use the Resurrection Device to bring zombies back to life.
strings.tut_resurrection_power: Place a corpse on the table with Reanimation Liquid, <sprite name="faith">, and a Zombie Collar.
strings.tut_resurrection_room: Here you can resurrect corpses. For zombies, more <sprite name="rskull"> is better.
strings.tut_resurrection_skulls: For zombies, more <sprite name="rskull"> and fewer <sprite name="skull"> is better.
strings.tut_sermons_day: Every <sprite name="day_wrath"> you can hold a sermon at the Church.
strings.tut_sermons_likes:
Earn <sprite name="happiness"> by completing quests and orders.
The better the ceremony, the more <sprite name="happiness_cross"> its success requires.
strings.tut_sermons_parishioners: Sermons spend <sprite name="happiness"> and require <sprite name="cross">. The lower of the two — <sprite name="happiness_cross"> — determines how many parishioners attend.
strings.tut_sermons_reward: The better the ceremony is, the more <sprite name="happiness_cross"> it requires to be successful.
strings.tut_skulls_1: Human remains each have their own unique spiritual attributes. A corpse gets its <sprite name="rskull"><sprite name="skull"> from its body parts. You can change a corpse's <sprite name="rskull"><sprite name="skull"> by removing organs and embalming.
strings.tut_skulls_2: The main way to increase your graveyard's <sprite name="wskull"> is to decorate graves with objects that have more <sprite name="wr">.
strings.tut_skulls_3: Lines that have both <sprite name="skull"> and <sprite name="wr">, counts as one <sprite name="wskull">. Lines that have <sprite name="rskull"> never count, but you'll need to fill them with <sprite name="wr"> to reach <sprite name="skull"> lines.
strings.tut_squad_equipment: Zombies only fight if equipped with armor and a pike or bow.
strings.tut_squad_form: To form a squad, bring zombies to the Barracks and put them in a Squad Slot.
strings.tut_squad_mercenaries: You can use your own Zombie Squads in future fights, and continue hiring mercenaries.
strings.tut_squad_multiple: As you progress through the story, you'll be able to use more Squads in a fight.
strings.tut_squad_own: You can now form your own Zombie Squads.
strings.tut_squad_quality: The better your zombies' equipment, the higher the <sprite name="barracks">.
strings.tut_squad_unlock: To unlock a Squad Slot, talk to Battle Ram in the Barracks.
strings.tut_survey_science: Get <sprite name="science"> from decomposing special items at the Study Table.
strings.tut_tech_1: To craft new items, you'll need to unlock the relevant technology. This costs tech points. (Press  to open the technology tree.)
strings.tut_tech_2: Red points represent your hand-crafting skills, and your ability to work with materials.
strings.tut_tech_3: Green points represent your knowledge about the nature of things and nature itself.
strings.tut_tech_4: Blue points represent your spiritual knowledge of the immaterial world. You'll get your first <sprite name="tech_blue"> at the [Study Table] in the Church basement.
strings.tut_tech_5: You earn points simply by doing things. You can also earn points by studying new items at this special table.
strings.tut_tech_hidden: Some skills are hidden, or require a certain reputation with another character.
strings.tut_tech_price: This costs <sprite name="tech_red">, <sprite name="tech_green">, and <sprite name="tech_blue">.
strings.tut_tech_unlock: Unlock new technologies in the Tech Tree. This costs <sprite name="tech_red">, <sprite name="tech_green">, and <sprite name="tech_blue">.
strings.tut_town_building: Reclaimed town areas can be restored by building houses and shops.
strings.tut_town_houses: Houses give Green Scrolls. Deliver them to Linda every <sprite name="day_lust"> to increase <sprite name="reputation-citizens"> and your maximum <sprite name="happiness"> limit.
strings.tut_town_shops: Shops unlock new merchants and town orders, while increasing <sprite name="village_REP">. Town orders are the main source of <sprite name="happiness">.
strings.tut_trading_change: Prices are dynamic: more the merchant has, less the prices.
strings.tut_trading_likes: You can also earn <sprite name="happiness"> by trading certain special goods.
strings.tut_trading_money: Trading gives you access to various items, and it's a great way to earn <sprite name="brz-m">, <sprite name="slv-m">, and <sprite name="gld-m">.
strings.tut_trading_restock: Merchant stocks refresh over time. You can also upgrade a merchant to expand their inventory.
strings.tut_trading_special: Every merchant has their own goods to buy and sell, some special just to them.
strings.tut_zombie_work_supply: Zombie suppliers deliver needed items to workstation zombies, and load items onto workbenches for auto-crafting.
strings.tut_zombie_work_talents: Zombie workers have their own talent levels <sprite name="talent_orange">, <sprite name="talent_red">, <sprite name="talent_green">,<sprite name="talent_yellow">, <sprite name="talent_blue"> and perks that can also be upgraded. They can also use equipment.
strings.tut_zombie_work_work: Place zombie workers at workstations to assign them different jobs and crafting tasks.
strings.tut_zone_quality_different: Different locations can have their own quality.
strings.tut_zone_quality_icons: For example, the graveyard uses <sprite name="wr">.
strings.tut_zone_quality_improve: Build, repair, and clean to improve quality.
strings.tutorial_autopsy_1: With a special autopsy table, you can remove or reattach different... "parts".
strings.tutorial_autopsy_2: Working with the various parts requires various skills. There's always a chance that a procedure might fail.
strings.tutorial_autopsy_3: You can check what skulls each part contributes. If you can’t see it right now, you may need to learn the relevant skill.
strings.tutorial_autopsy_graveyard: For the graveyard, it's better to have more <sprite name="skull"> and fewer <sprite name="rskull">.
strings.tutorial_autopsy_items: Advanced organs need higher <sprite name="talent_blue">. Then you can fill the progress bar enough to extract the organ <sprite name="organ_hrt">, and avoid surgeon's error <sprite name="organ_mis_hrt">.
strings.tutorial_autopsy_work: Extract and replace organs to change the body's <sprite name="skull"> and <sprite name="rskull">.
strings.tutorial_graveyard_place: To build more graves, unlock new Graveyard modules in the Tech Tree and place them.
strings.tutorial_graveyard_put: Decorate each grave to increase its quality <sprite name="wskull">. Each <sprite name="skull"> increases the maximum quality, while each <sprite name="rskull"> reduces it.
strings.tutorial_insp_complete: Performing various actions earns different inspirations.
strings.tutorial_insp_points: There are various inspirations: <sprite name="inspiration_point-orange">, <sprite name="inspiration_point-red">, <sprite name="inspiration_point-green">, <sprite name="inspiration_point-yellow">, and <sprite name="inspiration_point-blue">.
strings.tutorial_questslog_1: You can check your current tasks in the Story Tree. Tasks are separated into different story branches.
strings.tutorial_questslog_2: It’s a good idea to complete your current tasks, to unlock new ones...
strings.tutorial_questslog_3: Hopefully, there’s a happy ending somewhere to the right.
strings.tutorial_questslog_finish: You can always view the information for each quest.
strings.tutorial_questslog_info: Quests show which characters are important for the quest.
strings.tutorial_questslog_track: Some quests have various stages you need to complete before it's finished.
strings.tutorial_seremons_1: You can develop and perform different ceremonies, each offering unique rewards and bonuses.
strings.tutorial_seremons_2: More sophisticated ceremonies require more developed skills and higher church quality. A successful ceremony also requires attendees.
strings.tutorial_seremons_3: A well-maintained graveyard raises ceremony profits.
strings.ui_alchemy_flask_1_shed: Keep the shelf stocked, to provide empty flasks for alchemy
strings.ui_builddesk_is_empty: Buy new Techs in Tech Tree to unlock new buildings.
strings.ui_builddesk_town_is_empty: Buy new Techs in Tech Tree to unlock new options.
strings.ui_cant_exhume: To exhume a body, you need to remove the grave's fence and gravestone.
strings.ui_dont_have_points: You don’t have enough %1 to unlock this perk.
strings.ui_end_demo_body: In the full game you can:
strings.ui_end_demo_body_2: You'll be able to continue the story from this point, when the game is released on September 22nd! Here's some of what awaits:
strings.ui_end_demo_header: Thanks for playing Graveyard Keeper 2 Demo!
strings.ui_extract_item_desc: Do you want to extract this item from the body?
strings.ui_fence_empty: Add a fence to the grave
strings.ui_fight_barricades_unavailable: Barricades are unavailable in this fight
strings.ui_fight_construction_unavailable: Construction is unavailable in this fight
strings.ui_fight_towers_unavailable: Towers are unavailable in this fight
strings.ui_fuel_helper: Put the material in the firewood shed to provide fuel for the workbenches
strings.ui_grave_corpse_text: Remove all the decorations before exhuming the body
strings.ui_hotbar_selection_tip: Select a slot to equip this item:
strings.ui_monument_d: Gives additional <sprite name="wskull"> to the nearby tombs
strings.ui_monument_d_2: Gives additional <sprite name="wskull">, depending on the nearby tombs
strings.ui_new_tech_unlocked: You've unlocked a new technology and got:
strings.ui_operation_failed_desc: You can't exceed the collar's skull limit
strings.ui_order_possible_days: Orders can only be accepted on <sprite name="day_pride">. Orders cannot be accepted on other days.
strings.ui_previous_perk_locked: You need to unlock the parent perk first.
strings.ui_put_body: Put the body on the table
strings.ui_resurrection_insufficient_collar: This Zombie Collar isn't good enough for this corpse. You need a higher-quality collar.
strings.ui_resurrection_no_limit: You have reached the zombie limit. Use the PR Machine to increase it.
strings.ui_resurrection_no_organs: This body is missing vital organs. You can't make zombies without them.
strings.ui_tombstone_empty: Add a tombstone to the grave
strings.ultimate_bite_d: Attracts: Mythic Carp, Celestial Salmon, Elder Catfish, Kraken Jr
strings.violine_d: The violin of Albert's sister, intended for Linda.
strings.woodcutter_1_d: Chop trees into logs and firewood
strings.worms_bite_d: Attracts: Salmon, Herring, Eel, Catfish, Swamp Ghost, Anchovy
strings.zombie_supplier_station_no_overhead: I should put a zombie here.
strings.zombie_workers_tut_1: Zombies can craft items that you queue up at workbenches and furnaces. They can only follow recipes that match their talent level.
strings.zombie_workers_tut_2: Increase a zombie's talent by giving it better tools or by unlocking new talent points. Unlock talents using the Tech Points that zombies earn while crafting.
strings.zombie_workers_tut_3: For zombies to operate automatically, build a Zombie Supply Station in the area, and assign a Zombie Supplier to the station.
strings.zperk_advanced_blacksmith_d:
The zombie stopped hammering its own fingers.

+4 <sprite name="talent_red"> when working with iron.
strings.zperk_alchemist_d: Sometimes recipes give a little extra. Don't ask how. The zombie sometimes gets more items from the Formulation Bench.
strings.zperk_alchemy_talent_d:
Failure is just another form of experimentation.

+4 <sprite name="talent_blue"> when working at the Alchemy Workbench.
strings.zperk_apprentice_carpenter_d:
The zombie has learned the difference between a log and a plank.

+2 <sprite name="talent_orange"> when working with wood.
strings.zperk_axeman_d: A zombie equipped with an axe sometimes gets extra logs when chopping trees.
strings.zperk_blacksmith_1_d: The zombie sometimes crafts extra items from bronze work.
strings.zperk_blacksmith_2_d: The zombie sometimes crafts extra items from ironwork.
strings.zperk_blindseye_d: The zombie learned to draw the bow, rather than just throwing arrows by hand: higher bow damage.
strings.zperk_books_talent_d:
Every bestseller starts with a blank page.

+4 <sprite name="talent_yellow"> when crafting empty books.
strings.zperk_brewer_d:
The zombie learned to brew hops and honey without adding its own secret ingredients.

+3 <sprite name="talent_green"> at the brewery.
strings.zperk_carpenter_d: The zombie sometimes crafts extra items from wood.
strings.zperk_church_supplies_talent_d:
Even the church can't complain about free labor.

+4 <sprite name="talent_blue"> when crafting church supplies.
strings.zperk_clay_d: The zombie sometimes crafts extra items from clay.
strings.zperk_cube_distillations_1_d: Even the cube seems impressed. The zombie gets more items from the Distillation Cube.
strings.zperk_dead_king_d: The zombie writes everything faster: books, stories, and newspapers.
strings.zperk_dead_organist_d: When playing organ, gives more <sprite name="cross">.
strings.zperk_dead_printer_d: The zombie produces more paper and newspapers.
strings.zperk_dead_shakespeare_d: Every zombie has a story. Most end in tragedy. The zombie writes better stories.
strings.zperk_dead_singer_d: When in choir, it gives more <sprite name="cross">.
strings.zperk_dead_writer_d: The zombie can write: books, notes, newspapers...
strings.zperk_distillations_talent_d: +4 <sprite name="talent_blue"> when working at the Distillation Cube.
strings.zperk_excavator_d: The zombie has mastered the shovel. Increased speed when digging clay and sand.
strings.zperk_factory_operative_d: The zombie works better under the punishing conditions of conveyor production.
strings.zperk_farmer_1_d: The zombie produces better seeds and bigger crops.
strings.zperk_farmer_2_d: The zombie produces even better seeds and bigger crops.
strings.zperk_fertilizer_expert_d:
The zombie knows how to tell the different fertilizers apart.

+3 <sprite name="talent_blue"> when making fertilizer.
strings.zperk_formulation_talent_d:
If it's bubbling, don't stand too close.

+4 <sprite name="talent_blue"> when working at the Formulation Bench.
strings.zperk_glass_d: The zombie sometimes crafts extra item of glass.
strings.zperk_gold_d: The zombie sometimes finds gold when sifting sand.
strings.zperk_grave_crafter_d: A beautiful grave is your last chance to make a good first impression. The zombie crafts gravestones and fences more quickly.
strings.zperk_graves_fences_talent_d: +4 <sprite name="talent_orange"> when crafting gravestones and grave fences.
strings.zperk_impaler_d: The zombie gets that the sharp end points toward the enemy: higher spear damage.
strings.zperk_jeweller_d: Diamonds are forever. So is this employee. The zombie creates jewelry faster.
strings.zperk_jeweller_talent_d:
Zombie make a pretty!

+4 <sprite name="talent_red"> when working at the Jewelry Table.
strings.zperk_logger_d: The zombie figured out which end of the axe to hold. Woodcutting speed increased.
strings.zperk_magpies_eye_d: The zombie notices the shiny things in the mine, and can recover gems.
strings.zperk_mason_d: The zombie sometimes crafts extra items from stonework.
strings.zperk_master_blacksmith_d:
The zombie figured out heat control.

+6 <sprite name="talent_red"> when working with steel.
strings.zperk_master_carpenter_d:
The zombie has learned to saw in a straight line.

+4 <sprite name="talent_orange"> when working with wood.
strings.zperk_master_stonemason_d:
The zombie learned to control the force of its strikes.

+4 <sprite name="talent_orange"> when working with marble.
strings.zperk_miller_d: The zombie pours wheat between the millstones instead of all over the floor: yields more flour.
strings.zperk_musician_advanced_d: Not bad for someone without a pulse. Increases <sprite name="cross"> when assigned to the choir or organ.
strings.zperk_musician_basic_d: At least the rats seem to enjoy it. Slightly increases <sprite name="cross"> when assigned to the choir or organ.
strings.zperk_musician_master_d: Even the angels are taking notes. Greatly increases <sprite name="cross"> when assigned to the choir or organ.
strings.zperk_newspaper_talent_d:
Extra! Extra! Nobody's actually alive to read it.

+4 <sprite name="talent_yellow"> when working at the Printing Press.
strings.zperk_novice_blacksmith_d:
The zombie figured out which end of the hammer to hold.

+2 <sprite name="talent_red"> when working with bronze.
strings.zperk_novice_fisherman_d: The zombie learned that bobbers float and sinkers sink: higher chance to catch common fish.
strings.zperk_novice_stonemason_d:
The zombie realized the chisel is for the stone, not for gnawing.

+2 <sprite name="talent_orange"> when working with stone.
strings.zperk_paper_d: The zombie sometimes crafts extra paper.
strings.zperk_paper_talent_d:
Dead tree, dead worker — a perfect match.

+4 <sprite name="talent_yellow"> when crafting paper.
strings.zperk_potions_talent_d:
Some ingredients are fresher than others.

+4 <sprite name="talent_blue"> when crafting potions.
strings.zperk_preserver_d:
The zombie learned to seal jars before their contents come alive.

+4 <sprite name="talent_green"> when making canned goods.
strings.zperk_presser_d:
The zombie learned not to spill juice all over the floor.

+4 <sprite name="talent_green"> when pressing juice.
strings.zperk_puff_master_d:
The zombie puts what remains of its lungs to good use.

+3 <sprite name="talent_red"> when working with glass.
strings.zperk_quarryman_d: The zombie has mastered the pickaxe. Quarrying speed increased.
strings.zperk_stories_talent_d:
Nobody remembers the author anyway.

+4 <sprite name="talent_yellow"> when writing stories.
strings.zperk_tailor_d: The zombie has gotten better with fabric and thread: fewer scraps, more finished items.
strings.zperk_tin_can_d: The zombie sees that armor is for wearing, not rattling around in a bag: higher defense.
strings.zperk_undead_resistance_d: The zombie remembered it's already dead, and stopped noticing minor wounds: higher health.
strings.zperk_veteran_fisherman_d: The zombie learned to set the hook in time: higher chance to catch rare fish.
strings.zperk_winemaker_d:
The zombie has learned the winemaking process.

+5 <sprite name="talent_green"> when making wine.
strings.zperk_writer_d: The zombie can write a story...
strings.zperk_writing_talent_d:
Writer's block isn't a problem if you don't have a brain. 

+4 <sprite name="talent_yellow"> when working at the Writing Desk.
strings.zperk_zombie_miner_d: The zombie works better in the poisonous fumes of the mine — unlike you.
strings.zperk_zombie_tools_d: Tools give double bonus talent to the zombie.
